verses.sa:
अग्न आ याहि वीतये गृणानो हव्यदातये ।
नि होता सत्सि बर्हिषि ॥
verses.rom:
agna a yahi vitaye grinano havyadataye |
ni hota satsi barhishi ||
verses.en: Come, Agni, praised with song, to feast and sacrificial offering: sit As Hotar on the holy grass!

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने यज्ञानां होता विश्वेषां हितः ।
देवेभिर्मानुषे जने ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne yajnanam hota vishvesham hitah |
devebhirmanushe jane ||
verses.en: O Agni, thou hast been ordained Hotar of every sacrifice, By Gods, among the race of men.

verses.sa:
अग्निं दूतं वृणीमहे होतारं विश्ववेदसं ।
अस्य यज्ञस्य सुक्रतुं ॥
verses.rom:
agnim dutam vrinimahe hotaram vishvavedasam |
asya yajnasya sukratum ||
verses.en: Agni we choose as envoy, skilled performer of this holy rite, Hotar, possessor of all wealth.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्वृत्राणि जङ्घनद्द्रविणस्युर्विपन्यया ।
समिद्धः शुक्र आहुतः ॥
verses.rom:
agnirvritrani janghanaddravinasyurvipanyaya |
samiddhah shukra ahutah ||
verses.en: Served with oblation, kindled, bright, through love of song may Agni, bent On riches, smite the Vritras dead!

verses.sa:
प्रेष्ठं वो अतिथिं स्तुषे मित्रमिव प्रियं ।
अग्ने रथं न वेद्यं ॥
verses.rom:
preshtham vo atithim stushe mitramiva priyam |
agne ratham na vedyam ||
verses.en: I laud your most beloved guest like a dear friend, O Agni, him Who, like a chariot, wins us wealth.

verses.sa:
त्वं नो अग्ने महोभिः पाहि विश्वस्या अरातेः ।
उत द्विषो मर्त्यस्य ॥
verses.rom:
tvam no agne mahobhih pahi vishvasya arateh |
uta dvisho martyasya ||
verses.en: Do thou, O Agni, with great might guard us from all malignity, Yea, from the hate of mortal man!

verses.sa:
एह्यूषु ब्रवाणि तेऽग्न इत्थेतरा गिरः ।
एभिर्वर्धास इन्दुभिः ॥
verses.rom:
ehyushu bravani te'gna itthetara girah |
ebhirvardhasa indubhih ||
verses.en: O Agni, come; far other songs of praise will I sing forth to thee. Wax mighty with these Soma-drops!

verses.sa:
आ ते वत्सो मनो यमत्परमाच्चित्सधस्थात्।
अग्ने त्वां कामये गिरा ॥
verses.rom:
a te vatso mano yamatparamachchitsadhasthat|
agne tvam kamaye gira ||
verses.en: May Vatsa draw thy mind away even from thy loftiest dwelling place! Agni, I yearn for thee with song.

verses.sa:
त्वामग्ने पुष्करादध्यथर्वा निरमन्थत ।
मूर्ध्नो विश्वस्य वाघतः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne pushkaradadhyatharva niramanthata |
murdhno vishvasya vaghatah ||
verses.en: Agni, Atharvan brought thee forth by rubbing from the sky, the head Of all who offer sacrifice.

verses.sa:
अग्ने विवस्वदा भरास्मभ्यमूतये महे ।
देवो ह्यसि नो दृशे ॥
verses.rom:
agne vivasvada bharasmabhyamutaye mahe |
devo hyasi no drishe ||
verses.en: O Agni, bring us radiant light to be our mighty succour, for Thou art our visible deity!

verses.sa:
नमस्ते अग्न ओजसे गृणन्ति देव कृष्टयः ।
अमैरमित्रमर्दय ॥
verses.rom:
namaste agna ojase grinanti deva krishtayah |
amairamitramardaya ||
verses.en: O Agni, God, the people sing reverent praise to thee for strength: With terrors trouble thou the foe

verses.sa:
दूतं वो विश्ववेदसं हव्यवाहममर्त्यं ।
यजिष्ठमृञ्जसे गिरा ॥
verses.rom:
dutam vo vishvavedasam havyavahamamartyam |
yajishthamrinjase gira ||
verses.en: I seek with song your messenger, oblation-bearer, lord of wealth, Immortal, best at sacrifice.

verses.sa:
उप त्वा जामयो गिरो देदिशतीर्हविष्कृतः ।
वायोरनीके अस्थिरन् ॥
verses.rom:
upa tva jamayo giro dedishatirhavishkritah |
vayoranike asthiran ||
verses.en: Still turning to their aim in thee the sacrificer's sister hymns Have come to thee before the wind.

verses.sa:
उप त्वाग्ने दिवेदिवे दोषावस्तर्धिया वयं ।
नमो भरन्त एमसि ॥
verses.rom:
upa tvagne divedive doshavastardhiya vayam |
namo bharanta emasi ||
verses.en: To thee, illuminer of night, O Agni, day by day with prayer, Bringing thee reverence, we come.

verses.sa:
जराबोध तद्विविड्ढि विशेविशे यज्ञियाय ।
स्तोमं रुद्राय दृशीकं ॥
verses.rom:
jarabodha tadvividdhi vishevishe yajniyaya |
stomam rudraya drishikam ||
verses.en: Help, thou who knowest lauds, this work, a lovely hymn in Rudra's praise, Adorable in every house!

verses.sa:
प्रति त्यं चारुमध्वरं गोपीथाय प्र हूयसे ।
मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ॥
verses.rom:
prati tyam charumadhvaram gopithaya pra huyase |
marudbhiragna a gahi ||
verses.en: To this fair sacrifice to drink the milky draught art thou called forth: O Agni, with the Maruts come!

verses.sa:
अश्वं न त्वा वारवन्तं वन्दध्या अग्निं नमोभिः ।
सम्राजन्तमध्वराणां ॥
verses.rom:
ashvam na tva varavantam vandadhya agnim namobhih |
samrajantamadhvaranam ||
verses.en: With homage will I reverence thee, Agni, like a long-tailed steed, Imperial lord of holy rites.

verses.sa:
और्वभृगुवच्छुचिमप्नवानवदा हुवे ।
अग्निं समुद्रवाससं ॥
verses.rom:
aurvabhriguvachchhuchimapnavanavada huve |
agnim samudravasasam ||
verses.en: As Aurva and as Bhrigu called, as Apnavana called, I call The radiant Agni robed with sea.

verses.sa:
अग्निमिन्धानो मनसा धियं सचेत मर्त्यः ।
अग्निमिन्धे विवस्वभिः ॥
verses.rom:
agnimindhano manasa dhiyam sacheta martyah |
agnimindhe vivasvabhih ||
verses.en: When he enkindles Agni, man should with his heart attend the song: I kindle Agni till he glows.

verses.sa:
आदित्प्रत्नस्य रेतसो ज्योतिः पश्यन्ति वासरं ।
परो यदिध्यते दिवि ॥
verses.rom:
aditpratnasya retaso jyotih pashyanti vasaram |
paro yadidhyate divi ||
verses.en: Then, verily, they see the light refulgent of primeval seed, Kindled on yonder side of heaven.

verses.sa:
अग्निं वो वृधन्तमध्वराणां पुरूतमं ।
अच्छा नप्त्रे सहस्वते ॥
verses.rom:
agnim vo vridhantamadhvaranam purutamam |
achchha naptre sahasvate ||
verses.en: Hither, for powerful kinship, I call Agni, him who prospers you, Most frequent at our solemn rites.

verses.sa:
अग्निस्तिग्मेन शोचिषा यंसद्विश्वं न्या३त्रिणं ।
अग्निर्नो वंसते रयिं ॥
verses.rom:
agnistigmena shochisha yamsadvishvam nya3trinam |
agnirno vamsate rayim ||
verses.en: May Agni with his pointed blaze cast down each fierce devouring fiend: May Agni win us wealth by war!

verses.sa:
अग्ने मृड महां अस्यय आ देवयुं जनं ।
इयेथ बर्हिरासदं ॥
verses.rom:
agne mrida maham asyaya a devayum janam |
iyetha barhirasadam ||
verses.en: Agni, be gracious; thou art great: thou hast approached the pious man, Hast come to sit on sacred grass.

verses.sa:
अग्ने रक्षा णो अंहसः प्रति स्म देव रीषतः ।
तपिष्ठैरजरो दह ॥
verses.rom:
agne raksha no amhasah prati sma deva rishatah |
tapishthairajaro daha ||
verses.en: Agni, preserve us,from distress consume our enemies, O God, Eternal, with thy hottest flames

verses.sa:
अग्ने युङ्क्ष्वा हि ये तवाश्वासो देव साधवः ।
अरं वहन्त्याशवः ॥
verses.rom:
agne yunkshva hi ye tavashvaso deva sadhavah |
aram vahantyashavah ||
verses.en: Harness, O Agni, O thou God, thy steeds which are most excellent! The fleet ones bring thee rapidly.

verses.sa:
नि त्वा नक्ष्य विश्पते द्युमन्तं धीमहे वयं ।
सुवीरमग्न आहुत ॥
verses.rom:
ni tva nakshya vishpate dyumantam dhimahe vayam |
suviramagna ahuta ||
verses.en: Lord of the tribes, whom all must seek, we worshipped Agni set thee down, Refulgent, rich in valiant men.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्मूर्धा दिवः ककुत्पतिः पृथिव्या अयं ।
अपां रेतांसि जिन्वति ॥
verses.rom:
agnirmurdha divah kakutpatih prithivya ayam |
apam retamsi jinvati ||
verses.en: Agni is head and height of heaven, the master of the earth is he He quickeneth the waters' seed.

verses.sa:
इममू षु त्वमस्माकं सनिं गायत्रं नव्यांसं ।
अग्ने देवेषु प्र वोचः ॥
verses.rom:
imamu shu tvamasmakam sanim gayatram navyamsam |
agne deveshu pra vochah ||
verses.en: O Agni, graciously announce this our good fortune of the Gods, And this our newest hymn of praise!

verses.sa:
तं त्वा गोपवनो गिरा जनिष्ठदग्ने अङ्गरः ।
स पावक श्रुधी हवं ॥
verses.rom:
tam tva gopavano gira janishthadagne angarah |
sa pavaka shrudhi havam ||
verses.en: By song, O Agni, Angiras! Gopavana hath brought thee forth Hear thou my call, refulgent one!

verses.sa:
परि वाजपतिः कविरग्निर्हव्यान्यक्रमीत् ।
दधद्रत्नानि दाशुषे ॥
verses.rom:
pari vajapatih kaviragnirhavyanyakramit |
dadhadratnani dashushe ||
verses.en: Agni, the Sage, the Lord of Strength, hath moved around the sacred gifts, Giving the offerer precious things.

verses.sa:
उदु त्यं जातवेदसं देवं वहन्ति केतवः ।
दृशे विश्वाय सूर्यं ॥
verses.rom:
udu tyam jatavedasam devam vahanti ketavah |
drishe vishvaya suryam ||
verses.en: His heralds bear him up aloft, the God who knoweth all that lives, The Sun, that all may look on him.

verses.sa:
कविमग्निमुप स्तुहि सत्यधर्माणमध्वरे ।
देवममीवचातनं ॥
verses.rom:
kavimagnimupa stuhi satyadharmanamadhvare |
devamamivachatanam ||
verses.en: Praise Agni in the sacrifice, the Sage whose holy laws are true The God who driveth grief away.

verses.sa:
शं नो देवीरभिष्टये शं नो भवन्तु पीतये ।
शं योरभि स्रवन्तु नः ॥
verses.rom:
sham no devirabhishtaye sham no bhavantu pitaye |
sham yorabhi sravantu nah ||
verses.en: Kind be the Goddesses to lend us help, and kind that we may drink: May their streams bring us health and wealth

verses.sa:
कस्य नूनं परीणसि धियो जिन्वसि सत्पते ।
जोषाता यस्य ते गिरः ॥
verses.rom:
kasya nunam parinasi dhiyo jinvasi satpate |
joshata yasya te girah ||
verses.en: Lord of the brave, whose songs dost thou in thine abundance now inspire, Thou whose hymns help to win the kine?

verses.sa: यज्ञायज्ञा वो अग्नये गिरागिरा च दक्षसे |प्रप्र वयममृतं जातवेदसं प्रियं मित्रं न शंसिषं ॥
verses.rom: yajnayajna vo agnaye giragira cha dakshase |prapra vayamamritam jatavedasam priyam mitram na shamsisham ||
verses.en: Sing to your Agni with each song, at every sacrifice for strength. Come, let us praise the wise and, everlasting God even as a well-beloved friend,

verses.sa: पाहि नो अग्न एकया पाह्यू३त द्वितीयया |पाहि गीर्भिस्तिसृभिरूर्जां पते पाहि चतसृभिर्वसो ॥
verses.rom: pahi no agna ekaya pahyu3ta dvitiyaya |pahi girbhistisribhirurjam pate pahi chatasribhirvaso ||
verses.en: Agni, protect thou us by one, protect us by the second song, Protect us by three hymns, O Lord of power and might, bright God, by four hymns guard us well!

verses.sa: बृहद्भिरग्ने अर्चिभिः शुक्रेण देव शोचिषा |भरद्वाजे समिधानो यविष्ठ्य रेवत्पावक दीदिहि ॥
verses.rom: brihadbhiragne archibhih shukrena deva shochisha |bharadvaje samidhano yavishthya revatpavaka didihi ||
verses.en: O Agni, with thy lofty beams, with thy pure brilliancy, O God, Kindled, most youthful one! by Bharadvaja's hand, shine on us richly, holy Lord!

verses.sa: त्वे अग्ने स्वाहुत प्रियासः सन्तु सूरयः |यन्तारो ये मघवानो जनानामूर्वं दयन्त गोनां ॥
verses.rom: tve agne svahuta priyasah santu surayah |yantaro ye maghavano jananamurvam dayanta gonam ||
verses.en: O Agni who art worshipped well, dear let our princes be to thee, Our wealthy patrons who are governors of men, who part, as gifts, the stall of kine!

verses.sa: अग्ने जरितर्विश्पतिस्तपानो देव रक्षसः |अप्रोषिवान्गृहपते महां असि दिवस्पायुर्दुरोणयुः ॥
verses.rom: agne jaritarvishpatistapano deva rakshasah |aproshivangrihapate maham asi divaspayurduronayuh ||
verses.en: Agni, praise-singer! Lord of men, God! burning up the Rakshasas, Mighty art thou, the ever-present, household-lord! home-friend and guardian from the sky.

verses.sa: अग्ने विवस्वदुषसश्चित्रं राधो अमर्त्य |आ दाशुषे जातवेदो वहा त्वमद्या देवां उषर्बुधः ॥
verses.rom: agne vivasvadushasashchitram radho amartya |a dashushe jatavedo vaha tvamadya devam usharbudhah ||
verses.en: Immortal Jatavedas, thou bright-hued refulgent gift of Dawn, Agni, this day to him who pays oblations bring the Gods who waken with the morn!

verses.sa: त्वं नश्चित्र ऊत्या वसो राधांसि चोदय |अस्य रायस्त्वमग्ने रथीरसि विदा गाधं तुचे तु नः ॥
verses.rom: tvam nashchitra utya vaso radhamsi chodaya |asya rayastvamagne rathirasi vida gadham tuche tu nah ||
verses.en: Wonderful, with thy favouring help, send us thy bounties, gracious Lord. Thou art the charioteer, Agni, of earthly wealth: find rest and safety for our seed!

verses.sa: त्वमित्सप्रथा अस्यग्ने त्रातरृतः कविः |त्वां विप्रासः समिधान दीदिव आ विवासन्ति वेधसः ॥
verses.rom: tvamitsapratha asyagne tratarritah kavih |tvam viprasah samidhana didiva a vivasanti vedhasah ||
verses.en: Famed art thou, Agni, far and wide, preserver, righteous, and a Sage. The holy singers, O enkindled radiant one, ordainers, call on thee to come.

verses.sa: आ नो अग्ने वयोवृधं रयिं पावक शंस्यं |रास्वा च न उपमाते पुरुस्पृहं सुनीती सुयशस्तरं ॥
verses.rom: a no agne vayovridham rayim pavaka shamsyam |rasva cha na upamate puruspriham suniti suyashastaram ||
verses.en: O holy Agni, give us wealth famed among men and strengthening life! Bestow on us, O helper, that which many crave, more glorious still through righteousness!

verses.sa: यो विश्वा दयते वसु होता मन्द्रो जनानां |मधोर्न पात्रा प्रथमान्यस्मै प्र स्तोमा यन्त्वग्नये ॥
verses.rom: yo vishva dayate vasu hota mandro jananam |madhorna patra prathamanyasmai pra stoma yantvagnaye ||
verses.en: To him, who dealeth out all wealth, the sweet-toned Hotar-priest of men, To him like the first vessels filled with savoury juice, to Agni let the lauds go forth.

verses.sa:
एना वो अग्निं नमसोर्जो नपातमा हुवे ।
प्रियं चेतिष्ठमरतिं स्वाध्वरं विश्वस्य दूतममृतं ॥
verses.rom:
ena vo agnim namasorjo napatama huve |
priyam chetishthamaratim svadhvaram vishvasya dutamamritam ||
verses.en: With this mine homage I invoke Agni for you, the Son of Strength, Dear, wisest envoy, skilled in noble sacrifice, immortal messenger of all.

verses.sa:
शेषे वनेषु मातृषु सं त्वा मर्तास इन्धते ।
अतन्द्रो हव्यं वहसि हविष्कृत आदिद्देवेषु राजसि ॥
verses.rom:
sheshe vaneshu matrishu sam tva martasa indhate |
atandro havyam vahasi havishkrita adiddeveshu rajasi ||
verses.en: Thou liest in the logs that are thy mothers: mortals kindle thee. Alert thou bearest off the sacrifleer's gift, and then thou shinest to the Gods.

verses.sa:
अदर्शि गातुवित्तमो यस्मिन्व्रतान्यादधुः ।
उपो षु जातमार्यस्य वर्धनमग्निं नक्षन्तु नो गिरः ॥
verses.rom:
adarshi gatuvittamo yasminvratanyadadhuh |
upo shu jatamaryasya vardhanamagnim nakshantu no girah ||
verses.en: He hath appeared, best prosperer, in whom men lay their holy acts: So may our songs of praise come nigh to Agni who was born to give the Arya strength!

verses.sa:
अग्निरुक्थे पुरोहितो ग्रावाणो बर्हिरध्वरे ।
ऋचा यामि मरुतो ब्रह्मणस्पते देवा अवो वरेण्यं ॥
verses.rom:
agnirukthe purohito gravano barhiradhvare |
richa yami maruto brahmanaspate deva avo varenyam ||
verses.en: Chief Priest is Agni at the laud, as stones and grass at sacrifice. Gods! Maruts! Brahmanaspati! I crave with song the help that is most excellent.

verses.sa:
अग्निमीडिष्वावसे गाथाभिः शीरशोचिषं ।
अग्निं राये पुरुमीढ श्रुतं नरोऽग्निः सुदीतये छर्दिः ॥
verses.rom:
agnimidishvavase gathabhih shirashochisham |
agnim raye purumidha shrutam naro'gnih suditaye chhardih ||
verses.en: Pray Agni of the piercing flame, with sacred songs, to be our help; For wealth, famed Agni, Purumilha and ye men! He is Suditi's sure defence.

verses.sa:
श्रुधि श्रुत्कर्ण वह्निभिर्देवैरग्ने सयावभिः ।
आ सीदतु बर्हिषि मित्रो अर्यमा प्रातर्यावभिरध्वरे ॥
verses.rom:
shrudhi shrutkarna vahnibhirdevairagne sayavabhih |
a sidatu barhishi mitro aryama prataryavabhiradhvare ||
verses.en: Hear, Agni who hast ears to hear, with all thy train of escort Gods! With those who come at dawn let Mitra, Aryaman sit on the grass at sacrifice.

verses.sa:
प्र दैवोदासो अग्निर्देव इन्द्रो न मज्मना ।
अनु मातरं पृथिवीं वि वावृते तस्थौ नाकस्य शर्मणि ॥
verses.rom:
pra daivodaso agnirdeva indro na majmana |
anu mataram prithivim vi vavrite tasthau nakasya sharmani ||
verses.en: Agni of Divodasa, God, comes forth like Indra in his might. Rapidly hath he moved along his mother earth: he stands in high heaven's dwelling-place.

verses.sa:
अध ज्मो अध वा दिवो बृहतो रोचनादधि ।
अया वर्धस्व तन्वा गिरा ममा जाता सुक्रतो पृण ॥
verses.rom:
adha jmo adha va divo brihato rochanadadhi |
aya vardhasva tanva gira mama jata sukrato prina ||
verses.en: Whether thou come from earth or from the lofty lucid realm of heaven, Wax stronger in thy body through my song of praise: fill full all creatures, O most wise!

verses.sa:
कायमानो वना त्वं यन्मात्ऱीरजगन्नपः ।
न तत्ते अग्ने प्रमृषे निवर्तनं यद्दूरे सन्निहाभुवः ॥
verses.rom:
kayamano vana tvam yanmatrirajagannapah |
na tatte agne pramrishe nivartanam yaddure sannihabhuvah ||
verses.en: If, loving well the forests, thou wentest to thy maternal floods, Not to be scorned, Agni, is that return of thine when, from afar, thou now art here.

verses.sa:
नि त्वामग्ने मनुर्दधे ज्योतिर्जनाय शश्वते ।
दीदेथ कण्व ऋतजात उक्षितो यं नमस्यन्ति कृष्टयः ॥
verses.rom:
ni tvamagne manurdadhe jyotirjanaya shashvate |
didetha kanva ritajata ukshito yam namasyanti krishtayah ||
verses.en: O Agni, Manu stablished thee a light for all the race of men: With Kanva hast thou blazed, Law-born and waxen strong, thou whom the people reverence.

verses.sa:
देवो वो द्रविणोदाः पूर्णां विवष्ट्वासिचं ।
उद्वा सिञ्चध्वमुप वा पृणध्वमादिद्वो देव ओहते ॥
verses.rom:
devo vo dravinodah purnam vivashtvasicham |
udva sinchadhvamupa va prinadhvamadidvo deva ohate ||
verses.en: The God who giveth wealth accept your full libation poured to, him! Pour ye it out, then fill the vessel full again, for so the God regardeth you.

verses.sa:
प्रैतु ब्रह्मणस्पतिः प्र देव्येतु सूनृता ।
अच्छा वीरं नर्यं पङ्क्तिराधसं देवा यज्ञं नयन्तु नः ॥
verses.rom:
praitu brahmanaspatih pra devyetu sunrita |
achchha viram naryam panktiradhasam deva yajnam nayantu nah ||
verses.en: Let Brahmanaspati come forth, let Sunrita the Goddess come, And Gods bring to our rite which yields a fivefold gift the hero, lover of mankind!

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्व ऊ षु ण ऊतये तिष्ठा देवो न सविता ।
ऊर्ध्वो वाजस्य सनिता यदञ्जिभिर्वाघद्भिर्विह्वयामहे ॥
verses.rom:
urdhva u shu na utaye tishtha devo na savita |
urdhvo vajasya sanita yadanjibhirvaghadbhirvihvayamahe ||
verses.en: Stand up erect to lend us aid, stand up like Savitar the God, Erect as strength-bestower when we call on thee with priests who balm our offerings!

verses.sa:
प्र यो राये निनीषति मर्तो यस्ते वसो दाशत् ।
स वीरं धत्ते अग्न उक्थशंसिनं त्मना सहस्रपोषिणं ॥
verses.rom:
pra yo raye ninishati marto yaste vaso dashat |
sa viram dhatte agna ukthashamsinam tmana sahasraposhinam ||
verses.en: The man who bringeth gifts to thee, bright God who fain wouldst lead to wealth, Winneth himself a brave son, Agni! skilled in lauds, one prospering in a thousand ways.

verses.sa:
प्र वो यह्वं पुरूणां विशां देवयतीनां ।
अग्निं सूक्तेभिर्वचोभिर्वृणीमहे यंसमिदन्य इन्धते ॥
verses.rom:
pra vo yahvam purunam visham devayatinam |
agnim suktebhirvachobhirvrinimahe yamsamidanya indhate ||
verses.en: With hymns and holy eulogies we supplicate your Agni, Lord Of many families who duly serve the Gods, yea, him whom others too inflame.

verses.sa:
अयमग्निः सुवीर्यस्येशे हि सौभगस्य ।
राय ईशे स्वपत्यस्य गोमत ईशे वृत्रहथानां ॥
verses.rom:
ayamagnih suviryasyeshe hi saubhagasya |
raya ishe svapatyasya gomata ishe vritrahathanam ||
verses.en: This Agni is the Lord of great prosperity and hero, strength, Of wealth with noble offspring and with store of kine, the Lord of battles with the foe.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने गृहपतिस्त्वं होता नो अध्वरे ।
त्वं पोता विश्ववार प्रचेता ताक्षि यासि च वार्यं ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne grihapatistvam hota no adhvare |
tvam pota vishvavara pracheta takshi yasi cha varyam ||
verses.en: Thou, Agni, art the homestead's Lord, our Hotar-priest at sacrifice. Lord of all boons, thou art the Potar, passing wise. Pay worship, and enjoy the good!

verses.sa:
सखायस्त्वा ववृमहे देवं मर्तास ऊतये ।
अपां नपातं सुभगं सुदंससं सुप्रतूर्तिमनेहसं ॥
verses.rom:
sakhayastva vavrimahe devam martasa utaye |
apam napatam subhagam sudamsasam supraturtimanehasam ||
verses.en: We as thy friends have chosen thee, mortals a God, to be our help. The Waters' Child, the blessed, the most mighty one, swift conqueror, and without a peer.

verses.sa:
आ जुहोता हविषा मर्जयध्वं नि होतारं गृहपतिं दधिध्वं ।
इडस्पदे नमसा रातहव्यं सपर्यता यजतं पस्त्यानां ॥
verses.rom:
a juhota havisha marjayadhvam ni hotaram grihapatim dadhidhvam |
idaspade namasa ratahavyam saparyata yajatam pastyanam ||
verses.en: Present oblations, make him splendid: set ye as Hotar in his place the Home's Lord, worshipped With gifts and homage where they pour libations! Honour him meet for reverence in our houses.

verses.sa:
चित्र इच्छिशोस्तरुणस्य वक्षथो न यो मातरावन्वेति धातवे ।
अनूधा यदजीजनदधा चिदा ववक्षत्सद्यो महि दूत्या३ं चरन् ॥
verses.rom:
chitra ichchhishostarunasya vakshatho na yo mataravanveti dhatave |
anudha yadajijanadadha chida vavakshatsadyo mahi dutya3m charan ||
verses.en: Verily wondrous is the tender youngling's growth who never draweth nigh to drink his mother's milk. As soon as she who hath no udder bore him, he, faring on his. great errand, suddenly grew strong.

verses.sa:
इदं त एकं पर ऊ त एकं तृतीयेन ज्योतिषा सं विशस्व ।
संवेशनस्तन्वे३ चारुरेधि प्रियो देवानां परमे जनित्रे ॥
verses.rom:
idam ta ekam para u ta ekam tritiyena jyotisha sam vishasva |
samveshanastanve3 charuredhi priyo devanam parame janitre ||
verses.en: Here is one light for thee, another yonder: enter the third and, be therewith united. Beautiful be thy union with the body, beloved in the Gods' sublimest birthplace!

verses.sa:
इमं स्तोममर्हते जातवेदसे रथमिव सं महेमा मनीषया ।
भद्रा हि नः प्रमतिरस्य संसद्यग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
verses.rom:
imam stomamarhate jatavedase rathamiva sam mahema manishaya |
bhadra hi nah pramatirasya samsadyagne sakhye ma rishama vayam tava ||
verses.en: For Jatavedas, worthy of our praise, will we frame with our mind this eulogy as 'twere a car; For good, in his assembly, is this care of ours. Let us not, in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm!

verses.sa:
मूर्धानं दिवो अरतिं पृथिव्या वैश्वानरमृत आ जातमग्निं ।
कविं सम्राजमतिथिं जनानामासन्नाः पात्रं जनयन्त देवाः ॥
verses.rom:
murdhanam divo aratim prithivya vaishvanaramrita a jatamagnim |
kavim samrajamatithim jananamasannah patram janayanta devah ||
verses.en: Agni Vaisvanara, born in course of Order, the messenger of earth, the head of heaven, The Sage, the sovran, guest of men, our vessel fit for their mouth, the Gods have generated.

verses.sa:
वि त्वदापो न पर्वतस्य पृष्ठादुक्थेभिरग्ने जनयन्त देवाः ।
तं त्वा गिरः सुष्टुतयो वाजयन्त्याजिं न गिर्ववाहो जिग्युरश्वाः ॥
verses.rom:
vi tvadapo na parvatasya prishthadukthebhiragne janayanta devah |
tam tva girah sushtutayo vajayantyajim na girvavaho jigyurashvah ||
verses.en: Even as the waters from the mountain ridges, so sprang the; Gods, through lauds, from thee, O Agni. To thee speed hymns and eulogies, as horses haste, bearing him who loves the song, to battle.

verses.sa:
आ वो राजानमध्वरस्य रुद्रं होतारं सत्ययजं रोदस्योः ।
अग्निं पुरा तनयित्नोरचित्ताद्धिरण्यरूपमवसे कृणुध्वं ॥
verses.rom:
a vo rajanamadhvarasya rudram hotaram satyayajam rodasyoh |
agnim pura tanayitnorachittaddhiranyarupamavase krinudhvam ||
verses.en: Win to protect you, Rudra, lord of worship, priest of both worlds, effectual sacrificer, Agni, invested with his golden colours, before the thunder strike and lay you senseless!

verses.sa:
इन्धे राजा समर्यो नमोभिर्यस्य प्रतीकमाहुतं घृतेन ।
नरो हव्येभिरीडते सबाध आग्निरग्रमुषसामशोचि ॥
verses.rom:
indhe raja samaryo namobhiryasya pratikamahutam ghritena |
naro havyebhiridate sabadha agniragramushasamashochi ||
verses.en: The King whose face is decked with oil is kindled with homage offered by his faithful servant. The men, the priests adore him with oblations. Agni hath shone forth at the flush of morning.

verses.sa:
प्र केतुना बृहता यात्यग्निरा रोदसी वृषभो रोरवीति ।
दिवश्चिदन्तादुपमामुदानडपामुपस्थे महिषो ववर्ध ॥
verses.rom:
pra ketuna brihata yatyagnira rodasi vrishabho roraviti |
divashchidantadupamamudanadapamupasthe mahisho vavardha ||
verses.en: Agni advanceth with his lofty banner: through earth and heaven the Bull hath loudly bellowed He hath come nigh from the sky's farthest limit: the Steer hath waxen in the waters' bosom.

verses.sa:
अग्निं नरो दीधितिभिरण्योर्हस्तच्युतं जनयत प्रशस्तं ।
दूरेदृशं गृहपतिमथव्युं ॥
verses.rom:
agnim naro didhitibhiranyorhastachyutam janayata prashastam |
duredrisham grihapatimathavyum ||
verses.en: From the two fire-sticks have the men engendered with thoughts, urged by the hand, the glorious Agni, Far-seen, with pointed flame, Lord of the Homestead.

verses.sa:
अबोध्यग्निः समिधा जनानां प्रति धेनुमिवायतीमुषासं ।
यह्वा इव प्र वयामुज्जिहानाः प्र भानवः सस्रते नाकमच्छ ॥
verses.rom:
abodhyagnih samidha jananam prati dhenumivayatimushasam |
yahva iva pra vayamujjihanah pra bhanavah sasrate nakamachchha ||
verses.en: Agni is wakened by the people's fuel to meet the Dawn who cometh like a milch-cow. Like young trees shooting up on high their branches, his flames. are mounting to the vault of heaven.

verses.sa:
प्र भूर्जयन्तं महां विपोधां मूरैरमूरं पुरां दर्माणम्।
नयन्तं गीर्भिर्वना धियं धा हरिश्मश्रुं न वर्मणा धनर्चिम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra bhurjayantam maham vipodham murairamuram puram darmanam|
nayantam girbhirvana dhiyam dha harishmashrum na varmana dhanarchim ||
verses.en: Set forth the gleaming one, the song-inspirer, not foolish with. the foolish, fort- destroyer, Who leadeth with his hymns to thought of conquest, gold-bearded, richly splendid with his armour

verses.sa:
शुक्रं ते अन्यद्यजतं ते अन्यद्विषुरूपे अहनी द्यौरिवासि ।
विश्वा हि माया अवसि स्वधावन्भद्रा ते पूषन्निह रातिरस्तु ॥
verses.rom:
shukram te anyadyajatam te anyadvishurupe ahani dyaurivasi |
vishva hi maya avasi svadhavanbhadra te pushanniha ratirastu ||
verses.en: Thou art like heaven: one form is bright, one holy, like Day and Night dissimilar in colour. All magic powers thou aidest, self-dependent! Auspicious bethy bounty here, O Pushan!

verses.sa:
द्र.
इडामग्ने पुरुदंसं सनिं गोः शश्वत्तमं हवमानाय साध ।
स्यान्नः सूनुस्तनयो विजावाग्ने सा ते सुमतिर्भूत्वस्मे ॥
verses.rom:
dra.
idamagne purudamsam sanim goh shashvattamam havamanaya sadha |
syannah sunustanayo vijavagne sa te sumatirbhutvasme ||
verses.en: As holy food, Agni, to thine invoker give wealth in cattle, lasting, rich in marvels! To us be born a son and spreading offspring. Agni, be this thy gracious will to us-ward!

verses.sa:
प्र होता जातो महान्नभोविन्नृषद्मा सीददपां विवर्ते ।
दधद्यो धायी सुते वयांसि यन्ता वसूनि विधते तनूपाः ॥
verses.rom:
pra hota jato mahannabhovinnrishadma sidadapam vivarte |
dadhadyo dhayi sute vayamsi yanta vasuni vidhate tanupah ||
verses.en: Stablished to fill the juice with vital vigour, giver of wealth, guard of his servant's body, The great Priest, born, who knows the clouds, abider with men, is seated in the waters' eddy.

verses.sa:
प्र सम्राजमसुरस्य प्रशस्तं पुंसः कृष्टीनामनुमाद्यस्य ।
इन्द्रस्येव प्र तवसस्कृतानि वन्दद्वारा वन्दमाना विवष्टु ॥
verses.rom:
pra samrajamasurasya prashastam pumsah krishtinamanumadyasya |
indrasyeva pra tavasaskritani vandadvara vandamana vivashtu ||
verses.en: Let the song, honouring the best, with longing honour the Asura's most famous sovran, The deeds of him the mighty, deeds like Indra's, the manly one in whom the folk must triumph!

verses.sa:
अरण्योर्निहितो जातवेदा गर्भ इवेत्सुभृतो गर्भिणीभिः ।
दिवेदिव ईड्यो जागृवद्भिर्हविष्मद्भिर्मनुष्येभिरग्निः ॥
verses.rom:
aranyornihito jataveda garbha ivetsubhrito garbhinibhih |
divediva idyo jagrivadbhirhavishmadbhirmanushyebhiragnih ||
verses.en: In the two kindling-blocks lies Jatavedas like the well-cherished germ in pregnant women,-- Agni who day by day must be entreated by men who watch provided with oblations.

verses.sa:
सनादग्ने मृणसि यातुधानान्न त्वा रक्षांसि पृतनासु जिग्युः ।
अनु दह सहमूरान्कयादो मा ते हेत्या मुक्षत दैव्यायाः ॥
verses.rom:
sanadagne mrinasi yatudhananna tva rakshamsi pritanasu jigyuh |
anu daha sahamurankayado ma te hetya mukshata daivyayah ||
verses.en: Agni, from days of old thou slayest demons: never shall Rakshasas in fight o'ercome thee. Burn up the foolish ones, raw flesh devourers: let none of them escape thine heavenly arrow!

verses.sa:
अग्न ओजिष्ठमा भर द्युम्नमस्मभ्यमध्रिगो ।
प्र नो राये पनीयसे रत्सि वाजाय पन्थां ॥
verses.rom:
agna ojishthama bhara dyumnamasmabhyamadhrigo |
pra no raye paniyase ratsi vajaya pantham ||
verses.en: Bring us most mighty splendour thou, Agni, resistless on thy way: Prepare for us the path that leads to glorious opulence and strength!

verses.sa:
यदि वीरो अनु ष्यादग्निमिन्धीत मर्त्यः ।
आजुह्वद्धव्यमानुषक्शर्म भक्षीत दैव्यं ॥
verses.rom:
yadi viro anu shyadagnimindhita martyah |
ajuhvaddhavyamanushaksharma bhakshita daivyam ||
verses.en: May the brave man, if full of zeal he serve and kindle Agni's flame, Duly presenting sacred gifts, enjoy the Gods' protecting help.

verses.sa:
त्वेषस्ते धूम ऋण्वति दिवि सं च्छुक्र आततः ।
सूरो न हि द्युता त्वं कृपा पावक रोचसे ॥
verses.rom:
tveshaste dhuma rinvati divi sam chchhukra atatah |
suro na hi dyuta tvam kripa pavaka rochase ||
verses.en: Thy bright smoke lifts itself aloft, and far-extended shines in heaven, For, Purifier! like the Sun thou beamest with thy radiant glow.

verses.sa:
त्वं हि क्षैतवद्यशोऽग्ने मित्रो न पत्यसे ।
त्वं विचर्षणे श्रवो वसो पुष्टिं न पुष्यसि ॥
verses.rom:
tvam hi kshaitavadyasho'gne mitro na patyase |
tvam vicharshane shravo vaso pushtim na pushyasi ||
verses.en: Thou, Agni, even as Mitra, hast a princely glory of thine own. Bright, active God, thou makest fame increase like means of nourishment.

verses.sa:
प्रातरग्निः पुरुप्रियो विष स्तवेतातिथिः ।
विश्वे यस्मिन्नमर्त्ये हव्यं मर्तास इन्धते ॥
verses.rom:
prataragnih purupriyo visha stavetatithih |
vishve yasminnamartye havyam martasa indhate ||
verses.en: At dawn let Agni, much-beloved, guest of the house, be glorified, In whom, the everlasting one, all mortals make their offerings blaze.

verses.sa:
यद्वाहिष्ठं तदग्नये बृहदर्च विभावसो ।
महिषीव त्वद्रयिस्त्वद्वाजा उदीरते ॥
verses.rom:
yadvahishtham tadagnaye brihadarcha vibhavaso |
mahishiva tvadrayistvadvaja udirate ||
verses.en: Most moving song be Agni's: shine on high, O rich in radiant light! Like the chief consort of a King riches and strength proceed from thee.

verses.sa:
विशोविशो वो अतिथिं वाजयन्तः पुरुप्रियं ।
अग्निं वो दुर्यं वचः स्तुषे शूषस्य मन्मभिः ॥
verses.rom:
vishovisho vo atithim vajayantah purupriyam |
agnim vo duryam vachah stushe shushasya manmabhih ||
verses.en: Exerting all our strength with thoughts of power we glorify in speech Agni your dear familiar friend, the darling guest in every house.

verses.sa:
बृहद्वयो हि भानवेऽर्चा देवायाग्नये ।
यं मित्रं न प्रशस्तये मर्तासो दधिरे पुरः ॥
verses.rom:
brihadvayo hi bhanave'rcha devayagnaye |
yam mitram na prashastaye martaso dadhire purah ||
verses.en: His beam hath lofty power of life: sing praise to Agni, to the God Whom men have set in foremost place, like Mitra for their eulogy!

verses.sa:
अगन्म वृत्रहन्तमं ज्येष्ठमग्निमानवं ।
य स्म श्रुतर्वन्नार्क्षे बृहदनीक इध्यते ॥
verses.rom:
aganma vritrahantamam jyeshthamagnimanavam |
ya sma shrutarvannarkshe brihadanika idhyate ||
verses.en: To noblest Agni, friend of man, chief Vritra-slayer, have we come- Who with Srutarvan, Riksha's son, in lofty presence is inflamed.

verses.sa:
जातः परेण धर्मणा यत्सवृद्भिः सहाभुवः ।
पिता यत्कश्यपस्याग्निः श्रद्धा माता मनुः कविः ॥
verses.rom:
jatah parena dharmana yatsavridbhih sahabhuvah |
pita yatkashyapasyagnih shraddha mata manuh kavih ||
verses.en: Born as the loftiest Law commands, comrade of those who grew with him. Agni, the sire of Kasyapa by faith, the mother, Manu, Sage.

verses.sa:
सोमं राजानं वरुणमग्निमन्वारभामहे।
आदित्यं विष्णुं सूर्यं ब्रह्मानं च बृहस्पतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
somam rajanam varunamagnimanvarabhamahe|
adityam vishnum suryam brahmanam cha brihaspatim ||
verses.en: We in King Soma place our trust, in Agni, and in Varuna, The Aditya, Vishnu, Surya, and the Brahman-priest Brihaspati.

verses.sa:
इत एत उदारुहन्दिवः पृष्ठान्या रुहन्।
प्र भूर्जयो यथा पथोद्यामङ्गिरसो ययुः ॥
verses.rom:
ita eta udaruhandivah prishthanya ruhan|
pra bhurjayo yatha pathodyamangiraso yayuh ||
verses.en: Hence have these men gone up on high and mounted to the heights of heaven: On! conquer on the path by which Angirasas travelled to the skies!

verses.sa:
राये अग्ने महे त्वा दानाय समिधीमहि।
ईडिष्वा हि महे वृषं द्यावा होत्राय पृथिवी ॥
verses.rom:
raye agne mahe tva danaya samidhimahi|
idishva hi mahe vrisham dyava hotraya prithivi ||
verses.en: That thou mayst send us ample wealth, O Agni, we will kindler thee: So, for the great oblation, Steer, pray Heaven and Earth to come to us!

verses.sa:
दधन्वे वा यदीमनु वोचद्ब्रह्मेति वेरु तत्।
परि विश्वानि काव्या नेमिश्चक्रमिवाभुवत् ॥
verses.rom:
dadhanve va yadimanu vochadbrahmeti veru tat|
pari vishvani kavya nemishchakramivabhuvat ||
verses.en: He runs when one calls after him, This is the prayer of him who prays. He holds all knowledge in his grasp even as the felly rounds the wheel.

verses.sa:
प्रत्यग्ने हरसा हरः शृणाहि विश्वतस्परि।
यातुधानस्य रक्षसो बलं न्युब्जवीर्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
pratyagne harasa harah shrinahi vishvataspari|
yatudhanasya rakshaso balam nyubjaviryam ||
verses.en: Shoot forth, O Agni, with thy flame: demolish them on every side! Break down the Yatudhana's strength, the vigour of the Rakshasa!

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने वसूंरिह रुद्रां आदित्यां उत।
यजा स्वध्वरं जनं मनुजातं घृतप्रुषम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne vasumriha rudram adityam uta|
yaja svadhvaram janam manujatam ghritaprusham ||
verses.en: Worship the Vasus, Agni! here, the Rudras and Adityas, all Who know fair sacrifices, sprung from Mann, scattering blessings down!

verses.sa:
पुरु त्वा दाशिवां वोचेऽरिरग्ने तव स्विदा ।
तोदस्येव शरण आ महस्य ॥
verses.rom:
puru tva dashivam voche'riragne tava svida |
todasyeva sharana a mahasya ||
verses.en: Agni, thy faithful servant I call upon thee with many a gift, As in the keeping of the great inciting God.

verses.sa:
प्र होत्रे पूर्व्यं वचोऽग्नये भरता बृहत् ।
विपां ज्योतींषि बिभ्रते न वेधसे ॥
verses.rom:
pra hotre purvyam vacho'gnaye bharata brihat |
vipam jyotimshi bibhrate na vedhase ||
verses.en: To Agni, to the Hotar-priest offer your best, your lofty speech, To him ordainer-like who bears the light of songs.

verses.sa:
अग्ने वाजस्य गोमत ईशानः सहसो यहो ।
अस्मे धेहि जातवेदो महि श्रवः ॥
verses.rom:
agne vajasya gomata ishanah sahaso yaho |
asme dhehi jatavedo mahi shravah ||
verses.en: O Agni, thou who art the lord of wealth in kine, thou Son of Strength, Bestow on us, O Jatavedas, high renown

verses.sa:
अग्ने यजिष्ठो अध्वरे देवां देवयते यज ।
होता मन्द्रो वि राजस्यति स्रिधः ॥
verses.rom:
agne yajishtho adhvare devam devayate yaja |
hota mandro vi rajasyati sridhah ||
verses.en: Most skilled in sacrifice, bring the Gods, O Agni, to the pious, man: A joyful Priest, thy splendour drives our foes afar

verses.sa:
जज्ञानः सप्त मातृभिर्मेधामाशासत श्रिये ।
अयं ध्रुवो रयीणां चिकेतदा ॥
verses.rom:
jajnanah sapta matribhirmedhamashasata shriye |
ayam dhruvo rayinam chiketada ||
verses.en: Taught by seven mothers at his birth was he, for glory of the wise. He, firm and sure, hath set his mind on glorious wealth

verses.sa:
उत स्या नो दिवा मतिरदितिरूत्यागमत् ।
सा शन्ताता मयस्करदप स्रिधः ॥
verses.rom:
uta sya no diva matiraditirutyagamat |
sa shantata mayaskaradapa sridhah ||
verses.en: And in the day our prayer is this: May Aditi come nigh to help, With loving-kindness bring us weal and chase our foes

verses.sa:
ईडिष्वा हि प्रतीव्या३ं यजस्व जातवेदसं ।
चरिष्णुधूममगृभीतशोचिषं ॥
verses.rom:
idishva hi prativya3m yajasva jatavedasam |
charishnudhumamagribhitashochisham ||
verses.en: Worship thou Jatavedas, pray to him who willingly accepts, Whose smoke wanders at will, and none may grasp his flame

verses.sa:
न तस्य मायया च न रिपुरीशीत मर्त्यः ।
यो अग्नये ददाश हव्यदातये ॥
verses.rom:
na tasya mayaya cha na ripurishita martyah |
yo agnaye dadasha havyadataye ||
verses.en: No mortal man can e'er prevail by arts of magic over him Who hath served Agni well, the oblation-giving God.

verses.sa:
अप त्यं वृजिनं रिपुं स्तेनमग्ने दुराध्यं ।
दविष्ठमस्य सत्पते कृधी सुगं ॥
verses.rom:
apa tyam vrijinam ripum stenamagne duradhyam |
davishthamasya satpate kridhi sugam ||
verses.en: Agni, drive thou the wicked foe, the evil-hearted thief away, Far, far, Lord of the brave! and give us easy paths!

verses.sa:
श्रुष्ट्यग्ने नवस्य मे स्तोमस्य वीर विश्पते ।
नि मायिनस्तपसा रक्षसो दह ॥
verses.rom:
shrushtyagne navasya me stomasya vira vishpate |
ni mayinastapasa rakshaso daha ||
verses.en: O hero Agni, Lord of men, on hearing this new laud of mine Burn down the Rakshasas, enchanters, with thy flame!

verses.sa:
प्र मंहिष्ठाय गायत ऋताव्ने बृहते शुक्रशोचिषे ।
उपस्तुतासो अग्नये ॥
verses.rom:
pra mamhishthaya gayata ritavne brihate shukrashochishe |
upastutaso agnaye ||
verses.en: Sing forth to him the holy, most munificent, sublime with his refulgent glow, To Agni, ye Upastutas

verses.sa:
प्र सो अग्ने तवोतिभिः सुवीराभिस्तरति वाजकर्मभिः ।
यस्य त्वं सख्यमाविथ ॥
verses.rom:
pra so agne tavotibhih suvirabhistarati vajakarmabhih |
yasya tvam sakhyamavitha ||
verses.en: Agni, he conquers by thine aid that brings him store of valiant sons and does great deeds, Whose bond of friendship is thy choice

verses.sa:
तं गूर्धया स्वर्णरं देवासो देवमरतिं दधन्विरे ।
देवत्रा हव्यमूहिषे ॥
verses.rom:
tam gurdhaya svarnaram devaso devamaratim dadhanvire |
devatra havyamuhishe ||
verses.en: Sing praise to him the Lord of light! The Gods have made the God to be their messenger, To bear oblation to the Gods.

verses.sa:
मा नो हृणीथा अतिथिं वसुरग्निः पुरुप्रशस्त एशः ।
यः सुहोता स्वध्वरः ॥
verses.rom:
ma no hrinitha atithim vasuragnih puruprashasta eshah |
yah suhota svadhvarah ||
verses.en: Anger not him who is our guest! He is the bright God Agni, praised by many a man, God Hotar, skilled in sacrifice.

verses.sa:
भद्रो नो अग्निराहुतो भद्रा रातिः सुभग भद्रो अध्वरः ।
भद्रा उत प्रशस्तयः ॥
verses.rom:
bhadro no agnirahuto bhadra ratih subhaga bhadro adhvarah |
bhadra uta prashastayah ||
verses.en: May Agni, worshipped, bring us bliss: may the gift, blessed one! and sacrifice bring bliss. Yea, may our eulogies bring bliss.

verses.sa:
यजिष्ठं त्वा ववृमहे देवं देवत्रा होतारममर्त्यं ।
अस्य यज्ञस्य सुक्रतुं ॥
verses.rom:
yajishtham tva vavrimahe devam devatra hotaramamartyam |
asya yajnasya sukratum ||
verses.en: Thee have we chosen skilfullest in sacrifice, immortal Priest among the Gods, Wise finisher of this holy rite.

verses.sa:
तदग्ने द्युम्नमा भर यत्सासाहा सदने कं चिदत्रिणं ।
मन्युं जनस्य दूढ्यं ॥
verses.rom:
tadagne dyumnama bhara yatsasaha sadane kam chidatrinam |
manyum janasya dudhyam ||
verses.en: Bring us that splendour, Agni, which may overcome each greedy fiend in our abode, And the malicious wrath of men!

verses.sa:
यद्वा उ विश्पतिः शितः सुप्रीतो मनुषो विशे ।
विश्वेदग्निः प्रति रक्षांसि सेधति ॥
verses.rom:
yadva u vishpatih shitah suprito manusho vishe |
vishvedagnih prati rakshamsi sedhati ||
verses.en: Soon as the eager Lord of men is friendly unto Manu's race Agni averteth from us all the Rakshasas!

verses.sa:
तद्वो गाय सुते सचा पुरुहूताय सत्वने ।
शं यद्गवे न शाकिने ॥
verses.rom:
tadvo gaya sute sacha puruhutaya satvane |
sham yadgave na shakine ||
verses.en: Sing this, beside the flowing juice, to him your hero, much-invoked, To please him as a mighty Bull

verses.sa:
यस्ते नूनं शतक्रतविन्द्र द्युम्नितमो मदः ।
तेन नूनं मदे मदेः ॥
verses.rom:
yaste nunam shatakratavindra dyumnitamo madah |
tena nunam made madeh ||
verses.en: O Satakratu Indra, now rejoice with that carouse of thine Which is most glorious of all!

verses.sa:
गाव उप वदावटे महि यज्ञस्य रप्सुदा ।
उभा कर्णा हिरण्यया ॥
verses.rom:
gava upa vadavate mahi yajnasya rapsuda |
ubha karna hiranyaya ||
verses.en: Ye cows, protect the fount: the two mighty ones bless the sacrifice. The handles twain are wrought of gold.

verses.sa:
अरमश्वाय गायत श्रुतकक्षारं गवे ।
अरमिन्द्रस्य धाम्ने ॥
verses.rom:
aramashvaya gayata shrutakaksharam gave |
aramindrasya dhamne ||
verses.en: Sing praises that the horse may come; sing, Srutakaksha, that the cow May come, that Indra's might may come

verses.sa:
तमिन्द्रं वाजयामसि महे वृत्राय हन्तवे ।
स वृषा वृषभो भुवत् ॥
verses.rom:
tamindram vajayamasi mahe vritraya hantave |
sa vrisha vrishabho bhuvat ||
verses.en: We make this Indra very strong to strike, the mighty Vritra dead: A vigorous hero shall he be.

verses.sa:
त्वमिन्द्र बलादधि सहसो जात ओजसः ।
त्वं सन्वृषन्वृषेदसि ॥
verses.rom:
tvamindra baladadhi sahaso jata ojasah |
tvam sanvrishanvrishedasi ||
verses.en: Based upon strength and victory and power, O Indra, is thy birth: Thou, mighty one! art strong indeed,

verses.sa:
यज्ञ इन्द्रमवर्धयद्यद्भूमिं व्यवर्तयत् ।
चक्राण ओपशं दिवि ॥
verses.rom:
yajna indramavardhayadyadbhumim vyavartayat |
chakrana opasham divi ||
verses.en: The sacrifice made Indra great when he unrolled the earth, and made Himself a diadem in heaven.

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्राहं तथा त्वमीशीय वस्व एक इत् ।
स्तोता मे गोसखा स्यात् ॥
verses.rom:
yadindraham tatha tvamishiya vasva eka it |
stota me gosakha syat ||
verses.en: If I, O Indra, were, like thee, the single ruler over wealth My worshipper should be rich in kine.

verses.sa:
पन्यंपन्यमित्सोतार आ धावत मद्याय ।
सोमं वीराय शूराय ॥
verses.rom:
panyampanyamitsotara a dhavata madyaya |
somam viraya shuraya ||
verses.en: Pressers, blend Soma juice for him, each draught most excellent, for him The brave, the hero, for his joy.

verses.sa:
इदं वसो सुतमन्धः पिबा सुपूर्णमुदरं ।
अनाभयिन्ररिमा ते ॥
verses.rom:
idam vaso sutamandhah piba supurnamudaram |
anabhayinrarima te ||
verses.en: Here is the Soma juice expressed. O Vasu, drink till thou art full: Undaunted God, we give it thee

verses.sa:
उद्धेदभि श्रुतामघं वृषभं नर्यापसं |
अस्तारमेषि सूर्य ॥
verses.rom:
uddhedabhi shrutamagham vrishabham naryapasam |
astarameshi surya ||
verses.en: Surya, thou mountest up to meet the hero famous for his wealth, Who hurls the bolt and works for man.

verses.sa:
यदद्य कच्च वृत्रहन्नुदगा अभि सूर्य |
सर्वं तदिन्द्र ते वशे ॥
verses.rom:
yadadya kachcha vritrahannudaga abhi surya |
sarvam tadindra te vashe ||
verses.en: Whatever, Vritra-slayer! thou, Surya hast risen upon to-day, That, Indra, all is in thy power.

verses.sa:
य आनयत्परावतः सुनीती तुर्वशं यदुं |
इन्द्रः स नो युवा सखा ॥
verses.rom:
ya anayatparavatah suniti turvasham yadum |
indrah sa no yuva sakha ||
verses.en: That Indra is our youthful friend, who with his trusty guidanceled Turvasa, Yadu from afar.

verses.sa:
मा न इन्द्राभ्याऽऽ३ दिशः सूरो अक्तुष्वा यमत |
त्वा युजा वनेम तत् ॥
verses.rom:
ma na indrabhya''3 dishah suro aktushva yamata |
tva yuja vanema tat ||
verses.en: O Indra, let not ill designs surround us in the sunbeams' light This may we gain with thee for friend!

verses.sa:
एन्द्र सानसिं रयिं सजित्वानं सदासहं |
वर्षिष्ठमूतये भर ॥
verses.rom:
endra sanasim rayim sajitvanam sadasaham |
varshishthamutaye bhara ||
verses.en: Indra, bring wealth that gives delight, the victor's ever-conquering wealth, Most excellent, to be our aid

verses.sa:
इन्द्रं वयं महाधन इन्द्रमर्भे हवामहे |
युजं वृत्रेषु वज्रिणं ॥
verses.rom:
indram vayam mahadhana indramarbhe havamahe |
yujam vritreshu vajrinam ||
verses.en: In mighty battle we invoke Indra, Indra is lesser fight, The friend who bends his bolt at fiends.

verses.sa:
अपिबत्कद्रुवः सुतमिन्द्रः सहस्रबाह्वे |
तत्राददिष्ट प्ॐस्यं ॥
verses.rom:
apibatkadruvah sutamindrah sahasrabahve |
tatradadishta pomsyam ||
verses.en: In battle of a thousand arms Indra drank Kadru's Soma juice There he displayed his manly might.

verses.sa:
वयमिन्द्र त्वायवोऽभि प्र नोनुमो वृषन् |
विद्धी त्वा३स्य नो वसो ॥
verses.rom:
vayamindra tvayavo'bhi pra nonumo vrishan |
viddhi tva3sya no vaso ||
verses.en: Faithful to thee, we sing aloud, heroic Indra, songs to thee Mark, O good Lord, this act of ours!

verses.sa:
आ घा ये अग्निमिन्धते स्तृणन्ति बर्हिरानुषक् |
येषामिन्द्रो युवा सखा ॥
verses.rom:
a gha ye agnimindhate strinanti barhiranushak |
yeshamindro yuva sakha ||
verses.en: Hitherward! they who light the flame and straightway trim the sacred grass, Whose friend is Indra ever young.

verses.sa:
भिन्धि विश्वा अप द्विषः परि बाधो जही मृधः |
वसु स्पार्हं तदा भर ॥
verses.rom:
bhindhi vishva apa dvishah pari badho jahi mridhah |
vasu sparham tada bhara ||
verses.en: Drive all our enemies away, smite down the foes who press around, And bring the wealth for which we long!

verses.sa: इहेव शृण्व एषां कशा हस्तेषु यद्वदान् |नि यामं चित्रमृञ्जते ॥
verses.rom: iheva shrinva esham kasha hasteshu yadvadan |ni yamam chitramrinjate ||
verses.en: I Hear, as though 'twere close at hand, the cracking of the whips they hold: They gather splendour on their way.

verses.sa: इम उ त्वा वि चक्षते सखाय इन्द्र सोमिनः |पुष्टावन्तो यथा पशुं ॥
verses.rom: ima u tva vi chakshate sakhaya indra sominah |pushtavanto yatha pashum ||
verses.en: Indra, these friends of ours, supplied with Soma, wait and look to thee As men with fodder to the herd.

verses.sa: समस्य मन्यवे विशो विश्वा नमन्त कृष्टयः |समुद्रायेव सिन्धवः ॥
verses.rom: samasya manyave visho vishva namanta krishtayah |samudrayeva sindhavah ||
verses.en: Before his hot displeasure all the peoples, all the men bow down, As rivers bow them to the sea.

verses.sa: देवानामिदवो महत्तदा वृणीमहे वयं |वृष्णामस्मभ्यमूतये ॥
verses.rom: devanamidavo mahattada vrinimahe vayam |vrishnamasmabhyamutaye ||
verses.en: We choose unto ourselves that high protection of the mighty Gods, That it may help and succour us.

verses.sa: सोमानां स्वरणं कृणुहि ब्रह्मणस्पते |कक्षीवन्तं य औशिजः ॥
verses.rom: somanam svaranam krinuhi brahmanaspate |kakshivantam ya aushijah ||
verses.en: O Brahmanaspati, make thou Kakshivan Ausija a loud Chanter of flowing Soma juice!

verses.sa: बोधन्मना इदस्तु नो वृत्रहा भूर्यासुतिः |शृणोतु शक्र आशिषं ॥
verses.rom: bodhanmana idastu no vritraha bhuryasutih |shrinotu shakra ashisham ||
verses.en: Much honoured with libations may the Vritra-slayer watch for us: May Sakra listen to our prayer

verses.sa: अद्य नो देव सवितः प्रजावत्सावीः सौभगं |परा दुःष्वप्न्यं सुव ॥
verses.rom: adya no deva savitah prajavatsavih saubhagam |para duhshvapnyam suva ||
verses.en: Send us this day, God Savitar, prosperity with progeny Drive thou the evil dream away!

verses.sa: क्वा३स्य वृषभो युवा तुविग्रीवो अनानतः |ब्रह्मा कस्तं सपर्यति ॥
verses.rom: kva3sya vrishabho yuva tuvigrivo ananatah |brahma kastam saparyati ||
verses.en: Where is that ever-youthful Steer, strong-necked and never yet bent down? What Brahman ministers to him?

verses.sa: उपह्वरे गिरीणां सङ्गमे च नदीनां |धिया विप्रो अजायत ॥
verses.rom: upahvare girinam sangame cha nadinam |dhiya vipro ajayata ||
verses.en: There where the mountains downward slope, there at the meeting of the streams The Sage was manifest by song.

verses.sa: प्र सम्राजं चर्षणीनामिन्द्रं स्तोता नव्यं गीर्भिः |नरं नृषाहं मंहिष्ठं ॥
verses.rom: pra samrajam charshaninamindram stota navyam girbhih |naram nrishaham mamhishtham ||
verses.en: Praise Indra whom our songs must laud, sole sovran of mankind, the chief Most liberal who controlleth men

verses.sa:
अपादु शिप्रयन्धसः सुदक्षस्य प्रहोषिणः ।
इन्द्रोरिन्द्रो यवाशिरः ॥
verses.rom:
apadu shiprayandhasah sudakshasya prahoshinah |
indrorindro yavashirah ||
verses.en: Indra whose jaws are strong hath drunk of worshipping Sudaksha's draught, The Soma juice with barley brew.

verses.sa:
इमा उ त्वा पुरुवसोऽभि प्र नोनवुर्गिरः ।
गावो वत्सं न धेनवः ॥
verses.rom:
ima u tva puruvaso'bhi pra nonavurgirah |
gavo vatsam na dhenavah ||
verses.en: O Lord of ample wealth, these songs of praise have called aloud to thee, Like milch-kine lowing to their calves!

verses.sa:
अत्राह गोरमन्वत नाम त्वष्टुरपीच्यं ।
इत्था चन्द्रमसो गृहे ॥
verses.rom:
atraha goramanvata nama tvashturapichyam |
ittha chandramaso grihe ||
verses.en: Then straight they recognized the mystic name of the creative Steer, There in the mansion of the Moon.

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्रो अनयद्रितो महीरपो वृषन्तमः ।
तत्र पूषाभुवत्सचा ॥
verses.rom:
yadindro anayadrito mahirapo vrishantamah |
tatra pushabhuvatsacha ||
verses.en: When Indra, strongest hero, brought the streams, the mighty waters down, Pushan was standing by his side.

verses.sa:
गौर्धयति मरुतां श्रवस्युर्माता मघोनाम्
युक्ता वह्नी रथानां ॥
verses.rom:
gaurdhayati marutam shravasyurmata maghonam
yukta vahni rathanam ||
verses.en: The Cow, the streaming mother of the liberal Maruts, pours her milk, Harnessed to draw their chariots on.

verses.sa:
उप नो हरिभिः सुतं याहि मदानां पते ।
उप नो हरिभिः सुतं ॥
verses.rom:
upa no haribhih sutam yahi madanam pate |
upa no haribhih sutam ||
verses.en: Come, Lord of rapturous joys, to our libation with thy bay steeds, come With bay steeds to the flowing juice

verses.sa:
इष्टा होत्रा असृक्षतेन्द्रं वृधन्तो अध्वरे ।
अच्छावभृथमोजसा ॥
verses.rom:
ishta hotra asrikshatendram vridhanto adhvare |
achchhavabhrithamojasa ||
verses.en: Presented strengthening gifts have sent Indra away at sacrifice, With night, unto the cleansing bath.

verses.sa:
अहमिद्धि पितुष्परि मेधामृतस्य जग्रह ।
अहं सूर्य इवाजनि ॥
verses.rom:
ahamiddhi pitushpari medhamritasya jagraha |
aham surya ivajani ||
verses.en: I from my Father have received deep knowledge of eternal Law: I was born like unto the Sun.

verses.sa:
रेवतीर्नः सधमाद इन्द्रे सन्तु तुविवाजाः ।
क्षुमन्तो याभिर्मदेम ॥
verses.rom:
revatirnah sadhamada indre santu tuvivajah |
kshumanto yabhirmadema ||
verses.en: With Indra splendid feasts be ours, rich in all strengthening things, wherewith, Wealthy in food, we may rejoice

verses.sa:
सोमः पूषा च चेततुर्विश्वासां सुक्षितीनां ।
देवत्रा रथ्योर्हिता ॥
verses.rom:
somah pusha cha chetaturvishvasam sukshitinam |
devatra rathyorhita ||
verses.en: Soma and Pushan, kind to him who travels to the Gods, provide Dwellings all happy and secure.

verses.sa:
पान्तमा वो अन्धस इन्द्रमभि प्र गायत ।
विश्वासाहं शतक्रतुं मंहिष्ठं चर्षणीनां ॥
verses.rom:
pantama vo andhasa indramabhi pra gayata |
vishvasaham shatakratum mamhishtham charshaninam ||
verses.en: Invite ye Indra with a song to drink your draught of Soma steeds, juice, All-conquering Satakratu, most munificent of all who live

verses.sa:
प्र व इन्द्राय मादनं हर्यश्वाय गायत ।
सखायः सोमपाव्ने ॥
verses.rom:
pra va indraya madanam haryashvaya gayata |
sakhayah somapavne ||
verses.en: Sing ye a song, to make him glad, to Indra, Lord of tawny The Soma-drinker, O my friends!

verses.sa:
वयमु त्वा तदिदर्था इन्द्र त्वायन्तः सखायः ।
कण्वा उक्थेभिर्जरन्ते ॥
verses.rom:
vayamu tva tadidartha indra tvayantah sakhayah |
kanva ukthebhirjarante ||
verses.en: This, even this, O Indra, we implore: as thy devoted friends The Kanvas praise thee with their hymns!

verses.sa:
इन्द्राय मद्वने सुतं परि ष्टोभन्तु नो गिरः ।
अर्कमर्चन्तु कारवः ॥
verses.rom:
indraya madvane sutam pari shtobhantu no girah |
arkamarchantu karavah ||
verses.en: For Indra, lover of carouse, loud be our songs about the juice Let poets sing the song of praise.

verses.sa:
अयं त इन्द्र सोमो निपूतो अधि बर्हिषि ।
एहीमस्य द्रवा पिब ॥
verses.rom:
ayam ta indra somo niputo adhi barhishi |
ehimasya drava piba ||
verses.en: Here, Indra, is thy Soma draught, made pure upon the sacred grass: Run hither, come and drink thereof

verses.sa:
सुरूपकृत्नुमूतये सुदुघामिव गोदुहे ।
जुहूमसि द्यविद्यवि ॥
verses.rom:
surupakritnumutaye sudughamiva goduhe |
juhumasi dyavidyavi ||
verses.en: As a good cow to him who milks, we call the doer of good deeds To our assistance duy by day.

verses.sa:
(आरण्यकम्)
अभि त्वा वृषभा सुते सुतं सृजामि पीतये ।
तृम्पा व्यश्नुही मदं ॥
verses.rom:
(aranyakam)
abhi tva vrishabha sute sutam srijami pitaye |
trimpa vyashnuhi madam ||
verses.en: Hero, the Soma being shed, I pour the juice for thee to drink Sate thee and finish thy carouse!

verses.sa:
य इन्द्र चमसेष्वा सोमश्चमूषु ते सुतः ।
पिबेदस्य त्वमीशिषे ॥
verses.rom:
ya indra chamaseshva somashchamushu te sutah |
pibedasya tvamishishe ||
verses.en: The Soma, Indra, which is shed in saucers and in cups for thee, Drink thou, for thou art lord thereof!

verses.sa:
योगेयोगे तवस्तरं वाजेवाजे हवामहे ।
सखाय इन्द्रमूतये ॥
verses.rom:
yogeyoge tavastaram vajevaje havamahe |
sakhaya indramutaye ||
verses.en: In every need, in every fray we call, as friends, to succour us, Indra, the mightiest of all.

verses.sa:
आ त्वेता नि षीदतेन्द्रमभि प्र गायत ।
सखायः स्तोमवाहसः ॥
verses.rom:
a tveta ni shidatendramabhi pra gayata |
sakhayah stomavahasah ||
verses.en: O come ye hither, sit ye down: to Indra sing ye forth your song, Companions, bringing hymns of praise

verses.sa:
इदं ह्यन्वोजसा सुतं राधानां पते ।
पिबा त्वा३स्य गिर्वणः ॥
verses.rom:
idam hyanvojasa sutam radhanam pate |
piba tva3sya girvanah ||
verses.en: So, Lord of affluent gifts, this juice hath been expressed for thee with strength: Drink of it, thou who lovest song!

verses.sa:
महां इन्द्रः पुरश्च नो महित्वमस्तु वज्रिणे ।
द्यौर्न प्रथिना शवः ॥
verses.rom:
maham indrah purashcha no mahitvamastu vajrine |
dyaurna prathina shavah ||
verses.en: Great is our Indra from of old; greatness be his, the Thunderer Wide as the heaven extends his might.

verses.sa:
आ तू न इन्द्र क्षुमन्तं चित्रं ग्राभं सं गृभाय ।
महाहस्ती दक्षिणेन ॥
verses.rom:
a tu na indra kshumantam chitram grabham sam gribhaya |
mahahasti dakshinena ||
verses.en: Indra, as one with mighty arm, gather for us with thy right hand Manifold and nutritious spoil!

verses.sa:
अभि प्र गोपतिं गिरेन्द्रमर्च यथा विदे ।
सूनुं सत्यस्य सत्पतिं ॥
verses.rom:
abhi pra gopatim girendramarcha yatha vide |
sunum satyasya satpatim ||
verses.en: Praise, even as he is known, with song Indra the guardian of the kine, The Son of Truth, Lord of the brave.

verses.sa:
कया नश्चित्र आ भुवदूती सदावृधः सखा ।
कया शचिष्ठया वृता ॥
verses.rom:
kaya nashchitra a bhuvaduti sadavridhah sakha |
kaya shachishthaya vrita ||
verses.en: With what help will he come to us, wonderful, ever-waxing friend? With what most mighty company?

verses.sa:
त्यमु वः सत्रासाहं विश्वासु गीर्ष्वायतं ।
आ च्यावयस्यूतये ॥
verses.rom:
tyamu vah satrasaham vishvasu girshvayatam |
a chyavayasyutaye ||
verses.en: Thou speedest down to succour us this ever-conquering God of yours Him who is drawn to all our songs.

verses.sa:
सदसस्पतिमद्भुतं प्रियमिन्द्रस्य काम्यं ।
सनिं मेधामयासिषं ॥
verses.rom:
sadasaspatimadbhutam priyamindrasya kamyam |
sanim medhamayasisham ||
verses.en: To the assembly's wondrous Lord, the lovely friend of Indra, I Had prayed for wisdom and successs.

verses.sa:
ये ते पन्था अधो दिवो येभिर्व्यश्वमैरयः ।
उत श्रोषन्तु नो भुवः ॥
verses.rom:
ye te pantha adho divo yebhirvyashvamairayah |
uta shroshantu no bhuvah ||
verses.en: May all thy paths beneath the sky whereby thou speddest Vyasva on, Yea, let all spaces hear our voice

verses.sa:
भद्रंभद्रं न आ भरेषमूर्जं शतक्रतो ।
यदिन्द्र मृडयासि नः ॥
verses.rom:
bhadrambhadram na a bhareshamurjam shatakrato |
yadindra mridayasi nah ||
verses.en: Bring to us all things excellent, O Satakratu, food and strength, For, Indra, thou art kind to us!

verses.sa:
अस्ति सोमो अयं सुतः पिबन्त्यस्य मरुतः ।
उत स्वराजो अश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
asti somo ayam sutah pibantyasya marutah |
uta svarajo ashvina ||
verses.en: Here is the Soma ready pressed: of this the Maruts, yea, of this, Self-luminous the Asvins drink.

verses.sa:
ईङ्खयन्तीरपस्युव इन्द्रं जातमुपासते ।
वन्वानासः सुवीर्यं ॥
verses.rom:
inkhayantirapasyuva indram jatamupasate |
vanvanasah suviryam ||
verses.en: Tossing about, the active ones came nigh to Indra at his birth, Winning themselves heroic might.

verses.sa:
न कि देवा इनीमसि न क्या योपयामसि ।
मन्त्रश्रुत्यं चरामसि ॥
verses.rom:
na ki deva inimasi na kya yopayamasi |
mantrashrutyam charamasi ||
verses.en: Never, O Gods, do we offend, nor are we ever obstinate We walk as holy texts command.

verses.sa:
दोषो आगाद्बृहद्गाय द्युमद्गामन्नाथर्वण ।
स्तुहि देवं सवितारं ॥
verses.rom:
dosho agadbrihadgaya dyumadgamannatharvana |
stuhi devam savitaram ||
verses.en: Evening is come: sing loudly thou Atharvan's nobly singing son: Give praise to Savitar the God!

verses.sa:
एषो उषा अपूर्व्या व्युच्छति प्रिया दिवः ।
स्तुषे वामश्विना बृहत् ॥
verses.rom:
esho usha apurvya vyuchchhati priya divah |
stushe vamashvina brihat ||
verses.en: Now Morning with her earliest light shines forth, dear daughter of the Sky: High, Asvins, I extol your praise.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो दधीचो अस्थभिर्वृत्राण्यप्रतिष्कुतः ।
जघान नवतीर्नव ॥
verses.rom:
indro dadhicho asthabhirvritranyapratishkutah |
jaghana navatirnava ||
verses.en: Armed with the bones of dead Dadhyach, Indra, with unresisted might The nine-and-ninety Vritras slew.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रेहि मत्स्यन्धसो विश्वेभिः सोमपर्वभिः ।
महां अभिष्टिरोजसा ॥
verses.rom:
indrehi matsyandhaso vishvebhih somaparvabhih |
maham abhishtirojasa ||
verses.en: Come, Indra, and delight thee with the juice at all our Soma feasts, Protector, mighty in thy strength

verses.sa:
आ तू न इन्द्र वृत्रहन्नस्माकमर्धमा गहि ।
महान्महीभिरूतिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
a tu na indra vritrahannasmakamardhama gahi |
mahanmahibhirutibhih ||
verses.en: O thou who slayest Vritras, come, O Indra, hither to our side, Mighty one, with thy mighty aids!

verses.sa:
ओजस्तदस्य तित्विष उभे यत्समवर्तयत् ।
इन्द्रश्चर्मेव रोदसी ॥
verses.rom:
ojastadasya titvisha ubhe yatsamavartayat |
indrashcharmeva rodasi ||
verses.en: That might of his shone brightly forth when Indra brought together, like A skin, the worlds of heaven and earth,

verses.sa:
अयमु ते समतसि कपोत इव गर्भधिं ।
वचस्तच्चिन्न ओहसे ॥
verses.rom:
ayamu te samatasi kapota iva garbhadhim |
vachastachchinna ohase ||
verses.en: This is thine own Thou drawest near, as turns a pigeon to his mate: Thou carest, too, for this our prayer.

verses.sa:
वात आ वातु भेषजं शम्भु मयोभु नो हृदे ।
प्र न आयूंषि तारिषत् ॥
verses.rom:
vata a vatu bheshajam shambhu mayobhu no hride |
pra na ayumshi tarishat ||
verses.en: May Vata breathe his balm on us, healthful, delightful to our heart: May he prolong our days of life

verses.sa:
यं रक्षन्ति प्रचेतसो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा ।
न किः स दभ्यते जनः ॥
verses.rom:
yam rakshanti prachetaso varuno mitro aryama |
na kih sa dabhyate janah ||
verses.en: Ne'er is he injured whom the Gods Varuna, Mitra, Aryam. The excellently wise, protect.

verses.sa:
णो यथा पुराश्वयोत रथया ।
वरिवस्या महोनां ॥
verses.rom:
no yatha purashvayota rathaya |
varivasya mahonam ||
verses.en: According to our wish for kine, for steeds and chariots, as of old, Be gracious to our wealthy chiefs

verses.sa:
इमास्त इन्द्र पृश्नयो घृतं दुहत आशिरं ।
एनामृतस्य पिप्युषीः ॥
verses.rom:
imasta indra prishnayo ghritam duhata ashiram |
enamritasya pipyushih ||
verses.en: Indra, these spotted cows yield thee their butter and the milky draught, Aiders, thereby, of sacrifice.

verses.sa:
अया धिया च गव्यया पुरुणामन्पुरुष्टुत ।
यत्सोमेसोम आभुवः ॥
verses.rom:
aya dhiya cha gavyaya purunamanpurushtuta |
yatsomesoma abhuvah ||
verses.en: That thou much-lauded! many-named! mayst, with this thought, that longs for milk, Come to each Soma sacrifice.

verses.sa:
पावका नः सरस्वती वाजेभिर्वाजिनीवती ।
यज्ञं वष्टु धियावसुः ॥
verses.rom:
pavaka nah sarasvati vajebhirvajinivati |
yajnam vashtu dhiyavasuh ||
verses.en: May bright Sarasvati, endowed with plenteous wealth and spoil, enriched With prayer, desire the sacrifice.

verses.sa:
क इमं नाहुषीष्वा इन्द्रं सोमस्य तर्पयात् ।
स नो वसून्या भरात् ॥
verses.rom:
ka imam nahushishva indram somasya tarpayat |
sa no vasunya bharat ||
verses.en: Why 'mid the Nahusha tribes shall sate this Indra with his Soma juice? He shall bring precious things to us.

verses.sa:
आ याहि सुषुमा हि त इन्द्र सोमं पिबा इमं ।
एदं बर्हिः सदो मम ॥
verses.rom:
a yahi sushuma hi ta indra somam piba imam |
edam barhih sado mama ||
verses.en: Come, we have pressed the juice for thee; O Indra, drink this Soma here: Sit thou on this my sacred grass

verses.sa:
महि त्रीणामवरस्तु द्युक्षं मित्रस्यार्यम्णः ।
दुराधर्षं वरुणस्य ॥
verses.rom:
mahi trinamavarastu dyuksham mitrasyaryamnah |
duradharsham varunasya ||
verses.en: Great, unassailable must be the heavenly favour of the Three, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman.

verses.sa:
त्वावतः पुरूवसो वयमिन्द्र प्रणेतः ।
स्मसि स्थातर्हरीणां ॥
verses.rom:
tvavatah puruvaso vayamindra pranetah |
smasi sthatarharinam ||
verses.en: We, Indra, Lord of ample wealth, our guide, depend on one like thee, Thou driver of the tawny steeds!

verses.sa:
उत्त्वा मन्दन्तु सोमाः कृणुष्व राधो अद्रिवः ।
अव ब्रह्मद्विषो जहि ॥
verses.rom:
uttva mandantu somah krinushva radho adrivah |
ava brahmadvisho jahi ||
verses.en: Let Soma juices make thee glad! Display thy bounty, Thunderer: Drive off the enemies of prayer!

verses.sa:
गिर्वणः पाहि नः सुतं मधोर्धाराभिरज्यसे ।
इन्द्र त्वादातमिद्यशः ॥
verses.rom:
girvanah pahi nah sutam madhordharabhirajyase |
indra tvadatamidyashah ||
verses.en: Drink our libation, Lord of hymns! with streams of meath thou art bedewed: Yea, Indra, glory is thy gift.

verses.sa:
सदा व इन्द्रश्चर्कृषदा उपो नु स सपर्यन् ।
न देवो वृतः शूर इन्द्रः ॥
verses.rom:
sada va indrashcharkrishada upo nu sa saparyan |
na devo vritah shura indrah ||
verses.en: Indra hath ever thought of you and tended you with care. The God, Heroic Indra, is not checked.

verses.sa:
आ त्वा विशन्त्विन्दवः समुद्रमिव सिन्धवः ।
न त्वामिन्द्राति रिच्यते ॥
verses.rom:
a tva vishantvindavah samudramiva sindhavah |
na tvamindrati richyate ||
verses.en: Let the drops pass within thee as the rivers flow into the sea O Indra, naught excelleth thee!

verses.sa:
इन्द्रमिद्गाथिनो बृहदिन्द्रमर्केभिरर्किणः ।
इन्द्रं वाणीरनूषत ॥
verses.rom:
indramidgathino brihadindramarkebhirarkinah |
indram vaniranushata ||
verses.en: Indra, the singers with high praise, Indra reciters with their lauds, Indra the choirs have glorified.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र इषे ददातु न ऋभुक्षणमृभुं रयिं ।
वाजी ददातु वाजिनं ॥
verses.rom:
indra ishe dadatu na ribhukshanamribhum rayim |
vaji dadatu vajinam ||
verses.en: May Indra give, to aid us wealth handy that rules the skilful ones! Yea, may the Strong give potent wealth

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो अङ्ग महद्भयमभी षदप चुच्यवत् ।
स हि स्थिरो विचर्षणिः ॥
verses.rom:
indro anga mahadbhayamabhi shadapa chuchyavat |
sa hi sthiro vicharshanih ||
verses.en: Verily Indra, conquering all, drives even mighty fear away, For firm is he and swift to act.

verses.sa:
इमा उ त्वा सुतेसुते नक्षन्ते गिर्वणो गिरः ।
गावो वत्सं न धेनवः ॥
verses.rom:
ima u tva sutesute nakshante girvano girah |
gavo vatsam na dhenavah ||
verses.en: These songs with every draught we pour come, lover of the song, to thee As milch-kine hasten to their calves.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रा नु पूषणा वयं सख्याय स्वस्तये ।
हुवेम वाजसातये ॥
verses.rom:
indra nu pushana vayam sakhyaya svastaye |
huvema vajasataye ||
verses.en: Indra and Wishan will we call for friendship and prosperity, And for the winning of the spoil.

verses.sa:
पौषम्
न कि इन्द्र त्वदुत्तरं न ज्यायो अस्ति वृत्रहन् ।
न क्येवं यथा त्वं ॥
verses.rom:
pausham
na ki indra tvaduttaram na jyayo asti vritrahan |
na kyevam yatha tvam ||
verses.en: O Indra, Vritra-slayer, naught is better, mightier than thou Verily there is none like thee!

verses.sa:
तरणिं वो जनानां त्रदं वाजस्य गोमतः ।
समानमु प्र शंसिषं ॥
verses.rom:
taranim vo jananam tradam vajasya gomatah |
samanamu pra shamsisham ||
verses.en: Him have I magnified, our Lord in common, guardian of your folk, Discloser of great wealth in kine.

verses.sa:
असृग्रमिन्द्र ते गिरः प्रति त्वामुदहासत ।
सजोषा वृषभं पतिं ॥
verses.rom:
asrigramindra te girah prati tvamudahasata |
sajosha vrishabham patim ||
verses.en: Songs have outpoured themselves to thee, Indra, the strong, the guardian Lord, And with one will have risen to thee!

verses.sa:
सुनीथो घा स मर्त्यो यं मरुतो यमर्यमा ।
मित्रास्पान्त्यद्रुहः ॥
verses.rom:
sunitho gha sa martyo yam maruto yamaryama |
mitraspantyadruhah ||
verses.en: Good guidance hath the mortal man whom Arya-man, the Marut host, And Mitras, void of guile, protect.

verses.sa:
यद्वीडाविन्द्र यत्स्थिरे यत्पर्शाने पराभृतं ।
वसु स्पार्हं तदा भर ॥
verses.rom:
yadvidavindra yatsthire yatparshane parabhritam |
vasu sparham tada bhara ||
verses.en: Bring us the wealth for which we long, O Indra, that which is concealed In strong firm place precipitous.

verses.sa:
श्रुतं वो वृत्रहन्तमं प्र शर्धं चर्षणीनां ।
आशिषे राधसे महे ॥
verses.rom:
shrutam vo vritrahantamam pra shardham charshaninam |
ashishe radhase mahe ||
verses.en: Him your best Vritra-slayer, him the famous champion of mankind I urge to great munificence.

verses.sa:
अरं त इन्द्र श्रवसे गमेम शूर त्वावतः ।
अरं शक्र परेमणि ॥
verses.rom:
aram ta indra shravase gamema shura tvavatah |
aram shakra paremani ||
verses.en: Indra, may we adorn thy fame, fame of one like thee, hero! deck, Sakra! thy fame at highest feast!

verses.sa:
धानावन्तं करम्भिणमपूपवन्तमुक्थिनं ।
इन्द्र प्रातर्जुषस्व नः ॥
verses.rom:
dhanavantam karambhinamapupavantamukthinam |
indra pratarjushasva nah ||
verses.en: Indra, accept at break of day our Soma mixt with roasted corn, With groats, with cake, with eulogies!

verses.sa:
अपां फेनेन नमुचेः शिर इन्द्रोदवर्तयः ।
विश्वा यदजय स्पृधः ॥
verses.rom:
apam phenena namucheh shira indrodavartayah |
vishva yadajaya spridhah ||
verses.en: With waters' foam thou torest off, Indra, the head of Namuchi, When thou o'ercamest all the foes.

verses.sa:
इमे त इन्द्र सोमाः सुतासो ये च सोत्वाः ।
तेषां मत्स्व प्रभूवसो ॥
verses.rom:
ime ta indra somah sutaso ye cha sotvah |
tesham matsva prabhuvaso ||
verses.en: Thine are these Soma juices, thine, Indra, those still to be expressed: Enjoy them, Lord of princely wealth!

verses.sa:
तुभ्यं सुतासः सोमाः स्तीर्णं बर्हिर्विभावसो ।
स्तोतृभ्य इन्द्र मृडय ॥
verses.rom:
tubhyam sutasah somah stirnam barhirvibhavaso |
stotribhya indra mridaya ||
verses.en: For thee, O Indra, Lord of light, Somas are pressed and grass is strewn: Be gracious to thy worshippers!

verses.sa:
आ व इन्द्रं कृविं यथा वाजयन्तः शतक्रतुं ।
मंहिष्ठं सिञ्च इन्दुभिः ॥
verses.rom:
a va indram krivim yatha vajayantah shatakratum |
mamhishtham sincha indubhih ||
verses.en: We seeking strength, with Soma drops fill full your Indra like a well, Most liberal, Lord of boundless might.

verses.sa:
अतश्चिदिन्द्र न उपा याहि शतवाजया ।
इषा सहस्रवाजया ॥
verses.rom:
atashchidindra na upa yahi shatavajaya |
isha sahasravajaya ||
verses.en: O Indra, even from that place come unto us with food that gives A hundred, yea, a thousand powers!

verses.sa:
आ बुन्दं वृत्रहा ददे जातः पृच्छद्वि मातरं ।
क उग्राः के ह शृण्विरे ॥
verses.rom:
a bundam vritraha dade jatah prichchhadvi mataram |
ka ugrah ke ha shrinvire ||
verses.en: The new-born Vritra-slayer asked his mother, as he seized his shaft, Who are the, fierce and famous ones?

verses.sa:
बृबदुक्थं हवामहे सृप्रकरस्नमूतये ।
साधः कृण्वन्तमवसे ॥
verses.rom:
bribaduktham havamahe sriprakarasnamutaye |
sadhah krinvantamavase ||
verses.en: Let us call him to aid whose hands stretch far, the highly-lauded, who Fulfils the work to favour us

verses.sa:
ऋजुनीती नो वरुणो मित्रो नयति विद्वान् ।
अर्यमा देवैः सजोषाः ॥
verses.rom:
rijuniti no varuno mitro nayati vidvan |
aryama devaih sajoshah ||
verses.en: Mitra who knoweth leadeth us, and Varuna who guideth straight, And Aryaman in accord with Gods.

verses.sa:
दूरादिहेव यत्सतोऽरुणप्सुरशिश्वितत् ।
वि भानुं विश्वथातनत् ॥
verses.rom:
duradiheva yatsato'runapsurashishvitat |
vi bhanum vishvathatanat ||
verses.en: When, even as she were present here, red Dawn hath shone from far away, She spreadeth light on every side.

verses.sa:
आ नो मित्रावरुणा घृतैर्गव्यूतिमुक्षतं ।
मध्वा रजांसि सुक्रतू ॥
verses.rom:
a no mitravaruna ghritairgavyutimukshatam |
madhva rajamsi sukratu ||
verses.en: Varuna, Mitra, sapient pair, pour fatness on our pastures, pour Meath on the regions of the air!

verses.sa:
उदु त्ये सूनवो गिरः काष्ठा यज्ञेष्वत्नत ।
वाश्रा अभिज्ञु यातवे ॥
verses.rom:
udu tye sunavo girah kashtha yajneshvatnata |
vashra abhijnu yatave ||
verses.en: And, at our sacrifices, these, sons, singers, have enlarged their bounds, So that the cows must walk knee-deep.

verses.sa:
इदं विष्णुर्वि चक्रमे त्रेधा नि दधे पदं ।
समूढमस्य पांसुले ॥
verses.rom:
idam vishnurvi chakrame tredha ni dadhe padam |
samudhamasya pamsule ||
verses.en: Through all this world strode Vishnu: thrice his foot he planted, and the whole Was gathered in his footstep's dust.

verses.sa:
अतीहि मन्युषाविणं सुषुवांसमुपेरय ।
अस्य रातौ सुतं पिब ॥
verses.rom:
atihi manyushavinam sushuvamsamuperaya |
asya ratau sutam piba ||

verses.sa:
कदु प्रचेतसे महे वचो देवाय शस्यते ।
तदिध्यस्य वर्धनं ॥
verses.rom:
kadu prachetase mahe vacho devaya shasyate |
tadidhyasya vardhanam ||

verses.sa:
उक्थं च न शस्यमानं नागो रयिरा चिकेत ।
न गायत्रं गीयमानं ॥
verses.rom:
uktham cha na shasyamanam nago rayira chiketa |
na gayatram giyamanam ||

verses.sa:
इन्द्र उक्थेभिर्मन्दिष्ठो वाजानां च वाजपतिः ।
हरिवान्त्सुतानां सखा ॥
verses.rom:
indra ukthebhirmandishtho vajanam cha vajapatih |
harivantsutanam sakha ||

verses.sa:
आ याह्युप नः सुतं वाजेभिर्मा हृणीयथाः ।
महां इव युवजानिः ॥
verses.rom:
a yahyupa nah sutam vajebhirma hriniyathah |
maham iva yuvajanih ||

verses.sa:
कदा वसो स्तोत्रं हर्यत आ अव श्मशा रुधद्वाः ।
दीर्घं सुतं वाताप्याय ॥
verses.rom:
kada vaso stotram haryata a ava shmasha rudhadvah |
dirgham sutam vatapyaya ||

verses.sa:
ब्राह्मणादिन्द्र राधसः पिबा सोममृतूँरनु ।
तवेदं सख्यमस्तृतं ॥
verses.rom:
brahmanadindra radhasah piba somamritunranu |
tavedam sakhyamastritam ||

verses.sa:
वयं घा ते अपि स्मसि स्तोतार इन्द्र गिर्वणः ।
त्वं नो जिन्व सोमपाः ॥
verses.rom:
vayam gha te api smasi stotara indra girvanah |
tvam no jinva somapah ||

verses.sa:
एन्द्र पृक्षु कासु चिन्नृम्णं तनूषु धेहि नः ।
सत्राजिदुग्र पौंस्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
endra prikshu kasu chinnrimnam tanushu dhehi nah |
satrajidugra paumsyam ||

verses.sa:
एवा ह्यसि वीरयुरेवा शूर उत स्थिरः ।
एवा ते राध्यं मनः ॥
verses.rom:
eva hyasi virayureva shura uta sthirah |
eva te radhyam manah ||

prose.en:
Pass by the wrathful offerer; speed the man who pours libation, drink The juice which he presents to thee!

What is the word addressed to him, God great and excellently wise? For this is what exalteth him.

His wealth who hath no store of kine hath ne'er found out recited laud, Nor song of praises that is sung.

Lord of each thing that giveth strength, Indra delighteth most in lauds, Borne by bay steeds, libations' friend.

With wealth to our libation come, be not thou angry with us, like A great man with a youthful bride.

When, Vasu, wilt thou love the laud? Now let the Channel bring the stream. The juice is ready to ferment.

After the Seasons. Indra, drink the Soma from the Brahman's gift: Thy friendship is invincible! S. O Indra, lover of the song, we are the singers of thy praise O Soma-drinker, quicken us!

O Indra, in each fight and fray give to our bodies manly strength: Strong Lord, grant ever-conquering might!

For so thou art the brave man's friend; a hero, too, art thou, and strong: So may thine heart be won to us!

verses.sa:
अभि त्वा शूर नोनुमोऽदुग्धा इव धेनवः ।
ईशानमस्य जगतः स्वर्दृशमीशानमिन्द्र तस्थुषः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi tva shura nonumo'dugdha iva dhenavah |
ishanamasya jagatah svardrishamishanamindra tasthushah ||
verses.en: Like kine unmilked we call aloud, hero, to thee, and sing thy praise, Looker on heavenly light, Lord of this moving world, Lord, Indra, of what moveth not!

verses.sa:
त्वामिद्धि हवामहे सातौ वाजस्य कारवः।
त्वां वृत्रेष्विन्द्र सत्पतिं नरस्त्वां काष्ठास्वर्वतः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamiddhi havamahe satau vajasya karavah|
tvam vritreshvindra satpatim narastvam kashthasvarvatah ||
verses.en: That we may win us wealth and power we poets, verily, call on thee: In war men call on thee, Indra, the hero's Lord, in the steed's race-course call on thee:

verses.sa:
अभि प्र वः सुराधसमिन्द्रमर्च यथा विदे ।
यो जरितृभ्यो मघवा पुरूवसुः सहस्रेणेव शिक्षति ॥
verses.rom:
abhi pra vah suradhasamindramarcha yatha vide |
yo jaritribhyo maghava puruvasuh sahasreneva shikshati ||
verses.en: To you will I sing Indra's praise who gives good gifts as well we know; The praise of Maghavan who, rich in treasure, aids his singers with wealth thousandfold.

verses.sa:
तं वो दस्ममृतीषहं वसोर्मन्दानमन्धसः ।
अभि वत्सं न स्वसरेषु धेनव इन्द्रं गीर्भिर्नवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
tam vo dasmamritishaham vasormandanamandhasah |
abhi vatsam na svasareshu dhenava indram girbhirnavamahe ||
verses.en: As cows low to their calves in stalls, so with our songs we glorify This Indra, even your wondrous God who checks attack, who takes delight in precious juice.

verses.sa:
तरोभिर्वो विदद्वसुमिन्द्रं सबाध ऊतये ।
बृहद्गायन्तः सुतसोमे अध्वरे हुवे भरं न कारिणं ॥
verses.rom:
tarobhirvo vidadvasumindram sabadha utaye |
brihadgayantah sutasome adhvare huve bharam na karinam ||
verses.en: Loud singing at the sacred rite where Soma flows we priests invoke With haste, that he may help, as the bard's cherisher, Indra who findeth wealth for you

verses.sa:
तरणिरित्सिषासति वाजं पुरन्ध्या युजा ।
आ व इन्द्रं पुरुहूतं नमे गिरा नेमिं तष्टेव सुद्रुवं ॥
verses.rom:
taraniritsishasati vajam purandhya yuja |
a va indram puruhutam name gira nemim tashteva sudruvam ||
verses.en: With Plenty for his true ally the active man will gain the spoil. Your Indra, much-invoked, I bend with song, as bends a wright his wheel of solid wood.

verses.sa:
पिबा सुतस्य रसिनो मत्स्वा न इन्द्र गोमतः ।
आपिर्नो बोधि सधमाद्ये वृधे३ऽस्मां अवन्तु ते धियः ॥
verses.rom:
piba sutasya rasino matsva na indra gomatah |
apirno bodhi sadhamadye vridhe3'smam avantu te dhiyah ||
verses.en: Drink, Indra, of the savoury juice, and cheer thee with our milky draught! Be, for our weal, our friend and sharer of the feast, and let thy wisdom guard us well!

verses.sa:
त्वं ह्येहि चेरवे विदा भगं वसुत्तये ।
उद्वावृषस्व मघवन्गविष्टय उदिन्द्राश्वमिष्टये ॥
verses.rom:
tvam hyehi cherave vida bhagam vasuttaye |
udvavrishasva maghavangavishtaya udindrashvamishtaye ||
verses.en: For thou--come to the worshipper!--wilt find great wealth to make us rich. Fill thyself full, O Maghavan, for gain of kine, full, Indra, for the gain of steeds!

verses.sa:
न हि वश्चरमं च न वसिष्ठः परिमंस्ते ।
अस्माकमद्य मरुतः सुते सचा विश्वे पिबन्तु कामिनः ॥
verses.rom:
na hi vashcharamam cha na vasishthah parimamste |
asmakamadya marutah sute sacha vishve pibantu kaminah ||
verses.en: Vasishtha will not overlook the lowliest one among you all Beside our Soma juice effused to-day let all the Maruts drink with eager haste!

verses.sa:
मा चिदन्यद्वि शंसत सखायो मा रिषण्यत ।
इन्द्रमित्स्तोता वृषणं सचा सुते मुहुरुक्था च शंसत ॥
verses.rom:
ma chidanyadvi shamsata sakhayo ma rishanyata |
indramitstota vrishanam sacha sute muhuruktha cha shamsata ||
verses.en: Glorify naught besides, O friends; so shall no sorrow trouble you! Praise only mighty Indra when the juice is shed, and say your lauds repeatedly!

verses.sa:
न किष्टं कर्मणा नशद्यश्चकार सदावृधं ।
इन्द्रं न यज्ञैर्विश्वगूर्तमृभ्वसमधृष्टं धृष्णुमोजसा ॥
verses.rom:
na kishtam karmana nashadyashchakara sadavridham |
indram na yajnairvishvagurtamribhvasamadhrishtam dhrishnumojasa ||

verses.sa:
य ऋते चिदभिश्रिषः पुरा जत्रुभ्य आतृदः ।
सन्धाता सन्धिं मघवा पुरूवसुर्निष्कर्ता विह्रुतं पुनः ॥
verses.rom:
ya rite chidabhishrishah pura jatrubhya atridah |
sandhata sandhim maghava puruvasurnishkarta vihrutam punah ||

verses.sa:
आ त्वा सहस्रमा शतं युक्ता रथे हिरण्यये ।
ब्रह्मयुजो हरय इन्द्र केशिनो वहन्तु सोमपीतये ॥
verses.rom:
a tva sahasrama shatam yukta rathe hiranyaye |
brahmayujo haraya indra keshino vahantu somapitaye ||

verses.sa:
आ मन्द्रैरिन्द्र हरिभिर्याहि मयूररोमभिः ।
मा त्वा के चिन्नि येमुरिन्न पाशिनोऽति धन्वेव तां इहि ॥
verses.rom:
a mandrairindra haribhiryahi mayuraromabhih |
ma tva ke chinni yemurinna pashino'ti dhanveva tam ihi ||

verses.sa:
त्वमङ्ग प्र शंसिषो देवः शविष्ठ मर्त्यं ।
न त्वदन्यो मघवन्नस्ति मर्डितेन्द्र ब्रवीमि ते वचः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamanga pra shamsisho devah shavishtha martyam |
na tvadanyo maghavannasti marditendra bravimi te vachah ||

verses.sa:
त्वमिन्द्र यशा अस्यृजीषी शवसस्पतिः ।
त्वं वृत्राणि हंस्यप्रतीन्येक इत्पुर्वनुत्तश्चर्षणीधृतिः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamindra yasha asyrijishi shavasaspatih |
tvam vritrani hamsyapratinyeka itpurvanuttashcharshanidhritih ||

verses.sa:
इन्द्रमिद्देवतातय इन्द्रं प्रयत्यध्वरे ।
इन्द्रं समीके वनिनो हवामह इन्द्रं धनस्य सातये ॥
verses.rom:
indramiddevatataya indram prayatyadhvare |
indram samike vanino havamaha indram dhanasya sataye ||

verses.sa:
इमा उ त्वा पुरूवसो गिरो वर्धन्तु या मम ।
पावकवर्णाः शुचयो विपश्चितोऽभि स्तोमैरनूषत ॥
verses.rom:
ima u tva puruvaso giro vardhantu ya mama |
pavakavarnah shuchayo vipashchito'bhi stomairanushata ||

verses.sa:
उदु त्ये मधुमत्तमा गिर स्तोमास ईरते ।
सत्राजितो धनसा अक्षितोतयो वाजयन्तो रथा इव ॥
verses.rom:
udu tye madhumattama gira stomasa irate |
satrajito dhanasa akshitotayo vajayanto ratha iva ||

verses.sa:
यथा गौरो अपा कृतं तृष्यन्नेत्यवेरिणं ।
आपित्वे नः प्रपित्वे तूयमा गहि कण्वेषु सु सचा पिब ॥
verses.rom:
yatha gauro apa kritam trishyannetyaverinam |
apitve nah prapitve tuyama gahi kanveshu su sacha piba ||

prose.en:
No one by deed attains to him who works and strengthens evermore: No, not by sacrifice, to Indra. praised of all, resistless, daring, bold in might. 2 He without ligature, before making incision in the neck, Closed up the wound again, most wealthy Maghavan, who healeth the dissevered parts.

A thousand and a hundred steeds are harnessed to thy golden car: Yoked by devotion, Indra, let the long-maned bays bring thee to drink the Soma juice!

Come hither, Indra, with bay steeds, joyous, with tails like peacock's plumes! Let no men check thy course as fowlers stay the bird: pass o'er them as o'er desert lands!

Thou as a God, O mightiest, verily blessest mortal man. O Maghavan, there is no comforter but thou: Indra, I speak my words to thee.

O Indra, thou art far-renowned, impetuous Lord of power and might. Alone, the never-conquered guardian of mankind, thou smitest down resistless foes.

Indra for worship of the Gods, Indra while sacrifice proceeds, Indra, as warriors in the battle-shock, we call, Indra that we may win the spoil.

May these my songs of praise exalt thee, Lord, who hast abundant wealth! Men skilled in holy hymns, pure, with the hues of fire, have sung them with their lauds to thee.

These songs of ours exceeding sweet, these hymns of praise ascend to thee, Like ever-conquering chariots that display their strength gain wealth and give unfailing help.

Even as the wild-bull, when he thirsts, goes to the desert's watery pool, Come to us quickly both at morning and at eve, and with the Kanvas drink thy fill!

verses.sa:
शग्ध्यू३षु शचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः ।
भगं न हि त्वा यशसं वसुविदमनु शूर चरामसि ॥
verses.rom:
shagdhyu3shu shachipata indra vishvabhirutibhih |
bhagam na hi tva yashasam vasuvidamanu shura charamasi ||
verses.en: Indra, with all thy saving helps assist us, Lord of power and might! For after thee we follow even as glorious bliss, thee, hero, finderout of wealth.

verses.sa:
या इन्द्र भुज आभरः स्वर्वां असुरेभ्यः ।
स्तोतारमिन्मघवन्नस्य वर्धय ये च त्वे वृक्तबर्हिषः ॥
verses.rom:
ya indra bhuja abharah svarvam asurebhyah |
stotaraminmaghavannasya vardhaya ye cha tve vriktabarhishah ||
verses.en: O Indra, Lord of light, what joys thou broughtest from the Asuras, Prosper therewith, O Maghavan, him who lauds that deed, and those whose grass is trimmed for thee!

verses.sa:
प्र मित्राय प्रार्यम्णे सचथ्यमृतावसो ।
वरूथ्ये३ वरुणे छन्द्यं वचः स्तोत्रं राजसु गायत ॥
verses.rom:
pra mitraya praryamne sachathyamritavaso |
varuthye3 varune chhandyam vachah stotram rajasu gayata ||
verses.en: To Aryaman and Mitra sing a reverent song, O pious one, A pleasant hymn to Varuna who shelters us: sing ye a laud unto the Kings!

verses.sa:
अभि त्वा पूर्वपीतय इन्द्र स्तोमेभिरायवः ।
समीचीनास ऋभवः समस्वरन्रुद्रा गृणन्त पूर्व्यं ॥
verses.rom:
abhi tva purvapitaya indra stomebhirayavah |
samichinasa ribhavah samasvaranrudra grinanta purvyam ||
verses.en: Men with their lauds are urging thee, Indra, to drink the Soma first. The Ribhus in accord have lifted up their voice, and Rudras sung thee as the first.

verses.sa:
प्र व इन्द्राय बृहते मरुतो ब्रह्मार्चत ।
वृत्रं हनति वृत्रहा शतक्रतुर्वज्रेण शतपर्वणा ॥
verses.rom:
pra va indraya brihate maruto brahmarchata |
vritram hanati vritraha shatakraturvajrena shataparvana ||
verses.en: Sing to your lofty Indra, sing, Maruts, a holy hymn of praise Let Satakratu, Vritra-slayer, slay the foe with hundred-knotted thunderbolt!

verses.sa:
बृहदिन्द्राय गायत मरुतो वृत्रहन्तमं ।
येन ज्योतिरजनयन्नृतावृधो देवं देवाय जागृवि ॥
verses.rom:
brihadindraya gayata maruto vritrahantamam |
yena jyotirajanayannritavridho devam devaya jagrivi ||
