verses.en: To Indra sing the lofty hymn, Maruts! that slays the Vritras best, Whereby the holy ones created for the God the light divine that ever wakes.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र क्रतुं न आ भर पिता पुत्रेभ्यो यथा ।
शिक्षा णो अस्मिन्पुरुहूत यामनि जीवा ज्योतिरशीमहि ॥
verses.rom:
indra kratum na a bhara pita putrebhyo yatha |
shiksha no asminpuruhuta yamani jiva jyotirashimahi ||
verses.en: O Indra, give us wisdom as a sire gives wisdom to his sons Guide us, O much-invoked, in this our way: may we still live and look upon the light!

verses.sa:
मा न इन्द्र परा वृणग्भवा नः सधमाद्ये ।
त्वं न ऊती त्वमिन्न आप्यं मा न इन्द्र परा वृणक् ॥
verses.rom:
ma na indra para vrinagbhava nah sadhamadye |
tvam na uti tvaminna apyam ma na indra para vrinak ||
verses.en: O Indra, turn us not away: be present with us at our feast For thou art our protection, yea, thou art our kin: O Indra, turn us not away!

verses.sa:
वयं घ त्वा सुतावन्त आपो न वृक्तबर्हिषः ।
पवित्रस्य प्रस्रवणेषु वृत्रहन्परि स्तोतार आसते ॥
verses.rom:
vayam gha tva sutavanta apo na vriktabarhishah |
pavitrasya prasravaneshu vritrahanpari stotara asate ||
verses.en: We compass these like waters, we whose grass is trimmed and Soma pressed. Here where the filter pours its stream, thy worshippers round thee, O Vritra-slayer, sit.

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्र नाहुषीष्वा ओजो नृम्णं च कृष्टिषु ।
यद्वा पञ्च क्षितीनां द्युम्नमा भर सत्रा विश्वानि प्ॐस्या ॥
verses.rom:
yadindra nahushishva ojo nrimnam cha krishtishu |
yadva pancha kshitinam dyumnama bhara satra vishvani pomsya ||
verses.en: All strength and valour that is found, Indra, in tribes of Nahushas, And all the splendid fame that the Five Tribes enjoy, bring, yea, all manly powers at once!

verses.sa:
सत्यमित्था वृषेदसि वृषजूतिर्नोऽविता ।
वृषा ह्युग्र शृण्विषे परावति वृषो अर्वावति श्रुतः ॥
verses.rom:
satyamittha vrishedasi vrishajutirno'vita |
vrisha hyugra shrinvishe paravati vrisho arvavati shrutah ||
verses.en: Yea, verily thou art a Bull, our guardian, rushing like a bull: Thou, mighty one, art celebrated as a Bull, famed as a Bull both near and far.

verses.sa:
यच्छक्रासि परावति यदर्वावति वृत्रहन् ।
अतस्त्वा गीर्भिर्द्युगदिन्द्र केशिभिः सुतावां आ विवासति ॥
verses.rom:
yachchhakrasi paravati yadarvavati vritrahan |
atastva girbhirdyugadindra keshibhih sutavam a vivasati ||
verses.en: Whether, O Sakra, thou be far, or, Vritra-slayer, near at hand, Thence by heaven-reaching songs he who bath pressed the juice invites thee with thy long-maned steeds.

verses.sa:
अभि वो वीरमन्धसो मदेषु गाय गिरा महा विचेतसं ।
इन्द्रं नाम श्रुत्यं शाकिनं वचो यथा ॥
verses.rom:
abhi vo viramandhaso madeshu gaya gira maha vichetasam |
indram nama shrutyam shakinam vacho yatha ||
verses.en: In the wild raptures of the juice sing to your hero with high laud, to him the wise, To Indra glorious in his name, the mighty one, even as the hymn alloweth it!

verses.sa:
इन्द्र त्रिधातु शरणं त्रिवरूथं स्वस्तये ।
छर्दिर्यच्छ मघवद्भ्यश्च मह्यं च यावया दिद्युमेभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
indra tridhatu sharanam trivarutham svastaye |
chhardiryachchha maghavadbhyashcha mahyam cha yavaya didyumebhyah ||
verses.en: O Indra, give us for our weal a triple refuge, triply strong! Bestow a dwelling-place on our rich lords and me, and keep thy dart afar from these!

verses.sa:
श्रायन्त इव सूर्यं विश्वेदिन्द्रस्य भक्षत ।
वसूनि जातो जनिमान्योजसा प्रति भागं न दीधिमः ॥
verses.rom:
shrayanta iva suryam vishvedindrasya bhakshata |
vasuni jato janimanyojasa prati bhagam na didhimah ||
verses.en: Turning, as 'twere, to meet the Sun enjoy from Indra all good things! When he who will be born is born with power we look to treasures as our heritage.

verses.sa:
न सीमदेव आप तदिषं दीर्घायो मर्त्यः ।
एतग्वा चिद्या एतशो युयोजत इन्द्रो हरी युयोजते ॥
verses.rom:
na simadeva apa tadisham dirghayo martyah |
etagva chidya etasho yuyojata indro hari yuyojate ||
verses.en: The godless mortal gaineth not this food, O thou whose life is long! But one who yokes the bright-hued horses, Etasas; then Indra yokes his tawny steeds.

verses.sa:
आ नो विश्वासु हव्यमिन्द्रं समत्सु भूषत ।
उप ब्रह्माणि सवनानि वृत्रहन्परमज्या ऋचीषम ॥
verses.rom:
a no vishvasu havyamindram samatsu bhushata |
upa brahmani savanani vritrahanparamajya richishama ||
verses.en: Draw near unto our Indra who must be invoked in every fight! Come, thou most mighty Vritra-slayer, meet for praise, come to, libations and to hymns!

verses.sa:
तवेदिन्द्रावमं वसु त्वं पुष्यसि मध्यमं ।
सत्रा विश्वस्य परमस्य राजसि न किष्ट्वा गोषु वृण्वते ॥
verses.rom:
tavedindravamam vasu tvam pushyasi madhyamam |
satra vishvasya paramasya rajasi na kishtva goshu vrinvate ||
verses.en: Thine, Indra, is the lowest wealth, thou cherishest the midmost wealth, Thou ever rulest all the highest: in the fray for cattle none resisteth thee.

verses.sa:
क्वेयथ क्वेदसि पुरुत्रा चिद्धि ते मनः ।
अलर्षि युध्म खजकृत्पुरन्दर प्र गायत्रा अगासिषुः ॥
verses.rom:
kveyatha kvedasi purutra chiddhi te manah |
alarshi yudhma khajakritpurandara pra gayatra agasishuh ||
verses.en: Where art thou? Whither art thou gone? For many a place attracts thy mind. Haste, warrior, fort-destroyer, Lord of battle's din! haste, holy songs have sounded forth!

verses.sa:
वयमेनमिदा ह्योपीपेमेह वज्रिणं ।
तस्मा उ अद्य सवने सुतं भरा नूनं भूषत श्रुते ॥
verses.rom:
vayamenamida hyopipemeha vajrinam |
tasma u adya savane sutam bhara nunam bhushata shrute ||
verses.en: Here, verily, yesterday we let the thunder-wielder drink his fill. Bring him the juice poured forth in sacrifice to-day. Now range you by the glorious one!

verses.sa:
यो राजा चर्षणीनां याता रथेभिरध्रिगुः ।
विश्वासां तरुता पृतनानां ज्येष्ठं यो वृत्रहा गृणे ॥
verses.rom:
yo raja charshaninam yata rathebhiradhriguh |
vishvasam taruta pritananam jyeshtham yo vritraha grine ||
verses.en: He who as sovran Lord of men moves with his chariots unrestrained, The Vritra-slayer, vanquisher of fighting hosts, pre-eminent, is praised in song.

verses.sa:
यत इन्द्र भयामहे ततो नो अभयं कृधि ।
मघवञ्छग्धि तव तन्न ऊतये वि द्विषो वि मृधो जहि ॥
verses.rom:
yata indra bhayamahe tato no abhayam kridhi |
maghavanchhagdhi tava tanna utaye vi dvisho vi mridho jahi ||
verses.en: Indra, give us security from that whereof we are afraid Help us, O Maghavan, let thy favour aid us thus; drive away foes and enemies!

verses.sa:
वास्तोष्पते ध्रुवा स्थूणां सत्रं सोम्यानां ।
द्रप्सः पुरां भेत्ता शश्वतीनामिन्द्रो मुनीनां सखा ॥
verses.rom:
vastoshpate dhruva sthunam satram somyanam |
drapsah puram bhetta shashvatinamindro muninam sakha ||
verses.en: Strong pillar thou, Lord of the home! armour of Soma-offerers! The drop of Soma breaketh all the strongholds down, and Indra is the Rishis' friend.

verses.sa:
बण्महां असि सूर्य बडादित्य महां असि ।
महस्ते सतो महिमा पनिष्टम मह्ना देव महां असि ॥
verses.rom:
banmaham asi surya badaditya maham asi |
mahaste sato mahima panishtama mahna deva maham asi ||
verses.en: Verily, Surya, thou art great; truly, Aditya, thou art great! O most admired for greatness of thy majesty, God, by thy greatness thou art great!

verses.sa:
अश्वी रथी सुरूप इद्गोमां यदिन्द्र ते सखा ।
श्वात्रभाजा वयसा सचते सदा चन्द्रैर्याति सभामुप ॥
verses.rom:
ashvi rathi surupa idgomam yadindra te sakha |
shvatrabhaja vayasa sachate sada chandrairyati sabhamupa ||
verses.en: Indra! thy friend, when fair of form and rich in chariots, steeds, and kine, Hath ever vital power that gives him strength, and joins the company with radiant men.

verses.sa:
यद्द्याव इन्द्र ते शतं शतं भूमीरुत स्युः ।
न त्वा वज्रिन्त्सहस्रं सूर्या अनु न जातमष्ट रोदसी ॥
verses.rom:
yaddyava indra te shatam shatam bhumiruta syuh |
na tva vajrintsahasram surya anu na jatamashta rodasi ||
verses.en: O Indra, if a hundred heavens and if a hundred earths were thine,-- No, not a hundred suns could match thee at thy birth, not both the worlds, O Thunderer!

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्र प्रागपागुदग्न्यग्वा हूयसे नृभिः ।
सिमा पुरू नृषूतो अस्यानवेऽसि प्रशर्ध तुर्वशे ॥
verses.rom:
yadindra pragapagudagnyagva huyase nribhih |
sima puru nrishuto asyanave'si prashardha turvashe ||
verses.en: Though, Indra, thou art called by men eastward and west ward, north and south, Thou chiefly art with Anava and Turvasa, brave champion urged by men to come.

verses.sa:
कस्तमिन्द्र त्वा वसवा मर्त्यो दधर्षति ।
श्रद्धा हि ते मघवन्पार्ये दिवि वाजी वाजं सिषासति ॥
verses.rom:
kastamindra tva vasava martyo dadharshati |
shraddha hi te maghavanparye divi vaji vajam sishasati ||
verses.en: Indra whose wealth is in thyself, what mortal will attack this man? The strong will win the spoil on the decisive day through faith in thee, O Maghavan!

verses.sa:
इन्द्राग्नी अपादियं पूर्वागात्पद्वतीभ्यः ।
हित्वा शिरो जिह्वया रारपच्चरत्त्रिंशत्पदा न्यक्रमीत् ॥
verses.rom:
indragni apadiyam purvagatpadvatibhyah |
hitva shiro jihvaya rarapachcharattrimshatpada nyakramit ||
verses.en: First, Indra! Agni! hath this Maid come footless unto those with feet. Stretching her head and speaking loudly with her tongue, she hath gone downward thirty steps.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र नेदीय एदिहि मितमेधाभिरूतिभिः ।
आ शं तम शं तमाभिरभिष्टिभिरा स्वापे स्वापिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
indra nediya edihi mitamedhabhirutibhih |
a sham tama sham tamabhirabhishtibhira svape svapibhih ||
verses.en: Come, Indra, very near to us with aids of firmly-based resolve Come, most auspicious, with thy most auspicious help; good kinsman, with good kinsmen come!

verses.sa:
इत ऊती वो अजरं प्रहेतारमप्रहितं ।
आशुं जेतारं हेतारं रथीतममतूर्तं तुग्रियावृधं ॥
verses.rom:
ita uti vo ajaram prahetaramaprahitam |
ashum jetaram hetaram rathitamamaturtam tugriyavridham ||
verses.en: Call to your aid the eternal one who shoots and none may shoot at him, Inciter, swift, victorious, best of charioteers, unconquered, Tugriya's strengthener!

verses.sa:
मो षु त्वा वाघतश्च नारे अस्मन्नि रीरमन् ।
आरात्ताद्वा सधमादं न आ गहीह वा सन्नुप श्रुधि ॥
verses.rom:
mo shu tva vaghatashcha nare asmanni riraman |
arattadva sadhamadam na a gahiha va sannupa shrudhi ||
verses.en: Let none, no, not thy worshippers, delay thee far away from us Even from faraway come thou unto our feast, or listen if' already here!

verses.sa:
सुनोत सोमपाव्ने सोममिन्द्राय वज्रिणे ।
पचता पक्तीरवसे कृणुध्वमित्पृणन्नित्पृणते मयः ॥
verses.rom:
sunota somapavne somamindraya vajrine |
pachata paktiravase krinudhvamitprinannitprinate mayah ||
verses.en: For Indra Soma-drinker, armed with thunder, press the Soma juice; Make ready your dressed meats: cause him to favour us! The giver blesses him who gives.

verses.sa:
यः सत्राहा विचर्षणिरिन्द्रं तं हूमहे वयं ।
सहस्रमन्यो तुविनृम्ण सत्पते भवा समत्सु नो वृधे ॥
verses.rom:
yah satraha vicharshanirindram tam humahe vayam |
sahasramanyo tuvinrimna satpate bhava samatsu no vridhe ||
verses.en: We call upon that Indra who, most active, ever slays the foe With boundless spirit, Lord of heroes, manliest one, help thou and prosper us in fight!

verses.sa:
शचीभिर्नः शचीवसू दिवानक्तं दिशस्यतं ।
मा वां रातिरुप दसत्कदा च नास्मद्रातिः कदा च न ॥
verses.rom:
shachibhirnah shachivasu divanaktam dishasyatam |
ma vam ratirupa dasatkada cha nasmadratih kada cha na ||
verses.en: Ye rich in strength, through your great power vouchsafe us blessings day and night! The offerings which we bring to you shall never fail gifts brought by us shall never fail.

verses.sa:
यदा कदा च मीढुषे स्तोता जरेत मर्त्यः ।
आदिद्वन्देत वरुणं विपा गिरा धर्त्तारं विव्रतानां ॥
verses.rom:
yada kada cha midhushe stota jareta martyah |
adidvandeta varunam vipa gira dharttaram vivratanam ||
verses.en: Whenever mortal worshipper will sing a bounteous giver's praise, Let him with song inspired laud Varuna who supports the folk who follow varied rites.

verses.sa:
पाहि गा अन्धसो मद इन्द्राय मेध्यातिथे ।
यः सम्मिश्लो हर्योर्यो हिरण्यय इन्द्रो वज्री हिरण्ययः ॥
verses.rom:
pahi ga andhaso mada indraya medhyatithe |
yah sammishlo haryoryo hiranyaya indro vajri hiranyayah ||
verses.en: Drink milk to Indra in the joy of Soma juice, Medhyatithi! To golden Indra ever close to his bay steeds, the thunder-armed, the golden one!

verses.sa:
उभयं शृणवच्च न इन्द्रो अर्वागिदं वचः ।
सत्राच्या मघवान्त्सोमपीतये धिया शविष्ठ आ गमत् ॥
verses.rom:
ubhayam shrinavachcha na indro arvagidam vachah |
satrachya maghavantsomapitaye dhiya shavishtha a gamat ||
verses.en: Both boons,-may Indra, hitherward turned listen to this prayer of ours, And mightiest Maghavar, with thought inclined to us come near to drink the Soma juice!

verses.sa:
महे च न त्वाद्रिवः परा शुल्काय दीयसे ।
न सहस्राय नायुताये वज्रिवो न शताय शतामघ ॥
verses.rom:
mahe cha na tvadrivah para shulkaya diyase |
na sahasraya nayutaye vajrivo na shataya shatamagha ||
verses.en: Not for an ample price dost thou, Stone-caster! give thyself away, Not for a thousand, Thunderer! nor ten thousand, nor a hundred, Lord of countless wealth!

verses.sa:
वस्यां इन्द्रासि मे पितुरुत भ्रातुरभुञ्जतः ।
माता च मे छदयथः समा वसो वसुत्वनाय राधसे ॥
verses.rom:
vasyam indrasi me pituruta bhraturabhunjatah |
mata cha me chhadayathah sama vaso vasutvanaya radhase ||
verses.en: O Indra, thou art more to me than sire or niggard brother is. Thou and my mother, O good Lord, appear alike, to give me wealth abundantly.

verses.sa:
इम इन्द्राय सुन्विरे सोमासो दध्याशिरः ।
तां आ मदाय वज्रहस्त पीतये हरिभ्यां याह्योक आ ॥
verses.rom:
ima indraya sunvire somaso dadhyashirah |
tam a madaya vajrahasta pitaye haribhyam yahyoka a ||
verses.en: These Soma juice mixt with curd have been expressed for Indra here: Come with thy bay steeds, Thunder-wielder, to our home, to drink them till they make thee glad!

verses.sa:
इम इन्द्र मदाय ते सोमाश्चिकित्र उकिथनः ।
मधोः पपान उप नो गिरः शृणु रास्व स्तोत्राय गिर्वणः ॥
verses.rom:
ima indra madaya te somashchikitra ukithanah |
madhoh papana upa no girah shrinu rasva stotraya girvanah ||
verses.en: Indra, these Somas with their lauds have been prepared for thy delight. Drink of the pleasant juice and listen to our songs; lover of song, reward the hymn!

verses.sa:
आ त्वा३द्य सबर्दुघां हुवे गायत्रवेपसं ।
इन्द्रं धेनुं सुदुघामन्यामिषमुरुधारामरङ्कृतं ॥
verses.rom:
a tva3dya sabardugham huve gayatravepasam |
indram dhenum sudughamanyamishamurudharamarankritam ||
verses.en: I call on thee, Sabardugha, this day, inspirer of the psalm. Indra, the richly-yielding milch-cow who provides unfailing food in ample stream.

verses.sa:
न त्वा बृहन्तो अद्रयो वरन्त इन्द्र वीडवः ।
यच्छिक्षसि स्तुवते मावते वसु न किष्टदा मिनाति ते ॥
verses.rom:
na tva brihanto adrayo varanta indra vidavah |
yachchhikshasi stuvate mavate vasu na kishtada minati te ||
verses.en: Indra, the strong and lofty hills are powerless to bar thy way None stays that act of thine when thou wouldst fain give wealth to one like me who sings thy praise.

verses.sa:
क ईं वेद सुते सचा पिबन्तं कद्वयो दधे ।
अयं यः पुरो विभिनत्योजसा मन्दानः शिप्र्यन्धसः ॥
verses.rom:
ka im veda sute sacha pibantam kadvayo dadhe |
ayam yah puro vibhinatyojasa mandanah shipryandhasah ||
verses.en: Who knows what vital power he wins, drinking beside the flowing juice? This is the fair-cheeked. God who, joying in the draught, breaks down the castles in his strength.

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्र शासो अव्रतं च्यावया सदसस्परि ।
अस्माकमंशुं मघवन्पुरुस्पृहं वसव्ये अधि बर्हय ॥
verses.rom:
yadindra shaso avratam chyavaya sadasaspari |
asmakamamshum maghavanpuruspriham vasavye adhi barhaya ||
verses.en: What time thou castest from his seat and punishest the riteless man, Strengthen for opulence, O Indra Maghavan, our plant desired by many a one!

verses.sa:
त्वष्टा नो दैव्यं वचः पर्जन्यो ब्रह्मणस्पतिः ।
पुत्रैर्भ्रातृभिरदितिर्नु पातु नो दुष्टरं त्रामणं वचः ॥
verses.rom:
tvashta no daivyam vachah parjanyo brahmanaspatih |
putrairbhratribhiraditirnu patu no dushtaram tramanam vachah ||
verses.en: Let Tvashtar, Brahmanaspati, Parjanya guard our heavenly word, Aditi with her sons, the brothers, guard for us the invincible, the saving word!

verses.sa:
कदा च न स्तरीरसि नेन्द्र सश्चसि दाशुषे ।
उपोपेन्नु मघवन्भूय इन्नु ते दानं देवस्य पृच्यते ॥
verses.rom:
kada cha na starirasi nendra sashchasi dashushe |
upopennu maghavanbhuya innu te danam devasya prichyate ||
verses.en: Ne'er art thou fruitless, Indra, ne'er dost thou desert the worshipper: But now, O Maghavan, thy bounty as a God is poured forth ever more and more.

verses.sa:
युङ्क्ष्वा हि वृत्रहन्तम हरी इन्द्र परावतः ।
अर्वाचीनो मघवन्त्सोमपीतय उग्र ऋष्वेभिरा गहि ॥
verses.rom:
yunkshva hi vritrahantama hari indra paravatah |
arvachino maghavantsomapitaya ugra rishvebhira gahi ||
verses.en: Best slayer of the Vritras, yoke thy bay steeds, Indra, far away Come with the high ones hither, Maghavan, to us, mighty, to, drink the Soma juice!

verses.sa:
त्वामिदा ह्यो नरोऽपीप्यन्वज्रिन्भूर्णयः ।
स इन्द्र स्तोमवाहस इह श्रुध्युप स्वसरमा गहि ॥
verses.rom:
tvamida hyo naro'pipyanvajrinbhurnayah |
sa indra stomavahasa iha shrudhyupa svasarama gahi ||
verses.en: O Thunderer, zealous worshippers gave thee drink this time yesterday: So, Indra, listen here to him who offers lauds: come near unto, our dwelling-place!

verses.sa:
प्रत्यु अदर्श्यायत्यू३छ् छन्ती दुहिता दिवः ।
अपो मही वृणुते चक्षुषा तमो ज्योतिष्कृणोति सूनरि ॥
verses.rom:
pratyu adarshyayatyu3chh chhanti duhita divah |
apo mahi vrinute chakshusha tamo jyotishkrinoti sunari ||
verses.en: Advancing, sending forth her rays, the daughter of the Sky is seen. The mighty one lays bare the darkness with her eye, the friendly Lady makes the light.

verses.sa:
इमा उ वां दिविष्टय उस्रा हवन्ते अश्विना ।
अयं वामह्वेऽवसे शचीवसू विशंविशं हि गच्छथः ॥
verses.rom:
ima u vam divishtaya usra havante ashvina |
ayam vamahve'vase shachivasu vishamvisham hi gachchhathah ||
verses.en: These morning sacrifices call you, Asvins, at the break of day. For help have I invoked you rich in power and might: for, house by house, ye visit all.

verses.sa:
कु ष्ठः को वामश्विना तपानो देवा मर्त्यः ।
घ्नता वामश्मया क्षपमाणोंशुनेत्थमु आदुन्यथा ॥
verses.rom:
ku shthah ko vamashvina tapano deva martyah |
ghnata vamashmaya kshapamanomshunetthamu adunyatha ||
verses.en: Where are ye, Gods? What mortal man, O Asvins, glows with zeal for you, Urging you with the crushing stone and with the stalk of Soma thus or otherwise?

verses.sa:
अयं वां मधुमत्तमः सुतः सोमो दिविष्टिषु ।
तमश्विना पिबतं तिरो अह्न्यं धत्तं रत्नानि दाशुषे ॥
verses.rom:
ayam vam madhumattamah sutah somo divishtishu |
tamashvina pibatam tiro ahnyam dhattam ratnani dashushe ||
verses.en: This sweetest Soma juice hath been expressed for you at morning rites. Asvins, drink this prepared ere yesterday and give treasures to him who offers it!

verses.sa:
आ त्वा सोमस्य गल्दया सदा याचन्नहं ज्या ।
भूर्णिं मृगं न सवनेषु चुक्रुधं क ईशानं न याचिषत् ॥
verses.rom:
a tva somasya galdaya sada yachannaham jya |
bhurnim mrigam na savaneshu chukrudham ka ishanam na yachishat ||
verses.en: Let me not, still beseeching thee with might and sound of Soma drops, Anger at sacrifice a fierce wild creature! Who would not beseech the almighty one!

verses.sa:
अध्वर्यो द्रावया त्वं सोममिन्द्रः पिपासति ।
उपो नूनं युयुजे वृष्णा हरी आ च जगाम वृत्रहा ॥
verses.rom:
adhvaryo dravaya tvam somamindrah pipasati |
upo nunam yuyuje vrishna hari a cha jagama vritraha ||
verses.en: Adhvaryu, let the Soma flow, for Indra longs to drink thereof. He even now hath yoked his vigorous bay steeds: the Vritraslayer hath come nigh.

verses.sa:
अभी षतस्तदा भरेन्द्र ज्यायः कनीयसः ।
पुरूवसुर्हि मघवन्बभूविथ भरेभरे च हव्यः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi shatastada bharendra jyayah kaniyasah |
puruvasurhi maghavanbabhuvitha bharebhare cha havyah ||
verses.en: Bring thou all this unto the good, O Indra, to the old and young! For, Maghavan, thou art rich in treasures from of old, to be invoked in every fight.

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्र यावतस्त्वमेतावदहमीशीय ।
स्तोतारमिद्दधिषे रदावसो न पापत्वाय रंसिषं ॥
verses.rom:
yadindra yavatastvametavadahamishiya |
stotaramiddadhishe radavaso na papatvaya ramsisham ||
verses.en: If I, O Indra, were the lord of riches ample as thine own, I would support the singer, God who scatterest wealth! and not abandon him to woe.

verses.sa:
त्वमिन्द्र प्रतूर्तिष्वभि विश्वा असि स्पृधः ।
अशस्तिहा जनिता वृत्रतूरसि त्वं तूर्य तरुष्यतः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamindra praturtishvabhi vishva asi spridhah |
ashastiha janita vritraturasi tvam turya tarushyatah ||
verses.en: Thou in thy battles, Indra, art subduer of all hostile bands. Father art thou, all-conquering, cancelling the curse, thou victor of the vanquisher!

verses.sa:
प्र यो रिरिक्ष ओजसा दिवः सदोभ्यस्परि ।
न त्वा विव्याच रज इन्द्र पार्थिवमति विश्वं ववक्षिथ ॥
verses.rom:
pra yo ririksha ojasa divah sadobhyaspari |
na tva vivyacha raja indra parthivamati vishvam vavakshitha ||
verses.en: For in thy might thou stretchest out beyond the mansions of the sky. The earthly region, Indra, comprehends thee not. Thou hast waxed mighty over all.

verses.sa:
असावि देवं गोऋजीकमन्धो न्यस्मिन्निन्द्रो जनुषेमुवोच ।
बोधामसि त्वा हर्यश्व यज्ञैर्बोधा न स्तोममन्धसो मदेषु ॥
verses.rom:
asavi devam gorijikamandho nyasminnindro janushemuvocha |
bodhamasi tva haryashva yajnairbodha na stomamandhaso madeshu ||
verses.en: Pressed is the juice divine with milk commingled: thereto hath Indra ever been accustomed. We wake thee, Lord of bays, with sacrifices: mark this our laud in the wild joys of Soma!

verses.sa:
योनिष्ट इन्द्र सदने अकारि तमा नृभिः पुरूहूत प्र याहि ।
असो यथा नोऽविता वृधश्चिद्ददो वसूनि ममदश्च सोमैः ॥
verses.rom:
yonishta indra sadane akari tama nribhih puruhuta pra yahi |
aso yatha no'vita vridhashchiddado vasuni mamadashcha somaih ||
verses.en: A home is made for thee to dwell in, Indra: O much-invoked one, with the men go thither! Thou, that thou mayest guard us and increase us, givest us wealth and joyest in the Somas.

verses.sa:
अदर्दरुत्समसृजो वि खानि त्वमर्णवान्बद्बधानां अरम्णाः ।
महान्तमिन्द्र पर्वतं वि यद्वः सृजद्धारा अव यद्दानवान्हन् ॥
verses.rom:
adardarutsamasrijo vi khani tvamarnavanbadbadhanam aramnah |
mahantamindra parvatam vi yadvah srijaddhara ava yaddanavanhan ||
verses.en: The well thou clavest, settest free the fountains, and gavest rest to floods that were obstructed. Thou, Indra, laying the great mountain open, slaying the Ddnava, didst loose the torrents.

verses.sa:
सुष्वाणास इन्द्र स्तुमसि त्वा सनिष्यन्तश्चित्तुविनृम्ण वाजं ।
आ नो भर सुवितं यस्य कोना तना त्मना सह्यामा त्वोताः ॥
verses.rom:
sushvanasa indra stumasi tva sanishyantashchittuvinrimna vajam |
a no bhara suvitam yasya kona tana tmana sahyama tvotah ||
verses.en: When we have pressed the juice we laud thee, Indra, most valorous! even about to win the booty. Bring us prosperity, and by thy great wisdom, under thine own protection, may we conquer!

verses.sa:
जगृह्मा ते दक्षिणमिन्द्र हस्तं वसूयवो वसुपते वसूनां ।
विद्मा हि त्वा गोपतिं शूर गोनामस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणं रयिन्दाः ॥
verses.rom:
jagrihma te dakshinamindra hastam vasuyavo vasupate vasunam |
vidma hi tva gopatim shura gonamasmabhyam chitram vrishanam rayindah ||
verses.en: Thy right hand have we grasped in ours, O Indra, longing, thou very Lord of wealth, for treasures. Because we know thee, hero, Lord of cattle: vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches!

verses.sa:
इन्द्रं नरो नेमधिता हवन्ति यत्पार्या युनजते धियस्ताः ।
शूरो नृषाता श्रवसश्च काम आ गोमति व्रजे भजा त्वं नः ॥
verses.rom:
indram naro nemadhita havanti yatparya yunajate dhiyastah |
shuro nrishata shravasashcha kama a gomati vraje bhaja tvam nah ||
verses.en: Men call on Indra in the armed encounter that he may make the hymns they sing decisive. Hero in combat and in love of glory, give us a portion of the stall of cattle!

verses.sa:
वयः सुपर्णा उप सेदुरिन्द्रं प्रियमेधा ऋषयो नाधमानाः ।
अप ध्वान्तमूर्णुहि पूर्धि चक्षुर्मुमुग्ध्या३स्मान्निधयेव बद्धान् ॥
verses.rom:
vayah suparna upa sedurindram priyamedha rishayo nadhamanah |
apa dhvantamurnuhi purdhi chakshurmumugdhya3smannidhayeva baddhan ||
verses.en: Like birds of beauteous wing the Priyamedhas, Rishis, imploring, have come nigh to Indra. Dispel the darkness and fill full our vision: deliver us as men whom snares entangle!

verses.sa:
नाके सुपर्णमुप यत्पतन्तं हृदा वेनन्तो अभ्यचक्षत त्वा ।
हिरण्यपक्षं वरुणस्य दूतं यमस्य योनौ शकुनं भुरण्युं ॥
verses.rom:
nake suparnamupa yatpatantam hrida venanto abhyachakshata tva |
hiranyapaksham varunasya dutam yamasya yonau shakunam bhuranyum ||
verses.en: They gaze on thee with longing in their spirit, as on a strongwinged bird that mounteth sky-ward; On thee with wings of gold, Varuna's envoy, the Bird that hasteneth to the home of Yama.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्म जज्ञानं प्रथमं पुरस्ताद्वि सीमतः सुरुचो वेन आवः ।
स बुध्न्या उपमा अस्य विष्ठाः सतश्च योनिमसतश्च विवः ॥
verses.rom:
brahma jajnanam prathamam purastadvi simatah surucho vena avah |
sa budhnya upama asya vishthah satashcha yonimasatashcha vivah ||
verses.en: First in the ancient time was Prayer engendered: Vena disclosed the bright ones from the summit, Laid bare this world's lowest and highest regions, womb of the existent and the non- existent.

verses.sa:
अपूर्व्या पुरुतमान्यस्मै महे वीराय तवसे तुराय ।
विरप्शिने वज्रिणे शन्तमानि वचांस्यास्मै स्थविराय तक्षुः ॥
verses.rom:
apurvya purutamanyasmai mahe viraya tavase turaya |
virapshine vajrine shantamani vachamsyasmai sthaviraya takshuh ||
verses.en: They have prepared and fashioned for this hero words never matched, most plentiful, most auspicious, For him the ancient, great, strong, energetic, the very mighty wielder of the thunder.

verses.sa:
अव द्रप्सो अंशुमतीमतिष्ठदीयानः कृष्णो दशभिः सहस्रैः ।
आवत्तमिन्द्रः शच्या धमन्तमप स्नीहितिं नृमणा अधद्राः ॥
verses.rom:
ava drapso amshumatimatishthadiyanah krishno dashabhih sahasraih |
avattamindrah shachya dhamantamapa snihitim nrimana adhadrah ||
verses.en: The black drop sank in Ansumati's bosom, advancing with ten thousand round about it. Indra with might longed for it as it panted: the hero-hearted King laid down his weapons.

verses.sa:
वृत्रस्य त्वा श्वसथादीषमाणा विश्वे देवा अजहुर्ये सखायः ।
मरुद्भिरिन्द्र सख्यं ते अस्त्वथेमा विश्वाः पृतना जयासि ॥
verses.rom:
vritrasya tva shvasathadishamana vishve deva ajahurye sakhayah |
marudbhirindra sakhyam te astvathema vishvah pritana jayasi ||
verses.en: Flying in terror from the snort of Vritra all deities who were thy friends forsook thee. So, Indra, with the Maruts be thy friendship: in all these battles thou shalt be the victor.

verses.sa:
विधुं दद्राणं समने बहूनां युवानं सन्तं पलितो जगार ।
देवस्य पश्य काव्यं महित्वाद्या ममार स ह्यः समान ॥
verses.rom:
vidhum dadranam samane bahunam yuvanam santam palito jagara |
devasya pashya kavyam mahitvadya mamara sa hyah samana ||
verses.en: The old hath waked the young Moon from his slumber who runs his circling course with many round him. Behold the God's high wisdom in its greatness: he who died yesterday to-day is living.

verses.sa:
त्वं ह त्यत्सप्तभ्यो जायमानोऽशत्रुभ्यो अभवः शत्रुरिन्द्र ।
गूढे द्यावापृथिवी अन्वविन्दो विभुमद्भ्यो भुवनेभ्यो रणं धाः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam ha tyatsaptabhyo jayamano'shatrubhyo abhavah shatrurindra |
gudhe dyavaprithivi anvavindo vibhumadbhyo bhuvanebhyo ranam dhah ||
verses.en: Then, at thy birth, thou wast the foeman, Indra, of those the seven who ne'er had met a rival. The hidden pair, heaven and the earth, thou foundest, and to the mighty worlds thou gavest pleasure.

verses.sa:
मेडिं न त्वा वज्रिणं भृष्टिमन्तं पुरुधस्मानं वृषभं स्थिरप्स्नुं ।
करोष्यर्यस्तरुषीर्दुवस्युरिन्द्र द्युक्षं वृत्रहणं गृणीषे ॥
verses.rom:
medim na tva vajrinam bhrishtimantam purudhasmanam vrishabham sthirapsnum |
karoshyaryastarushirduvasyurindra dyuksham vritrahanam grinishe ||
verses.en: A friend we count thee, sharp-edged, thunder-wielder, Steer strong of body, overthrowing many. Thou, helping, causest pious tribes to conquer: Indra, I laud the, heavenly Vritra-slayer.

verses.sa:
प्र वो महे महेवृधे भरध्वं प्रचेतसे प्र सुमतिं कृणुध्वं ।
विशः पूर्वीः प्र चर चर्षणिप्राः ॥
verses.rom:
pra vo mahe mahevridhe bharadhvam prachetase pra sumatim krinudhvam |
vishah purvih pra chara charshaniprah ||
verses.en: Bring to the wise, the great, who waxeth mighty your offerings,. and make ready your devotion! Go forth to many tribes as man's controller!

verses.sa:
शुनं हुवेम मघवानमिन्द्रमस्मिन्भरे नृतमं वाजसातौ ।
शृण्वन्तमुग्रमूतये समत्सु ध्नन्तं वृत्राणि सञ्जितं धनानि ॥
verses.rom:
shunam huvema maghavanamindramasminbhare nritamam vajasatau |
shrinvantamugramutaye samatsu dhnantam vritrani sanjitam dhanani ||
verses.en: Call we on Maghavan, auspicious Indra, best hero in this fight where spoil is gathered, Strong, listening to give us aid in battles, who slays the Vritras, wins and gathers riches!

verses.sa:
उदु ब्रह्माण्यैरत श्रवस्येन्द्रं समर्ये महया वसिष्ठ ।
आ यो विश्वानि श्रवसा ततानोपश्रोता म ईवतो वचांसि ॥
verses.rom:
udu brahmanyairata shravasyendram samarye mahaya vasishtha |
a yo vishvani shravasa tatanopashrota ma ivato vachamsi ||
verses.en: Prayers have been offered up-through love of glory: Vasishtha, honour Indra in the battle! He who with fame extends through all existence hears words which I, his faithful servant, utter.

verses.sa:
चक्रं यदस्याप्स्वा निषत्तमुतो तदस्मै मध्विच्चच्छद्यात् ।
पृथिव्यामतिषितं यदूधः पयो गोष्वदधा ओषधीषु ॥
verses.rom:
chakram yadasyapsva nishattamuto tadasmai madhvichchachchhadyat |
prithivyamatishitam yadudhah payo goshvadadha oshadhishu ||
verses.en: May the sweet Soma juices make him happy to cast his quoit that lies in depth of waters! Thou from the udder which o'er earth is fastened hast poured the milk into the kine and herbage.

verses.sa:
त्यमू षु वाजिनं देवजूतं सहोवानं तरुतारं रथानां ।
अरिष्टनेमिं पृतनाजमाशुं स्वस्तये तार्क्ष्यमिहा हुवेम ॥
verses.rom:
tyamu shu vajinam devajutam sahovanam tarutaram rathanam |
arishtanemim pritanajamashum svastaye tarkshyamiha huvema ||
verses.en: This vigorous one whom deities commission, the conqueror of cars, the strong and mighty, Swift, fleet to battle, with uninjured fellies, even Tarkshya for our weal will we call hither.

verses.sa:
त्रातारमिन्द्रमवितारमिन्द्रं हवेहवे सुहवं शूरमिन्द्रं ।
हुवे नु शक्रं पुरुहूतमिन्द्रमिदं हविर्मघवा वेत्विन्द्रः ॥
verses.rom:
trataramindramavitaramindram havehave suhavam shuramindram |
huve nu shakram puruhutamindramidam havirmaghava vetvindrah ||
verses.en: Indra the rescuer, Indra the helper, hero who listens at each invocation, Sakra I call, Indra invoked of many. May Indra Maghavan accept our presents!

verses.sa:
यजामह इन्द्रं वज्रदक्षिणं हरीणां रथ्य३ं विव्रतानां ।
प्र श्मश्रुभिर्दोधुवदूर्ध्वधा भुवद्वि सेनाभिर्भयमानो वि राधसा ॥
verses.rom:
yajamaha indram vajradakshinam harinam rathya3m vivratanam |
pra shmashrubhirdodhuvadurdhvadha bhuvadvi senabhirbhayamano vi radhasa ||
verses.en: Indra whose right hand wields the bolt we worship, driver of bay steeds seeking sundered courses. Shaking his beard with might he hath arisen, terrible with his weapons, with his bounty.

verses.sa:
सत्राहणं दाधृषिं तुम्रमिन्द्रं महामपारं वृशभं सुवज्रं ।
हन्ता यो वृत्रं सनितोत वाजं दाता मघानि मघवा सुराधाः ॥
verses.rom:
satrahanam dadhrishim tumramindram mahamaparam vrishabham suvajram |
hanta yo vritram sanitota vajam data maghani maghava suradhah ||
verses.en: The ever-slaying, bold and furious Indra, the bright bolt's Lord, the strong, the great, the boundless, Who slayeth Vritra and acquireth booty, giver of blessings, Maghavan the bounteous.

verses.sa:
यो नो वनुष्यन्नभिदाति मर्त उगणा वा मन्यमानस्तुरो वा ।
क्षिधी युधा शवसा वा तमिन्द्राभी ष्याम वृषमणस्त्वोताः ॥
verses.rom:
yo no vanushyannabhidati marta ugana va manyamanasturo va |
kshidhi yudha shavasa va tamindrabhi shyama vrishamanastvotah ||
verses.en: The man who lies in wait and fights against us, deeming himself a giant or a hero,-- By battle or with strength destroy him, Indra! With thy help, manly-souled! may we be victors!

verses.sa:
(आरण्यकगानम्)
यं वृत्रेषु क्षितय स्पर्धमाना यं युक्तेषु तुरयन्तो हवन्ते ।
यं शूरसातौ यमपामुपज्मन्यं विप्रासो वाजयन्ते स इन्द्रः ॥
verses.rom:
(aranyakaganam)
yam vritreshu kshitaya spardhamana yam yukteshu turayanto havante |
yam shurasatau yamapamupajmanyam vipraso vajayante sa indrah ||
verses.en: He whom men call when striving with their foemen, or speeding onward in array of battle, Whom bards incite where heroes win the booty, or in the way to waters, He is Indra.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रापर्वता बृहता रथेन वामीरिष आ वहतं सुवीराः ।
वीतं हव्यान्यध्वरेषु देवा वर्धेथां गीर्भीरिडया मदन्ता ॥
verses.rom:
indraparvata brihata rathena vamirisha a vahatam suvirah |
vitam havyanyadhvareshu deva vardhetham girbhiridaya madanta ||
verses.en: On a high car, O Parvata and Indra, bring pleasant viands, with brave heroes, hither! Enjoy our presents, Gods, at sacrifices: wax strong by hymns, rejoice in our oblation!

verses.sa:
इन्द्राय गिरो अनिशितसर्गा अपः प्रैरयत्सगरस्य बुध्नात् ।
यो अक्षेणेव चक्रियौ शचीभिर्विष्वक्तस्तम्भ पृथिवीमुत द्यां ॥
verses.rom:
indraya giro anishitasarga apah prairayatsagarasya budhnat |
yo aksheneva chakriyau shachibhirvishvaktastambha prithivimuta dyam ||
verses.en: In ceaseless flow hath he poured forth his praises, as waters from the ocean's depth, to Indra, Who to his car on both its sides securely hath fixed the earth and heaven as with an axle.

verses.sa:
आ त्वा सखायः सख्या ववृत्युस्तिरः पुरू चिदर्णवां जगम्याः ।
पितुर्नपातमा दधित वेधा अस्मिन्क्षये प्रतरां दीद्यानः ॥
verses.rom:
a tva sakhayah sakhya vavrityustirah puru chidarnavam jagamyah |
piturnapatama dadhita vedha asminkshaye prataram didyanah ||
verses.en: May our friends turn thee hitherward to friendship! Mayst thou approach us even o'er many rivers! May the Disposer, radiant in this mansion with special lustre, bring the father's offspring!

verses.sa:
को अद्य युङ्क्ते धुरि गा ऋतस्य शिमीवतो भामिनो दुर्हृणायून् ।
आसन्नेषामप्सुवाहो मयोभून्य एषां भृत्यामृणधत्स जीवात् ॥
verses.rom:
ko adya yunkte dhuri ga ritasya shimivato bhamino durhrinayun |
asanneshamapsuvaho mayobhunya esham bhrityamrinadhatsa jivat ||
verses.en: Who yokes to-day unto the pole of Order the strong and passionate steers of checkless spirit, Health-bringing, bearing in their mouths no fodder? Long shall he live who richly pays their service.

verses.sa:
गायन्ति त्वा गायत्रिणोऽर्चन्त्यर्कमर्किणः।
ब्रह्माणस्त्वा शतक्रत उद्वंशमिव येमिरे ॥
verses.rom:
gayanti tva gayatrino'rchantyarkamarkinah|
brahmanastva shatakrata udvamshamiva yemire ||
verses.en: The singers hymn thee, they who chant the psalm of praise are lauding thee. The Brahmans have exalted thee, O Satakratu, like a pole.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रं विश्वा अवीवृधन्त्समुद्रव्यचसं गिरः।
रथीतमं रथीनां वाजानां सत्पतिं पतिं ॥
verses.rom:
indram vishva avivridhantsamudravyachasam girah|
rathitamam rathinam vajanam satpatim patim ||
verses.en: All sacred-songs have magnified Indra expansive as the sea, Best of all warriors borne on cars, the Lord of heroes, Lord of strength.

verses.sa:
इममिन्द्र सुतं पिब ज्येष्ठममर्त्यं मदं।
शुक्रस्य त्वाभ्यक्षरन्धारा ऋतस्य सादने ॥
verses.rom:
imamindra sutam piba jyeshthamamartyam madam|
shukrasya tvabhyaksharandhara ritasya sadane ||
verses.en: This poured libation, Indra, drink, immortal, gladdening, excellent: Streams of the bright have flowed to thee here at the seat of holy Law.

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्र चित्र म इह नास्ति त्वादातमद्रिवः।
राधस्तन्नो विदद्वस उभयाहस्त्या भर ॥
verses.rom:
yadindra chitra ma iha nasti tvadatamadrivah|
radhastanno vidadvasa ubhayahastya bhara ||
verses.en: Stone-darting Indra, wondrous God, what wealth thou hast not given me here, That bounty, treasure-finder! bring, filling full both thy hands, to us!

verses.sa:
श्रुधी हवं तिरश्च्या इन्द्र यस्त्वा सपर्यति।
सुवीर्यस्य गोमतो रायस्पूर्धि महां असि ॥
verses.rom:
shrudhi havam tirashchya indra yastva saparyati|
suviryasya gomato rayaspurdhi maham asi ||
verses.en: O Indra, hear Tiraschi's call, the call of him who serveth thee! Satisfy him with wealth of kine and valiant offspring! Great art thou.

verses.sa:
असावि सोम इन्द्र ते शविष्ठ धृष्णवा गहि।
आ त्वा पृणक्त्विन्द्रियं रजः सूर्यो न रश्मिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
asavi soma indra te shavishtha dhrishnava gahi|
a tva prinaktvindriyam rajah suryo na rashmibhih ||
verses.en: This Soma hath been pressed for thee, O Indra: bold one, mightiest, come! May Indra-vigour fill thee full, as Surya fills mid-air with rays

verses.sa:
एन्द्र याहि हरिभिरुप कण्वस्य सुष्टुतिं।
दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
verses.rom:
endra yahi haribhirupa kanvasya sushtutim|
divo amushya shasato divam yaya divavaso ||
verses.en: Come hither, Indra, with thy bays, come thou to Kanva's eulogy! Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day! have gone to heaven.

verses.sa:
आ त्वा गिरो रथीरिवास्थुः सुतेषु गिर्वणः।
अभि त्वा समनूषत गावो वत्सं न धेनवः ॥
verses.rom:
a tva giro rathirivasthuh suteshu girvanah|
abhi tva samanushata gavo vatsam na dhenavah ||
verses.en: Song-lover! like a charioteer come songs to thee when Soma flows. Together, they have called to thee as mother-kine unto their calves.

verses.sa:
एतो न्विन्द्रं स्तवाम शुद्धं शुद्धेन साम्ना।
शुद्धैरुक्थैर्वावृध्वांसं शुद्धैराशीर्वान्ममत्तु ॥
verses.rom:
eto nvindram stavama shuddham shuddhena samna|
shuddhairukthairvavridhvamsam shuddhairashirvanmamattu ||
verses.en: Come now and let us glorify pure Indra with pure Sama hymn! Let milk-blent juice delight him made stronger with pure, pure songs of praise!

verses.sa:
यो रयिं वो रयिन्तमो यो द्युम्नैर्द्युम्नवत्तमः।
सोमः सुतः स इन्द्र तेऽस्ति स्वधापते मदः ॥
verses.rom:
yo rayim vo rayintamo yo dyumnairdyumnavattamah|
somah sutah sa indra te'sti svadhapate madah ||
verses.en: That which, most wealthy, makes you rich, in splendours most illustrious, Soma is pressed: thy gladdening drink, Indra libation's Lord! is this.

verses.sa:
प्रत्यस्मै पिपीषते विश्वानि विदुषे भर ।
अरङ्गमाय जग्मयेऽपश्चादध्वने नरः ॥
verses.rom:
pratyasmai pipishate vishvani vidushe bhara |
arangamaya jagmaye'pashchadadhvane narah ||
verses.en: Bring forth oblations to the God who knoweth all who fain would drink, The wanderer, lagging not behind the hero, coming nigh with speed!

verses.sa:
आ नो वयोवयःशयं महान्तं गह्वरेष्ठां महान्तं पूर्विनेष्ठां ।
उग्रं वचो अपावधीः ॥
verses.rom:
a no vayovayahshayam mahantam gahvareshtham mahantam purvineshtham |
ugram vacho apavadhih ||
verses.en: To us the mighty, lying in all vital power, who resteth in the deep, who standeth in the east. Drive thou the awful word away.

verses.sa:
आ त्वा रथं यथोतये सुम्नाय वर्तयामसि ।
तुविकूर्मिमृतीषहमिन्द्रं शविष्ठ सत्पतिं ॥
verses.rom:
a tva ratham yathotaye sumnaya vartayamasi |
tuvikurmimritishahamindram shavishtha satpatim ||
verses.en: Even as a car to give us aid, we draw thee nigh to favour us, Strong in thy deeds, quelling attack, Indra, Lord, mightiest! of the brave.

verses.sa:
स पूर्व्यो महोनां वेनः क्रतुभिरानजे ।
यस्य द्वारा मनुः पिता देवेषु धिय आनजे ॥
verses.rom:
sa purvyo mahonam venah kratubhiranaje |
yasya dvara manuh pita deveshu dhiya anaje ||
verses.en: With powers of mighty ones hath he, the friend, the ancient, been equipped, Through whom our father Manu made prayers efficacious with the Gods.

verses.sa:
यदी वहन्त्याशवो भ्राजमाना रथेष्वा ।
पिबन्तो मदिरं मधु तत्र श्रवांसि कृण्वते ॥
verses.rom:
yadi vahantyashavo bhrajamana ratheshva |
pibanto madiram madhu tatra shravamsi krinvate ||
verses.en: What time the swift and shining steeds, yoked to the chariots, draw them on, Drinking the sweet delightful juice, there men perform their glorious acts.

verses.sa:
त्यमु वो अप्रहणं गृणीषे शवसस्पतिं ।
इन्द्रं विश्वासाहं नरं शचिष्ठं विश्ववेदसं ॥
verses.rom:
tyamu vo aprahanam grinishe shavasaspatim |
indram vishvasaham naram shachishtham vishvavedasam ||
verses.en: Him for your sake I glorify as Lord of Strength who wrongeth none, Indra the hero, mightiest, all-conquering and omniscient.

verses.sa:
दधिक्राव्णो अकारिषं जिष्णोरश्वस्य वाजिनः ।
सुरभि नो मुखा करत्प्र न आयूंषि तारिषत् ॥
verses.rom:
dadhikravno akarisham jishnorashvasya vajinah |
surabhi no mukha karatpra na ayumshi tarishat ||
verses.en: I with my praise have glorified strong Dadhikravan, conquering steed Sweet may he make our mouths: may he prolong the days we have to live!

verses.sa:
पुरां भिन्दुर्युवा कविरमितौजा अजायत ।
इन्द्रो विश्वस्य कर्मणो धर्त्ता वज्री पुरुष्टुतः ॥
verses.rom:
puram bhinduryuva kaviramitauja ajayata |
indro vishvasya karmano dhartta vajri purushtutah ||
verses.en: Render of forts, the young, the wise, of strength unmeasured, was he born, Sustainer of each sacred rite, Indra, the Thunderer, much-extolled.

verses.sa:
प्रप्र वस्त्रिष्टुभमिषं वन्दद्वीरायेन्दवे ।
धिया वो मेधसातये पुरन्ध्या विवासति ॥
verses.rom:
prapra vastrishtubhamisham vandadvirayendave |
dhiya vo medhasataye purandhya vivasati ||
verses.en: Offer the triple sacred draught to Indu hero-worshipper! With hymn and plenty he invites you to complete the sacrifice.

verses.sa:
कश्यपस्य स्वर्विदो यावाहुः सयुजाविति ।
ययोर्विश्वमपि व्रतं यज्ञं धीरा निचाय्य ॥
verses.rom:
kashyapasya svarvido yavahuh sayujaviti |
yayorvishvamapi vratam yajnam dhira nichayya ||
verses.en: Those whom they call the attendant pair of Kasyapa who knows the light, Lords of each holy duty when the wise have honoured sacrifice.

verses.sa:
अर्चत प्रार्चता नरः प्रियमेधासो अर्चत ।
अर्चन्तु पुत्रका उत पुरमिद्धृष्ण्वर्चत ॥
verses.rom:
archata prarchata narah priyamedhaso archata |
archantu putraka uta puramiddhrishnvarchata ||
verses.en: Sing, sing ye forth your songs of praise, men, Priya-medhas, sing your songs: Yea, let young children sing their lauds: yea, glorify our firm stronghold!

verses.sa:
उक्थमिन्द्राय शंस्यं वर्धनं पुरुनिःषिधे ।
शक्रो यथा सुतेषु नो रारणत्सख्येषु च ॥
verses.rom:
ukthamindraya shamsyam vardhanam purunihshidhe |
shakro yatha suteshu no raranatsakhyeshu cha ||
verses.en: To Indra must a laud be said, a joy to him who freely gives, That Sakra may be joyful in our friendship and the juice we pour.

verses.sa:
विश्वानरस्य वस्पतिमनानतस्य शवसः ।
एवैश्च चर्षणीनामूती हुवे रथानां ॥
verses.rom:
vishvanarasya vaspatimananatasya shavasah |
evaishcha charshaninamuti huve rathanam ||
verses.en: Your Lord of might that ne'er hath bent, that ruleth over all mankind, I call, that he, as he is wont, may aid the chariots and the men.

verses.sa:
स घा यस्ते दिवो नरो धिया मर्तस्य शमतः ।
ऊती स बृहतो दिवो द्विषो अंहो न तरति ॥
verses.rom:
sa gha yaste divo naro dhiya martasya shamatah |
uti sa brihato divo dvisho amho na tarati ||
verses.en: Even he who is thine own, through thought of Heaven, of mortal man who toils, He with the help of lofty Dyaus comes safe through straits of enmity.

verses.sa:
विभोष्ट इन्द्र राधसो विभ्वी रातिः शतक्रतो ।
अथा नो विश्वचर्षणे द्युम्नं सुदत्र मंहय ॥
verses.rom:
vibhoshta indra radhaso vibhvi ratih shatakrato |
atha no vishvacharshane dyumnam sudatra mamhaya ||
verses.en: Wide, Indra Satakratu, spreads the bounty of thine ample grace: So, good and liberal giver, known to all men, send us splendid wealth!

verses.sa:
वयश्चित्ते पतत्रिणो द्विपाच्चतुष्पादर्जुनि ।
उषः प्रारन्नृतूंरनु दिवो अन्तेभ्यस्परि ॥
verses.rom:
vayashchitte patatrino dvipachchatushpadarjuni |
ushah prarannritumranu divo antebhyaspari ||
verses.en: Bright Ushas, when thy times return, all quadrupeds and bipeds stir, And round about flock winged birds from all the boundaries of heaven.

verses.sa:
अमी ये देवा स्थन मध्य आ रोचने दिवः ।
कद्व ऋतं कदमृतं का प्रत्ना व आहुतिः ॥
verses.rom:
ami ye deva sthana madhya a rochane divah |
kadva ritam kadamritam ka pratna va ahutih ||
verses.en: Ye Gods who yonder have your home amid the luminous realm of heaven, What count ye right? what endless life? What is the ancient call on you?

verses.sa:
ऋचं साम यजामहे याभ्यां कर्माणि कृण्वते ।
वि ते सदसि राजतो यज्ञं देवेषु वक्षतः ॥
verses.rom:
richam sama yajamahe yabhyam karmani krinvate |
vi te sadasi rajato yajnam deveshu vakshatah ||
verses.en: We offer laud and psalm wherewith men celebrate their holy rites. They govern at the sacred place and bear the sacrifice to Gods.

verses.sa:
विश्वाः पृतना अभिभूतरं नरः सजूस्ततक्षुरिन्द्रं जजनुश्च राजसे ।
क्रत्वे वरे स्थेमन्यामुरीमुतोग्रमोजिष्ठं तरसं तरस्विनं ॥
verses.rom:
vishvah pritana abhibhutaram narah sajustatakshurindram jajanushcha rajase |
kratve vare sthemanyamurimutogramojishtham tarasam tarasvinam ||
verses.en: Heroes of one accord brought forth and formed for kingship Indra who wins the victory in all encounters, For power, in firmness, in the field, the great destroyer, fierce and exceeding strong,rstalwart and full of vigour.

verses.sa:
श्रत्ते दधामि प्रथमाय मन्यवेऽहन्यद्दस्युं नर्यं विवेरपः ।
उभे यत्वा रोदसी धावतामनु भ्यसात्ते शुष्मात्पृथिवी चिदद्रिवः ॥
verses.rom:
shratte dadhami prathamaya manyave'hanyaddasyum naryam viverapah |
ubhe yatva rodasi dhavatamanu bhyasatte shushmatprithivi chidadrivah ||
verses.en: I trust in thy first wrathful deed, O Indra, when thou slewest Vritra and didst work to profit man; When the two world-halves fled for refuge unto thee, and earth even trembled at thy strength, O Thunder-armed!

verses.sa:
समेत विश्वा ओजसा पतिं दिवो य एक इद्भूरतिथिर्जनानाम्
स पूर्व्यो नूतनमाजिगीषं तं वर्त्तनीरनु वावृत एक इत् ॥
verses.rom:
sameta vishva ojasa patim divo ya eka idbhuratithirjananam
sa purvyo nutanamajigisham tam varttaniranu vavrita eka it ||
verses.en: Come all with might together to the Lord of heaven, the only one who is indeed the guestof men. He is the first: to him who fain would come to us all pathways turn; he is in truth the only one.

verses.sa:
इमे त इन्द्र ते वयं पुरुष्टुत ये त्वारभ्य चरामसि प्रभूवसो ।
न हि त्वदन्यो गिर्वणो गिरः सघत्क्षोणीरिव प्रति तद्धर्य नो वचः ॥
verses.rom:
ime ta indra te vayam purushtuta ye tvarabhya charamasi prabhuvaso |
na hi tvadanyo girvano girah saghatkshoniriva prati taddharya no vachah ||
verses.en: Thine, Indra, praised of many, excellently rich, are we who trusting in thy help draw near to thee. For none but thou, song-lover, shall receive our lauds: as Earth loves all her creatures, welcome this our hymn!

verses.sa:
चर्षणीधृतं मघवानमुक्थ्या३मिन्द्रं गिरो बृहतीरभ्यनूषत ।
वावृधानं पुरुहूतं सुवृक्तिभिरमर्त्यं जरमाणं दिवेदिवे ॥
verses.rom:
charshanidhritam maghavanamukthya3mindram giro brihatirabhyanushata |
vavridhanam puruhutam suvriktibhiramartyam jaramanam divedive ||
verses.en: High hymns have sounded forth the praise of Maghavan, supporter of mankind, of Indra meet for lauds; Him who hath waxen mighty, much-invoked with prayers, immortal one whose praise each day is sung aloud.

verses.sa:
अच्छा व इन्द्रं मतयः स्वर्युवः सध्रीचीर्विश्वा उशतीरनूषत ।
परि ष्वजन्त जनयो यथा पतिं मर्यं न शुन्ध्युं मघवानमूतये ॥
verses.rom:
achchha va indram matayah svaryuvah sadhrichirvishva ushatiranushata |
pari shvajanta janayo yatha patim maryam na shundhyum maghavanamutaye ||
verses.en: In perfect unison have all your longing hymns that find the light of heaven sounded forth Indra's praise. As wives embrace their lord, the comely bridegroom, so they compass Maghavan about that he may help.

verses.sa:
अभि त्यं मेषं पुरुहूतमृग्मियमिन्द्रं गीर्भिर्मदता वस्वो अर्णवं ।
यस्य द्यावो न विचरन्ति मानुषं भुजे मंहिष्ठमभि विप्रमर्चत ॥
verses.rom:
abhi tyam mesham puruhutamrigmiyamindram girbhirmadata vasvo arnavam |
yasya dyavo na vicharanti manusham bhuje mamhishthamabhi vipramarchata ||
verses.en: Make glad with songs that Ram whom many men invoke, worthy hymns of praise, Indra the sea of wealth; Whose boons spread like the heavens, the - lover of mankind: sing praise to him the Sage, most liberal for our good!

verses.sa:
त्यं सु मेषं महया स्वर्विदं शतं यस्य सुभुवः साकमीरते ।
अत्यं न वाजं हवनस्यदं रथमेन्द्रं ववृत्यामवसे सुवृक्तिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
tyam su mesham mahaya svarvidam shatam yasya subhuvah sakamirate |
atyam na vajam havanasyadam rathamendram vavrityamavase suvriktibhih ||
verses.en: I glorify that Ram who finds the light of heaven, whose hundred strong and mighty ones go forth with him. With prayers may I turn hither Indra to mine aid;-the car which like a swift steed hasteth to the call!

verses.sa:
घृतवती भुवनानामभिश्रियोर्वी पृथ्वी मधुदुघे सुपेशसा ।
द्यावापृथिवी वरुणस्य धर्मणा विष्कभिते अजरे भूरिरेतसा ॥
verses.rom:
ghritavati bhuvananamabhishriyorvi prithvi madhudughe supeshasa |
dyavaprithivi varunasya dharmana vishkabhite ajare bhuriretasa ||
verses.en: Filled full of fatness, compassing all things that be, wide, spacious, dropping meath, beautiful in their form, The heaven and the earth by Varuna's decree, unwasting, rich in germs, stand parted each from each.

verses.sa:
उभे यदिन्द्र रोदसी आपप्राथोषा इव ।
महान्तं त्वा महीनां सम्राजं चर्षणीनां ।
देवी जनित्र्यजीजनद्भद्रा जनित्र्यजीजनत् ॥
verses.rom:
ubhe yadindra rodasi apaprathosha iva |
mahantam tva mahinam samrajam charshaninam |
devi janitryajijanadbhadra janitryajijanat ||
verses.en: As like the Morning, thou hast filled, O Indra, both the earth. and heaven, So as the mighty one, great King of all the mighty race of men, the Goddess mother brought thee forth, the blessed mother gave thee life.

verses.sa:
प्र मन्दिने पितुमदर्चता वचो यः कृष्णगर्भा निरहन्नृजिश्वना ।
अवस्यवो वृषणं वज्रदक्षिणं मरुत्वन्तं सख्याय हुवेमहि ॥
verses.rom:
pra mandine pitumadarchata vacho yah krishnagarbha nirahannrijishvana |
avasyavo vrishanam vajradakshinam marutvantam sakhyaya huvemahi ||
verses.en: Sing, with oblation, praise to him who maketh glad, who with. Rijisvan drove the dusky brood away! Let us, desiring help, call him for friendship, him the strong, the Marut-girt, whose right hand wields the bolt!

verses.sa:
इन्द्र सुतेषु सोमेषु क्रतुं पुनीष उक्थ्यं ।
विदे वृधस्य दक्षस्य महां हि षः ॥
verses.rom:
indra suteshu someshu kratum punisha ukthyam |
vide vridhasya dakshasya maham hi shah ||

verses.sa:
तमु अभि प्र गायत पुरुहूतं पुरुष्टुतं ।
इन्द्रं गीर्भिस्तविषमा विवासत ॥
verses.rom:
tamu abhi pra gayata puruhutam purushtutam |
indram girbhistavishama vivasata ||

verses.sa:
तं ते मदं गृणीमसि वृषणं पृक्षु सासहिं ।
उ लोककृत्नुमद्रिवो हरिश्रियं ॥
verses.rom:
tam te madam grinimasi vrishanam prikshu sasahim |
u lokakritnumadrivo harishriyam ||

verses.sa:
यत्सोममिन्द्र विष्णवि यद्वा घ त्रित आप्त्ये ।
यद्वा मरुत्सु मन्दसे समिन्दुभिः ॥
verses.rom:
yatsomamindra vishnavi yadva gha trita aptye |
yadva marutsu mandase samindubhih ||

verses.sa:
एदु मधोर्मदिन्तरं सिञ्चाध्वर्यो अन्धसः ।
एवा हि वीरस्तवते सदावृधः ॥
verses.rom:
edu madhormadintaram sinchadhvaryo andhasah |
eva hi virastavate sadavridhah ||

verses.sa:
एन्दुमिन्द्राय सिञ्चत पिबाति सोम्यं मधु ।
प्र राधांसि चोदयते महित्वना ॥
verses.rom:
endumindraya sinchata pibati somyam madhu |
pra radhamsi chodayate mahitvana ||

verses.sa:
एतो न्विन्द्रं स्तवाम सखायः स्तोम्यं नरं ।
कृष्टीर्यो विश्वा अभ्यस्त्येक इथ् ॥
verses.rom:
eto nvindram stavama sakhayah stomyam naram |
krishtiryo vishva abhyastyeka ith ||

verses.sa:
इन्द्राय साम गायत विप्राय बृहते बृहत् ।
ब्रह्मकृते विपश्चिते पनस्यवे ॥
verses.rom:
indraya sama gayata vipraya brihate brihat |
brahmakrite vipashchite panasyave ||

verses.sa:
य एक इद्विदयते वसु मर्ताय दाशुषे ।
ईशानो अप्रतिष्कुत इन्द्रो अङ्ग ॥
verses.rom:
ya eka idvidayate vasu martaya dashushe |
ishano apratishkuta indro anga ||

verses.sa:
सखाय आ शिषामहे ब्रह्मेन्द्राय वज्रिणे ।
स्तुष ऊ षु वो नृतमाय धृष्णवे ॥
verses.rom:
sakhaya a shishamahe brahmendraya vajrine |
stusha u shu vo nritamaya dhrishnave ||

prose.en:
Sing forth to him whom many men invoke, to him whom many laud: Invite the potent Indra with your songs of praise

We sing this strong and wild delight of thine which conquer; in the fray, Which, Caster of the Stone! gives room and shines like gold,

Whether thou drink the Soma by Vishnu's or Trita Aptya's side, Or with the Maruts, Indra! quaff the following drops.

Come, priest, and of the savoury juice pour forth a yet more gladdening draught: So is the hero praised who ever prospers us.

Pour out the drops for Indra; let him drink the meath of Soma juice! He through his majesty sends forth his bounteous gifts.

Come, sing we praise to Indra, friends! the hero who deserves the laud, Him who with none to aid o'ercomes all tribes of men.

Sing ye a psalm to Indra, sing a great song to the lofty Sage, To him who maketh prayer, inspired who loveth laud!

He who alone bestoweth wealth on mortal man who offereth gifts Is Indra only, potent Lord whom none resist.

Companions, let us learn a prayer to Indra, to the Thunderer, To glorify your bold and most heroic friend!

verses.sa:
गृणे तदिन्द्र ते शव उपमां देवतातये ।
यद्धंसि वृत्रमोजसा शचीपते ॥
verses.rom:
grine tadindra te shava upamam devatataye |
yaddhamsi vritramojasa shachipate ||
verses.en: Indra, this might of thine I praise most highly for the sacrifice That thou, O Lord of Power, dost slay Vritra with might

verses.sa:
यस्य त्यच्छम्बरं मदे दिवोदासाय रन्धयन् ।
अयं स सोम इन्द्र ते सुतः पिब ॥
verses.rom:
yasya tyachchhambaram made divodasaya randhayan |
ayam sa soma indra te sutah piba ||
verses.en: For thee this Soma hath been pressed, in whose wild joy thou madest once Sambara Divodasa's prey: O Indra, drink!

verses.sa:
एन्द्र नो गधि प्रिय सत्राजिदगोह्य ।
गिरिर्न विश्वतः पृथुः पतिर्दिवः ॥
verses.rom:
endra no gadhi priya satrajidagohya |
girirna vishvatah prithuh patirdivah ||
verses.en: Come unto us, O Indra, dear, still conquering, unconcealable! Wide as a mountain spread on all sides, Lord of heaven!

verses.sa:
य इन्द्र सोमपातमो मदः शविष्ठ चेतति ।
येना हंसि न्या३त्रिणं तमीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
ya indra somapatamo madah shavishtha chetati |
yena hamsi nya3trinam tamimahe ||
verses.en: Joy, mightiest Indra, that perceives, sprung from deep Soma draughts, whereby Thou smitest down the greedy fiend,-that joy we crave!

verses.sa:
तुचे तुनाय तत्सु नो द्राधीय आयुर्जीवसे ।
आदित्यासः समहसः कृणोतन ॥
verses.rom:
tuche tunaya tatsu no dradhiya ayurjivase |
adityasah samahasah krinotana ||
verses.en: Adityas, very mighty ones, grant to our children and our seed This lengthened term of life that they may live long days!

verses.sa:
वेत्था हि निरृतीनां वज्रहस्त परिवृजं ।
अहरहः शुन्ध्युः परिपदामिव ॥
verses.rom:
vettha hi nirritinam vajrahasta parivrijam |
aharahah shundhyuh paripadamiva ||
verses.en: Though knowest, Indra, Thunder-armed! how to avoid destructive powers, As one secure from pitfalls each returning day.

verses.sa:
अपामीवामप स्त्रिधमप सेधत दुर्मतिं ।
आदित्यासो युयोतना नो अंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
apamivamapa stridhamapa sedhata durmatim |
adityaso yuyotana no amhasah ||
verses.en: Drive ye disease and strife away, drive ye away malignity: Adityas, keep us far removed from sore distress!

verses.sa:
पिबा सोममिन्द्र मन्दतु त्वा यं ते सुषाव हर्यश्वाद्रिः ।
सोतुर्बाहुभ्यां सुयतो नार्वा ॥
verses.rom:
piba somamindra mandatu tva yam te sushava haryashvadrih |
soturbahubhyam suyato narva ||
verses.en: Drive Soma, Indra, Lord of bays! and let it cheer thee: the stone, like a well-guided courser,

verses.sa:
अभ्रातृव्यो अना त्वमनापिरिन्द्र जनुषा सनादसि ।
युधेदापित्वमिच्छसे ॥
verses.rom:
abhratrivyo ana tvamanapirindra janusha sanadasi |
yudhedapitvamichchhase ||
verses.en: Still, Indra, from all ancient time rivalless ever and companionless art thou: Thou seekest friendship but in war.

verses.sa:
यो न इदमिदं पुरा प्र वस्य आनिनाय तमु व स्तुषे ।
सखाय इन्द्रमूतये ॥
verses.rom:
yo na idamidam pura pra vasya aninaya tamu va stushe |
sakhaya indramutaye ||
verses.en: Him who of old hath broucht to us this and that blessing, him I magnify for you, Even Indra, O my friends, for help.

verses.sa:
आ गन्ता मा रिषण्यत प्रस्थावानो माप स्थात समन्यवः ।
दृढा चिद्यमयिष्णवः ॥
verses.rom:
a ganta ma rishanyata prasthavano mapa sthata samanyavah |
dridha chidyamayishnavah ||
verses.en: Fail not when marching onward: come hither, like-spirited, stay not far away Ye who can tame even what is firm!

verses.sa:
आ याह्ययमिन्दवेऽश्वपते गोपत उर्वरापते ।
सोमं सोमपते पिब ॥
verses.rom:
a yahyayamindave'shvapate gopata urvarapate |
somam somapate piba ||
verses.en: Come hither to the dropping juice, O Lord of cornland. Lord of horses, Lord of kine: Drink thou the Soma, Soma's Lord!

verses.sa:
त्वया ह स्विद्युजा वयं प्रति श्वसन्तं वृषभ ब्रुवीमहि ।
संस्थे जनस्य गोमतः ॥
verses.rom:
tvaya ha svidyuja vayam prati shvasantam vrishabha bruvimahi |
samsthe janasya gomatah ||
verses.en: Hero, may we, with thee for friend, withstand the man who pants against us in his wrath, In fight with people rich in kine!

verses.sa:
गावश्चिद्धा समन्यवः सजात्येन मरुतः सबन्धवः ।
रिहते ककुभो मिथः ॥
verses.rom:
gavashchiddha samanyavah sajatyena marutah sabandhavah |
rihate kakubho mithah ||
verses.en: Yea, kin by common ancestry, the Maruts, even the oxen, close united friends! Are licking one another's back.

verses.sa:
त्वं न इन्द्रा भर ओजो नृम्णं शतक्रतो विचर्षणे ।
आ वीरं पृतनासहं ॥
verses.rom:
tvam na indra bhara ojo nrimnam shatakrato vicharshane |
a viram pritanasaham ||
verses.en: O Indra, bring great strength to us, bring valour, Satakratu, thou most active, bring A hero conquering in war!

verses.sa:
अधा हीन्द्र गिर्वण उप त्वा काम ईमहे ससृग्महे ।
उदेव ग्मन्त उदभिः ॥
verses.rom:
adha hindra girvana upa tva kama imahe sasrigmahe |
udeva gmanta udabhih ||
verses.en: So, Indra, friend of song, do we draw nigh to thee with longing; we have streamed to thee Coming like floods that follow floods

verses.sa:
सीदन्तस्ते वयो यथा गोश्रीते मधौ मदिरे विवक्षणे ।
अभि त्वामिन्द्र नोनुमः ॥
verses.rom:
sidantaste vayo yatha goshrite madhau madire vivakshane |
abhi tvamindra nonumah ||
verses.en: Sitting like birds beside thy meath, mingled with milk, which gladdeneth and exalteth thee, Indra, to thee we sing aloud.

verses.sa:
वयमु त्वामपूर्व्य स्थूरं न कच्चिद्भरन्तोऽवस्यवः ।
वज्रिञ्चित्रं हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
vayamu tvamapurvya sthuram na kachchidbharanto'vasyavah |
vajrinchitram havamahe ||
verses.en: We call on thee, O matchless one! We, seeking help, possessing nothing firm ourselves, Call on thee, wondrous, Thunder-armed.

verses.sa:
स्वादोरित्था विषूवतो मधोः पिबन्ति गौर्यः ।
या इन्द्रेण सयावरीर्वृष्णा मदन्ति शोभथा वस्वीरनु स्वराज्यं ॥
verses.rom:
svadorittha vishuvato madhoh pibanti gauryah |
ya indrena sayavarirvrishna madanti shobhatha vasviranu svarajyam ||
verses.en: The juice of Soma thus diffused, sweet to the taste the bright cows drink, Who travelling in splendour close to mighty Indra's side rejoice, good in their own supremacy.

verses.sa:
इत्था हि सोम इन्मदो ब्रह्म चकार वर्धनं ।
शविष्ठ वज्रिन्नोजसा पृथिव्या निः शशा अहिमर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यं ॥
verses.rom:
ittha hi soma inmado brahma chakara vardhanam |
shavishtha vajrinnojasa prithivya nih shasha ahimarchannanu svarajyam ||
verses.en: Thus hath the Soma, gladdening draught, produced the prayer that giveth joy: Thou, mightiest, Thunder-armed, hast driven by force the Dragon from the earth, lauding thine own supremacy.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो मदाय वावृधे शवसे वृत्रहा नृभिः ।
तमिन्महत्स्वाजिषूतिमर्भे हवामहे स वाजेषु प्र नोऽविषत् ॥
verses.rom:
indro madaya vavridhe shavase vritraha nribhih |
taminmahatsvajishutimarbhe havamahe sa vajeshu pra no'vishat ||
verses.en: By men hath Indra been advanced, the Vritra-slayer, to joy and strength. Him only we invoke for help in battles whether great or small: be he our aid in deeds of might!

verses.sa:
इन्द्र तुभ्यमिदद्रिवोऽनुत्तं वज्रिन्वीर्यं ।
यद्ध त्यं मायिनं मृगं तव त्यन्माययावधीरर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यं ॥
verses.rom:
indra tubhyamidadrivo'nuttam vajrinviryam |
yaddha tyam mayinam mrigam tava tyanmayayavadhirarchannanu svarajyam ||
verses.en: Unconquered strength is only thine, Indra, Stonecaster, Thunder-armed! When thou with thy surpassing power smotest to death that guileful beast, lauding thine own supremacy.

verses.sa:
प्रेह्यभीहि धृष्णुहि न ते वज्रो नि यंसते ।
इन्द्र नृम्णं हि ते शवो हनो वृत्रं जया अपोऽर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यं ॥
verses.rom:
prehyabhihi dhrishnuhi na te vajro ni yamsate |
indra nrimnam hi te shavo hano vritram jaya apo'rchannanu svarajyam ||
verses.en: Go forward, meet the foe, be bold; thy bolt of thunder is not checked! Manliness, Indra, is thy strength. Slay Vritra, make the waters thine, lauding thine own supremacy!

verses.sa:
यदुदीरत आजयो धृष्णवे धीयते धनं ।
युङ्क्ष्वा मदच्युता हरी कं हनः कं वसौ दधोऽस्मां इन्द्र वसौ दधः ॥
verses.rom:
yadudirata ajayo dhrishnave dhiyate dhanam |
yunkshva madachyuta hari kam hanah kam vasau dadho'smam indra vasau dadhah ||
verses.en: When war and battles are on foot, booty is offered to the bold. Yoke thou thy wildly-rushing bays. Whom wilt thou slay, and whom enrich? Do thou, O Indra, make us rich!

verses.sa:
अक्षन्नमीमदन्त ह्यव प्रिया अधूषत ।
अस्तोषत स्वभानवो विप्रा नविष्ठया मती योजा न्विन्द्र ते हरी ॥
verses.rom:
akshannamimadanta hyava priya adhushata |
astoshata svabhanavo vipra navishthaya mati yoja nvindra te hari ||
verses.en: Wcll have they eaten and rejoiced; the friends have risen and passed away: The sages luminous in themselves have praised thee with their latest hymn. Now, Indra, yoke thy two bay steeds!

verses.sa:
उपो षु शृणुही गिरो मघवन्मातथा इव ।
कदा नः सूनृतावतः कर इदर्थयास इद्योजा न्विन्द्र ते हरी ॥
verses.rom:
upo shu shrinuhi giro maghavanmatatha iva |
kada nah sunritavatah kara idarthayasa idyoja nvindra te hari ||
verses.en: Graciously listen to our songs. Maghavan, be not negligent! When wilt thou make us glorious? Make this, only this thine end and aim. Now, Indra! yoke thy two bay steeds.

verses.sa:
चन्द्रमा अप्स्वा३न्तरा सुपर्णो धावते दिवि ।
न वो हिरण्यनेमयः पदं विन्दन्ति विद्युतो वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी ॥
verses.rom:
chandrama apsva3ntara suparno dhavate divi |
na vo hiranyanemayah padam vindanti vidyuto vittam me asya rodasi ||
verses.en: Within the waters runs the Moon, he with the beauteous wings in heaven. Ye lightnings with your golden wheels, men find not your abiding-place. Mark this my woe, ye Earth and Sky!

verses.sa:
प्रति प्रियतमं रथं वृषणं वसुवाहनं ।
स्तोता वामश्विनावृषि स्तोमेभिर्भूषति प्रति माध्वी मम श्रुतं हवं ॥
verses.rom:
prati priyatamam ratham vrishanam vasuvahanam |
stota vamashvinavrishi stomebhirbhushati prati madhvi mama shrutam havam ||
verses.en: To meet your treasure-bringing car, the mighty car most dear to us. Asvins, the Rishi is prepared, your worshipper, with songs of praise. Lovers of sweetness, hear my call!

verses.sa:
आ ते अग्न इधीमहि द्युमन्तं देवाजरं ।
युद्ध स्या ते पनीयसी समिद्दीदयति द्यवीषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
verses.rom:
a te agna idhimahi dyumantam devajaram |
yuddha sya te paniyasi samiddidayati dyavisham stotribhya a bhara ||
verses.en: O Agni, God, we kindle thee, refulgent, wasting not away, That this more glorious fuel may send forth for thee its shine to heaven. Bring food to those who sing thy praise!

verses.sa:
आग्निं न स्ववृक्तिभिर्होतारं त्वा वृणीमहे ।
शीरं पावकशोचिषं वि वो मदे यज्ञेषु स्तीर्णबर्हिषं विवक्षसे ॥
verses.rom:
agnim na svavriktibhirhotaram tva vrinimahe |
shiram pavakashochisham vi vo made yajneshu stirnabarhisham vivakshase ||
verses.en: With offerings of our own we choose thee, Agni, as our Hotar priest, Piercing and brightly shining-at your glad carouse-served with trimmed grass at sacrifice. Thou waxest great.

verses.sa:
महे नो अद्य बोधयोषो राये दिवित्मती ।
यथा चिन्नो अबोधयः सत्यश्रवसि वाय्ये सुजाते अश्वसूनृते ॥
verses.rom:
mahe no adya bodhayosho raye divitmati |
yatha chinno abodhayah satyashravasi vayye sujate ashvasunrite ||
verses.en: O heavenly Dawn, awaken us to ample opulence to-day, Even as thou didst waken us with Satyasravas, Vayya's son, high born! delightful with thy steeds!

verses.sa:
भद्रं नो अपि वातय मनो दक्षमुत क्रतुं ।
अथा ते सख्ये अन्धसो वि वो मदे रणा गावो न यवसे विवक्षसे ॥
verses.rom:
bhadram no api vataya mano dakshamuta kratum |
atha te sakhye andhaso vi vo made rana gavo na yavase vivakshase ||
verses.en: Send us a mind that brings delight, send energy and mental power. Then-at your glad carouse-let men joy in thy love, sweet juice! as kine in pasturage. Thou waxest great,

verses.sa:
क्रत्वा महां अनुष्वधं भीम आ वावृते शवः ।
श्रिय ऋष्व उपाकयोर्नि शिप्री हरिवां दधे हस्तयोर्वज्रमायसं ॥
verses.rom:
kratva maham anushvadham bhima a vavrite shavah |
shriya rishva upakayorni shipri harivam dadhe hastayorvajramayasam ||
verses.en: Great, as his nature is, through power, terrible, he hath waxed in strength, Lord of bay steeds, strong-jawed, sublime, he in joined hands for glory's sake hath grasped his iron thunderbolt.

verses.sa:
स घा तं वृषणं रथमधि तिष्ठाति गोविदं ।
यः पात्रं हारियोजनं पूर्णमिन्द्रा चिकेतति योजा न्विन्द्र ते हरी ॥
verses.rom:
sa gha tam vrishanam rathamadhi tishthati govidam |
yah patram hariyojanam purnamindra chiketati yoja nvindra te hari ||
verses.en: He, Indra, verily will mount the powerful car that finds the kine, Who thinks upon the well-filled bowl, the tawny coursers' harnesser. Now, Indra, yoke thy two bay steeds!

verses.sa:
अग्निं तं मन्ये यो वसुरस्तं यं यन्ति धेनवः ।
अस्तमर्वन्त आशवोऽस्तं नित्यासो वाजिन इषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
verses.rom:
agnim tam manye yo vasurastam yam yanti dhenavah |
astamarvanta ashavo'stam nityaso vajina isham stotribhya a bhara ||
verses.en: I think of Agni who is kind, whom, as their home, the milch-kine seek: Whom fleet-foot coursers seek as home, and strong enduring steeds as home. Bring food to those who sing thy praise!

verses.sa:
न तमंहो न दुरितं देवासो अष्ट मर्त्यं ।
सजोषसो यमर्यमा मित्रो नयति वरुणो अति द्विषः ॥
verses.rom:
na tamamho na duritam devaso ashta martyam |
sajoshaso yamaryama mitro nayati varuno ati dvishah ||
verses.en: No peril, no severe distress, ye Gods, affects the mortal man Whom Aryaman and Mitra lead, and Varuna, of one accord, beyond his foes.

verses.sa: परि प्र धन्वेन्द्राय सोम स्वादुर्मित्राय पूष्णे भगाय ॥
verses.rom: pari pra dhanvendraya soma svadurmitraya pushne bhagaya ||
verses.en: Flow forth, O Soma, flow thou onward, sweet to Indra's Mitra's, Pushan's, Bhaga's taste.

verses.sa:
पर्यू षु प्र धन्व वाजसातये परि वृत्राणि सक्षणिः ।
द्विषस्तरध्या ऋणया न ईरसे ॥
verses.rom:
paryu shu pra dhanva vajasataye pari vritrani sakshanih |
dvishastaradhya rinaya na irase ||
verses.en: Run forth to battle, conquering the Vritras; thou speedest to quell the foes like one exacting debts.

verses.sa: पवस्व सोम महान्त्समुद्रः पिता देवानां विश्वाभि धाम ॥
verses.rom: pavasva soma mahantsamudrah pita devanam vishvabhi dhama ||
verses.en: Flow onward, Soma, as a mighty sea, as Father of the Gods, to every form.

verses.sa: पवस्व सोम महे दक्षायाश्वो न निक्तो वाजी धनाय ॥
verses.rom: pavasva soma mahe dakshayashvo na nikto vaji dhanaya ||
verses.en: Flow onward, Soma, flow for mighty strength, as a strong courser, bathed, to win the prize.

verses.sa: इन्दुः पविष्ट चारुर्मदायापामुपस्थे कविर्भगाय ॥
verses.rom: induh pavishta charurmadayapamupasthe kavirbhagaya ||
verses.en: Fair Indu hath flowed on for rapturous joy, sage, for good fortune, in the waters' lap.

verses.sa:
अनु हि त्वा सुतं सोम मदामसि महे समर्यराज्ये ।
वाजां अभि पवमान प्र गाहसे ॥
verses.rom:
anu hi tva sutam soma madamasi mahe samaryarajye |
vajam abhi pavamana pra gahase ||
verses.en: In thee, effused. O Soma, we rejoice ourselves for great supremacy in fight: Thou, Pavamana, enterest into mighty deeds.

verses.sa: क ईं व्यक्ता नरः सनीडा रुद्रस्य मर्या अथ स्वश्वाः ॥
verses.rom: ka im vyakta narah sanida rudrasya marya atha svashvah ||
verses.en: Who are these radiant men in serried rank, Rudra's young heroes, too, with noble steeds?

verses.sa:
अग्ने तमद्याश्वं न स्तोमैः क्रतुं न भद्रं हृदिस्पृशं ।
ऋध्यामा त ओहैः ॥
verses.rom:
agne tamadyashvam na stomaih kratum na bhadram hridisprisham |
ridhyama ta ohaih ||
verses.en: Agni, with hymns may we now accomplish that which thou lovest, Strength, like a horse, auspicious strength with service.

verses.sa:
आविर्मर्या आ वाजं वाजिनो अग्मं देवस्य सवितुः सवं ।
स्वर्गां अर्वन्तो जयत ॥
verses.rom:
avirmarya a vajam vajino agmam devasya savituh savam |
svargam arvanto jayata ||
verses.en: The strong youths have come forth to view, to show their strength, God Savitar's quickening energy: Ye warrior horsemen, win the heavens.

verses.sa: पवस्व सोम द्युम्नी सुधारो महां अवीनामनुपूर्व्यः ॥
verses.rom: pavasva soma dyumni sudharo maham avinamanupurvyah ||
verses.en: Soma, flow splendid with thy copious stream in due succession through the ample fleece.

verses.sa: विश्वतोदावन्विश्वतो न आ भर यं त्वा शविष्ठमीमहे ॥
verses.rom: vishvatodavanvishvato na a bhara yam tva shavishthamimahe ||
verses.en: Giver from all sides, bring to us from every side, thou whom as strongest we entreat!

verses.sa: एष ब्रह्मा य ऋत्विय इन्द्रो नाम श्रुतो गृणे ॥
verses.rom: esha brahma ya ritviya indro nama shruto grine ||
verses.en: This Brahman, comer at due time, named Indra, is renowned and praised.

verses.sa: ब्रह्माण इन्द्रं महयन्तो अर्कैरवर्धयन्नहये हन्तवा उ ॥
verses.rom: brahmana indram mahayanto arkairavardhayannahaye hantava u ||
verses.en: The Brahmans with their hymns exalting Indra increased his strength that he might slaughter Ahi.

verses.sa: अनवस्ते रथमश्वाय तक्षुस्त्वष्टा वज्रं पुरुहूत द्युमन्तं ॥
verses.rom: anavaste rathamashvaya takshustvashta vajram puruhuta dyumantam ||
verses.en: Anavas wrought a chariot for thy courser, and Tvashtar, much-invoked! the bolt that gitters:

verses.sa: शं पदं मघं रयीषिणो न काममव्रतो हिनोति न स्पृशद्रयिं ॥
verses.rom: sham padam magham rayishino na kamamavrato hinoti na sprishadrayim ||
verses.en: Rest, wealth to him who longs for wealth! the riteless stirs not his love nor wins his way to riches.

verses.sa: सदा गावः शुचयो विश्वधायसः सदा देवा अरेपसः ॥
verses.rom: sada gavah shuchayo vishvadhayasah sada deva arepasah ||
verses.en: The cows are ever pure and all-supporting, the Gods are ever free from stain and blemish.

verses.sa: आ याहि वनसा सह गावः सचन्त वर्त्तनिं यदूधभिः ॥
verses.rom: a yahi vanasa saha gavah sachanta varttanim yadudhabhih ||
verses.en: With all thy beauty come! The kine approaching with full udders follow on thy path.

verses.sa: उप प्रक्षे मधुमति क्षियन्तः पुष्येम रयिं धीमहे त इन्द्र ॥
verses.rom: upa prakshe madhumati kshiyantah pushyema rayim dhimahe ta indra ||
verses.en: May we, inhabiting a meath-rich dwelling, increase our wealth, and think of thee, O Indra!

verses.sa: अर्चन्त्यर्कं मरुतः स्वर्क्का आ स्तोभति श्रुतो युवा स इन्द्रः ॥
verses.rom: archantyarkam marutah svarkka a stobhati shruto yuva sa indrah ||
verses.en: The Maruts with fair hymns chant out their praise-song: this Indra, famed and youthful, shouts accordant.

verses.sa: प्र व इन्द्राय वृत्रहन्तमाय विप्राय गाथं गायत यं जुजोषते ॥
verses.rom: pra va indraya vritrahantamaya vipraya gatham gayata yam jujoshate ||
verses.en: Sing to your Indra, mightiest Vritra-slayer, sing to the Sage the song that he accepteth!

verses.sa: अचेत्यग्निश्चिकितिर्हव्यवाड्न सुमद्रथः ॥
verses.rom: achetyagnishchikitirhavyavadna sumadrathah ||
verses.en: Observant Agni hath appeared, oblation-bearer with his car.

verses.sa: अग्ने त्वं नो अन्तम उत त्राता शिवो भुवो वरूथ्यः ॥
verses.rom: agne tvam no antama uta trata shivo bhuvo varuthyah ||
verses.en: O Agni, be our nearest friend, yea, our protector and our kind deliverer!

verses.sa: भगो न चित्रो अग्निर्महोनां दधाति रत्नं ॥
verses.rom: bhago na chitro agnirmahonam dadhati ratnam ||
verses.en: Like wondrous Bhaga, Agni deals treasure among the mighty.

verses.sa: विश्वस्य प्र स्तोभ पुरो वा सन्यदि वेह नूनं ॥
verses.rom: vishvasya pra stobha puro va sanyadi veha nunam ||
verses.en: Far off or present even now, send forth thy shouting first of all!

verses.sa: उषा अप स्वसुष्टमः सं वर्त्तयति वर्त्तनिं सुजातता ॥
verses.rom: usha apa svasushtamah sam varttayati varttanim sujatata ||
verses.en: Dawn drives away her sister's gloom, and through her excellence makes her retrace her path.

verses.sa: इमा नु कं भुवना सीषधेमेन्द्रश्च विश्वे च देवाः ॥
verses.rom: ima nu kam bhuvana sishadhemendrashcha vishve cha devah ||
verses.en: May we, with Indra and the Gods to aid us, bring these existing worlds to full completion!

verses.sa: वि स्रुतयो यथा पथ इन्द्र त्वद्यन्तु रातयः ॥
verses.rom: vi srutayo yatha patha indra tvadyantu ratayah ||
verses.en: Like streams of water on their way, let bounties, Indra, flow from thee!

verses.sa: अया वाजं देवहितं सनेम मदेम शतहिमाः सुवीराः ॥
verses.rom: aya vajam devahitam sanema madema shatahimah suvirah ||
verses.en: With this may we obtain strength god-appointed, happy with brave sons through a hundred winters!

verses.sa: ऊर्जा मित्रो वरुणः पिन्वतेडाः पीवरीमिषं कृणुही न इन्द्र ॥
verses.rom: urja mitro varunah pinvatedah pivarimisham krinuhi na indra ||
verses.en: With strength let Mitra, Varuna swell oblations; do thou prepare for us rich food, O Indra!

verses.sa: इन्द्रो विश्वस्य राजति ॥
verses.rom: indro vishvasya rajati ||
verses.en: Indra is King of all the world.

verses.sa:
त्रिकद्रुकेषु महिषो यवाशिरं तुविशुष्मस्तृम्पत्सोममपिबद्विष्णुना सुतं यथावशं ।
स ईं ममाद महि कर्म कर्त्तवे महामुरुं सैनं सश्चद्देवो देवं सत्य इन्दुः सत्यमिन्द्रं ॥
verses.rom:
trikadrukeshu mahisho yavashiram tuvishushmastrimpatsomamapibadvishnuna sutam yathavasham |
sa im mamada mahi karma karttave mahamurum sainam sashchaddevo devam satya induh satyamindram ||
verses.en: At the Trikadrukas the great and strong enjoyed the barley-brew. With Vishnu did he drink the pressed-out Soma juice, even as he would. That hath so heightened him the great, the wide to do his mighty work. So did the God attend the God, true Indu Indra who is true.

verses.sa:
अयं सहस्रमानवो दृशः कवीनां मतिर्ज्योतिर्विधर्म ।
ब्रध्नः समीचीरुषसः समैरयदरेपसः सोचेतसः स्वसरे मन्युमन्तश्चिता गोः ॥
verses.rom:
ayam sahasramanavo drishah kavinam matirjyotirvidharma |
bradhnah samichirushasah samairayadarepasah sochetasah svasare manyumantashchita goh ||
verses.en: This God who sees for thousands of mankind, the light, the thought of poets, and the Law, The brilliant one, hath sent forth hither all the Dawns: spotless, one-minded, zealous in their home they dwell, with thought upon the Steer.

verses.sa:
एन्द्र याह्युप नः परावतो नायमच्छा विदथानीव सत्पतिरस्ता राजेव सत्पतिः ।
हवामहे त्वा प्रयस्वन्तः सुतेष्वा पुत्रासो न पितरं वाजसातये मंहिष्ठं वाजसातये ॥
verses.rom:
endra yahyupa nah paravato nayamachchha vidathaniva satpatirasta rajeva satpatih |
havamahe tva prayasvantah suteshva putraso na pitaram vajasataye mamhishtham vajasataye ||
verses.en: Come to us, Indra, from afar, conducting us, as, to the gatherings, a Lord of heroes, as an archer King, the heroes' Lord! We come with gifts of pleasant food, with flowing juice, invoking thee, as sons invite a sire, that we may win the spoil, thee, bounteousest, for gain of spoil.

verses.sa:
तमिन्द्रं जोहवीमि मघवानमुग्रं सत्रा दधानमप्रतिष्कुतं श्रवांसि भूरिः ।
मंहिष्ठो गीर्भिरा च यज्ञियो ववर्त्त राये नो विश्वा सुपथा कृणोतु वज्री ॥
verses.rom:
tamindram johavimi maghavanamugram satra dadhanamapratishkutam shravamsi bhurih |
mamhishtho girbhira cha yajniyo vavartta raye no vishva supatha krinotu vajri ||
verses.en: Loudly I call that Indra Maghavan, the mighty, resistless, evermore possessing many glories. Holy, most liberal, may he lead us on to riches, through songs, and, thunder-armed make all our pathways pleasant!

verses.sa:
अस्तु श्रौषट् पुरो अग्निं धिया दध आ नु त्यच्छर्धो दिव्यं वृणीमह इन्द्रवायू वृणीमहे ।
यद्ध क्राणा विवस्वते नाभा सन्दाय नव्यसे ।
अध प्र नूनमुप यन्ति धीतयो देवांअच्छा न धीतयः ॥
verses.rom:
astu shraushat puro agnim dhiya dadha a nu tyachchhardho divyam vrinimaha indravayu vrinimahe |
yaddha krana vivasvate nabha sandaya navyase |
adha pra nunamupa yanti dhitayo devamachchha na dhitayah ||
verses.en: Heard be our prayer! In thought I honour Agni first: now straightway we elect this heavenly company, Indra and Vayu we elect. For when our latest thought is raised and on Vivasvan centred well, then do our holy songs go forward on their way, our songs as 'twere unto the Gods.

verses.sa:
प्र वो महे मतयो यन्तु विष्णवे मरुत्वते गिरिजा एवयामरुत् ।
प्र शर्धाय प्र यज्यवे सुखादये तवसे भन्ददिष्टये धुनिव्रताय शवसे ॥
verses.rom:
pra vo mahe matayo yantu vishnave marutvate girija evayamarut |
pra shardhaya pra yajyave sukhadaye tavase bhandadishtaye dhunivrataya shavase ||
verses.en: To Vishnu, to the mighty whom the Maruts follow, let your hymns born in song go forth, Evayamarut! To the strong, very holy band adorned with bracelets, that rushes on in joy and ever roars for vigour!

verses.sa:
अया रुचा हरिण्या पुनानो विश्वा द्वेषांसि तरति सयुग्वभिः सूरो न सयुग्वभिः ।
धारा पृष्ठस्य रोचते पुनानो अरुषो हरिः ।
विश्वा यद्रूपा परियास्यृक्वभिः सप्तास्येभिर्ऋक्वभिः ॥
verses.rom:
aya rucha harinya punano vishva dveshamsi tarati sayugvabhih suro na sayugvabhih |
dhara prishthasya rochate punano arusho harih |
vishva yadrupa pariyasyrikvabhih saptasyebhirrikvabhih ||
verses.en: With this his golden splendour purifying him, be with his own allies subdues all enemies, as Sura with his own allies. Cleansing himself with stream of juice he shines forth yellow-hued and red, when with the praisers he encompasses all, forms, with praisers having seven mouths.

verses.sa:
अभि त्यं देवं सवितारमोण्योः कविक्रतुमर्चामि सत्यसवं रत्नधामभि प्रियं मतिम्
ऊर्ध्वा यस्यामतिर्भा अदिद्युतत्सवीमनि हिरण्यपाणिरमिमीत सुक्रतुः कृपा स्वः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi tyam devam savitaramonyoh kavikratumarchami satyasavam ratnadhamabhi priyam matim
urdhva yasyamatirbha adidyutatsavimani hiranyapaniramimita sukratuh kripa svah ||
verses.en: I praise this God, parent of heaven and earth, exceeding wise, possessed of real energy, giver of treasure, thinker dear to all, Whose splendour is sublime, whose light shone brilliant in, creation, who, wise and golden-handed, in his beauty mader the sky.

verses.sa:
अग्निं होतारं मन्ये दास्वन्तं वसोः सूनुं सहसो जातवेदसं विप्रं न जातवेदसं ।
य ऊर्ध्वया स्वध्वरो देवो देवाच्या कृपा ।
घृतस्य विभ्राष्टिमनु शुक्रशोचिष आजुह्वानस्य सर्पिषः ॥
verses.rom:
agnim hotaram manye dasvantam vasoh sunum sahaso jatavedasam vipram na jatavedasam |
ya urdhvaya svadhvaro devo devachya kripa |
ghritasya vibhrashtimanu shukrashochisha ajuhvanasya sarpishah ||
verses.en: Agni I deem our Hotar-priest, munificent wealth-giver, Son of Strength, who, knoweth all that is, even as the Sage who, knoweth all. Lord of fair rites, a God with form erected turning to the Gods, he, when the flame hath sprung forth from the holy oil, the offered fatness, longs for it as it glows bright.

verses.sa:
तव त्यन्नर्यं नृतोऽप इन्द्र प्रथमं पूर्व्यं दिवि प्रवाच्यं कृतं ।
यो देवस्य शवसा प्रारिणा असु रिणन्नपः ।
भुवो विश्वमभ्यदेवमोजसा विदेदूर्जं शतक्रतुर्विदेदिषं ॥
verses.rom:
tava tyannaryam nrito'pa indra prathamam purvyam divi pravachyam kritam |
yo devasya shavasa prarina asu rinannapah |
bhuvo vishvamabhyadevamojasa videdurjam shatakraturvidedisham ||
verses.en: This, Indra! dancer! was thy hero deed, thy first and ancient work, worthy to be told forth in heaven, Even thine who furtheredst life with a God's own power, freeing the floods. All that is godless may he conquer with his might, and, Lord of Hundred Powers, find for us strength and food!

verses.sa:
उच्चा ते जातमन्धसो दिवि सद्भूम्या ददे ।
उग्रं शर्म महि श्रवः ॥
verses.rom:
uchcha te jatamandhaso divi sadbhumya dade |
ugram sharma mahi shravah ||
verses.en: High is thy juice's birth: though set it heaven, on earth it hath obtained dread sheltering power and great renown.

verses.sa:
स्वादिष्ठया मदिष्ठया पवस्व सोम धारया ।
इन्द्राय पातवे सुतः ॥
verses.rom:
svadishthaya madishthaya pavasva soma dharaya |
indraya patave sutah ||
verses.en: In sweetest and most gladdening stream flow pure, O Soma, on thy way, pressed out for Indra, for his drink!

verses.sa:
वृषा पवस्व धारया मरुत्वते च मत्सरः ।
विश्वा दधान ओजसा ॥
verses.rom:
vrisha pavasva dharaya marutvate cha matsarah |
vishva dadhana ojasa ||
verses.en: Flow onward mighty with thy stream, inspiriting the Maruts' Lord, winning all riches with thy power!

verses.sa:
यस्ते मदो वरेण्यस्तेना पवस्वान्धसा ।
देवावीरघशंसहा ॥
verses.rom:
yaste mado varenyastena pavasvandhasa |
devaviraghashamsaha ||
verses.en: Flow onward with that juice of thine most excellent, that brings delight, slaying the wicked, dear to Gods!

verses.sa:
तिस्रो वाच उदीरते गावो मिमन्ति धेनवः ।
हरिरेति कनिक्रदत् ॥
verses.rom:
tisro vacha udirate gavo mimanti dhenavah |
harireti kanikradat ||
verses.en: Three several words are uttered: kine are lowing, cows who give the milk; the tawny- hued goes bellowing on.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रायेन्दो मरुत्वते पवस्व मधुमत्तमः ।
अर्कस्य योनिमासदं ॥
verses.rom:
indrayendo marutvate pavasva madhumattamah |
arkasya yonimasadam ||
